id: Jago pedang wanita dari reruntuhan Kerajaan Sama. Penyelamat kerajaannya, dan salah satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Rakyat Savat yang dipimpinnya semua mati di perang besar. Sebagai orang terakhir yang masih hidup, ia mencoba bunuh diri, namun suara dari pedangnya Lexida menghentikannya. Itulah suara dari rakyatnya. Dengan jiwa-jiwa sekutunya di dalam pedang, ia bertarung dengan lebih banyak kekuatan dan keindahan daripada sebelumnya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20015_DESCRIPTION
desc: A swordswoman from the ruined Sama Kingdom. She is the savior of her kingdom, and one of the Six Heroes. The Savat people she led all lost their lives in the great war. As the last one standing, she tried to end her life, but a voice from her sword Lexida halted her. It was the voices of her fallen countrymen. With her allies' souls in her sword, she fought with more strength and beauty than ever before.

raw.en: A swordswoman from the ruined Sama Kingdom. She is the savior of her kingdom, and one of the Six Heroes. The Savat people she led all lost their lives in the great war. As the last one standing, she tried to end her life, but a voice from her sword Lexida halted her. It was the voices of her fallen countrymen. With her allies' souls in her sword, she fought with more strength and beauty than ever before.
raw.es: Espadachina del antiguo reino de Sama. Una de las salvadoras del reino y miembro de los Seis héroes. Todos los miembros de Savat que ella guió en la gran guerra perdieron la vida. Cuando quedó sola en el campo de batalla, Selena intentó quitarse la vida, pero la voz que salía de su espada Lexida la detuvo. Lo que escuchó fueron las voces de sus camaradas caídos. Con las almas de sus aliados en su espada, Selena peleó con más fuerza y belleza que nunca antes.

raw.pt: Uma espadachim do reino arruinado de Sama. Ela foi a salvadora de seu reino, e uma entre os Seis Heróis. O povo de Savat que ela liderou todos perderam a vida durante a grande guerra. Como última dos seus, ela tentou dar cabo da própria vida, mas uma voz de sua espada Lexida a impediu. Era a voz de seus compatriotas caídos. Com as almas de seus aliados em sua espada, ela lutou com mais força e beleza do que antes.
raw.th: นักดาบหญิงจากซากราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย เธอเป็นผู้กอบกู้ดินแดนของเธอและหนึ่งในวีรบุรุษทั้งหก ชาวซาวัทที่เธอนำทัพเสียชีวิตในสงครามครั้งใหญ่ทั้งหมด ขณะที่เหลืออยู่เป็นคนสุดท้าย เธอพยายามจะจบชีวิตของตนเองแต่เสียงจาก เล็คส์สิดาดาบของเธอได้หยุดเธอเอาไว้ มันเป็นเสียงของเพื่อนร่วมชาติที่ตายไป เมื่อมีวิญญาณของเหล่าสหายอยู่ในดาบ เธอสู้ด้วยหลังที่เพิ่มขึ้นและงดงามมากขึ้นกว่าแต่ก่อน
raw.vi: Một nữ kiếm sĩ đến từ Vương quốc Sama đổ nát. Cô là vị cứu tinh của vương quốc và một trong Sáu vị anh hùng. Những người Savat mà cô dẫn dắt tất cả đã thiệt mạng trong cuộc đại chiến. Là người cuối cùng còn lại, cô đã cố gắng kết thúc cuộc đời mình, nhưng giọng nói từ thanh kiếm của cô Lexida đã khiến cô dừng lại. Đó là tiếng nói của những đồng hương đã ngã xuống của cô. Linh hồn các đồng đội của cô ở trong thanh kiếm, cô đã chiến đấu với sức mạnh và vẻ đẹp hơn bao giờ hết.

id: Setelah kehilangan orang-orang yang dipimpinnya di medan perang, Selena berusaha menghentikan Pasukan Dewa. Dalam perjalanannya ke sana, dia diserang oleh ahli sihir fanatik, meskipun dia berhasil selamat karena pengorbanan teman dekatnya Lucina. Selena mendapatkan kekuatan yang lebih besar dari para dewa dalam pertarungan ini, tapi langsung setelah itu seorang ksatria muncul di depannya dan berbicara kepadanya. Menjawab dengan "meskipun begitu, aku tidak akan mengampunimu," dia dibunuh oleh ksatria itu sambil memandang rendah ksatria itu. Orang-orang yang berhasil selamat setelah pengorbanannya berhenti melawan dan pergi mencari rumah baru.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20016_DESCRIPTION
desc: After losing the people she had led onto the battlefield, Selena sought to stop the God Army. On her way there, she suffered an assault by a religious fanatic witch, though she was able to escape thanks to the sacrifice her close friend Lucina had made. Selena attained powers greater than those of the gods during this battle, but immediately after a knight appeared before her and spoke. Answering that "even so, I will never forgive you," she was struck down by the knight while she stared him down. The people who managed to survive after her death stopped retaliating and went on to seek a new home.

raw.en: After losing the people she had led onto the battlefield, Selena sought to stop the God Army. On her way there, she suffered an assault by a religious fanatic witch, though she was able to escape thanks to the sacrifice her close friend Lucina had made. Selena attained powers greater than those of the gods during this battle, but immediately after a knight appeared before her and spoke. Answering that "even so, I will never forgive you," she was struck down by the knight while she stared him down. The people who managed to survive after her death stopped retaliating and went on to seek a new home.
raw.es: Tras haber perdido a la gente que había guiado en el campo, Selena intentó detener al ejército divino. De camino, una bruja y fanática religiosa la atacó. Selena escapó gracias al sacrificio que su gran amiga Lucina había realizado. Durante la batalla, Selena consiguió poderes incluso más abrumadores que los de los dioses, pero un caballero apareció frente a ella de repente y le habló. Luego de responder: «Nunca te perdonaré», Selena cayó tras recibir una estocada del caballero, mientras lo miraba a los ojos. La gente que logró sobrevivir a su muerte dejó de atacar y comenzó a buscar un nuevo hogar.
raw.id: Setelah kehilangan orang-orang yang dipimpinnya di medan perang, Selena berusaha menghentikan Pasukan Dewa. Dalam perjalanannya ke sana, dia diserang oleh ahli sihir fanatik, meskipun dia berhasil selamat karena pengorbanan teman dekatnya Lucina. Selena mendapatkan kekuatan yang lebih besar dari para dewa dalam pertarungan ini, tapi langsung setelah itu seorang ksatria muncul di depannya dan berbicara kepadanya. Menjawab dengan "meskipun begitu, aku tidak akan mengampunimu," dia dibunuh oleh ksatria itu sambil memandang rendah ksatria itu. Orang-orang yang berhasil selamat setelah pengorbanannya berhenti melawan dan pergi mencari rumah baru.
raw.pt: Depois de perder as pessoas que conduziu na batalha, Selena quis deter o Exército dos Deuses. No seu caminho, ela foi atacada por uma bruxa religiosa fanática. Ela conseguiu escapar graças ao sacrifício da sua amiga Lucina. Selena adquiriu poderes maiores que os dos deuses, mas imediatamente após um cavaleiro apareceu à sua frente e falou. Respondendo que “mesmo assim, jamais perdoarei,” ela foi atacada pelo cavaleiro enquanto o encarava. Quem conseguiu sobreviver após a morte dela parou de batalhar e procurou um novo lar.
raw.th: หลังจากประชาชนล้มตายไปมาก เซเลน่าจึงเข้าร่วมสนามรบเพื่อหยุดยั้งทหารเทพ ในการต่อสู้ เธอถูกกลุ่มคนคลั่งแม่มดโจมตีจนได้รับบาดเจ็บ แต่จากการสังเวยชีวิตของลูซิน่าเพื่อนสนิท จึงทำให้เธอหนีรอดออกมาได้ เซเลน่ายังได้รับพลังที่เหนือกว่าเหล่าเทพระหว่างการต่อสู้ แต่หลังจากอัศวินผู้หนึ่งปรากฎตัว และเธอตอบไปว่า "อย่างไรเสีย ข้าก็ไม่มีวันยกโทษให้เจ้า" เธอก็ถูกเขาโจมตีขณะที่เธอกำลังจะเอาชนะเขา หลังจากการตายของเธอ ผู้คนที่ยังรักชีวิตของตนจึงหยุดการตอบโต้ และออกเดินทางเพื่อหาที่อยู่แห่งใหม่t
raw.vi: Sau khi mất đi những người mà cô chỉ huy trên chiến trường, Selena đã tìm cách dừng Đội Quân Các Vị Thần. Trên đường đến đó, cô gặp phải một cuộc đột kích bởi một phù thủy sùng đạo cuồng tín, mặc dù cô có thể trốn thoát nhờ sự hy sinh của người bạn thân của cô là Lucina. Selena đã đạt đến sức mạnh lớn hơn sức mạnh của các vị thần trong trận chiến này, nhưng ngay lập tức sau khi một hiệp sĩ xuất hiện trước cô và nói chuyện. Sau câu trả lời "ngay cả vậy, tôi sẽ không bao giờ tha thứ cho anh", cô đã chết dưới tay hiệp sĩ trong khi cô đang nhìn chằm chằm vào anh ta. Những người dân đã cố gắng sống sót sau cái chết của cô đã thôi trả thù và tiếp tục tìm kiếm một ngôi nhà mới.

id: Penunggang naga dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Dia dilatih oleh ayahnya dan menjadi penunggang naga pada umur 14. Kemampuannya untuk menunggang naga laut dan udara membuatnya menjadi kandidat menjadi komandan. Dia sangat setia dan melakukan perintah raja tanpa bertanya, tapi itulah yang akhirnya menyebabkan kejatuhannya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20021_DESCRIPTION
desc: A dragon rider from the ruined Sama Kingdom. He trained under his father and became a dragon rider at the young age of 14. His ability to ride marine and aerial dragons made him a promising candidate for commander. He was deeply loyal and accepted orders from his king unconditionally, but that inflexibility eventually led to his downfall.

raw.en: A dragon rider from the ruined Sama Kingdom. He trained under his father and became a dragon rider at the young age of 14. His ability to ride marine and aerial dragons made him a promising candidate for commander. He was deeply loyal and accepted orders from his king unconditionally, but that inflexibility eventually led to his downfall.
raw.es: Jinete de dragones del antiguo reino de Sama que se entrenó bajo la tutela de su padre hasta los 14 años. Su talento para cabalgar dragones marinos y aéreos hizo que se convirtiera en un posible comandante. Su total lealtad a su rey acabó por llevarlo a su ruina.
raw.id: Penunggang naga dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Dia dilatih oleh ayahnya dan menjadi penunggang naga pada umur 14. Kemampuannya untuk menunggang naga laut dan udara membuatnya menjadi kandidat menjadi komandan. Dia sangat setia dan melakukan perintah raja tanpa bertanya, tapi itulah yang akhirnya menyebabkan kejatuhannya.
raw.pt: Um cavaleiro de dragões do Reino arruinado de Sama. Ele treinou com seu pai e se tornou um cavaleiro de dragões cedo, aos 14 anos. Sua habilidade para montar dragões aéreos e marinhos fazia dele um candidato promissor a comandante. Ele era profundamente leal e aceitava ordens de seu rei incondicionalmente, mas essa falta de flexibilidade resultou na sua ruína.
raw.th: ผู้ขี่มังกรจากราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย เขาได้รับการฝึกฝนโดยพ่อของเขาและกลายเป็นผู้ขี่มังกรในวัยหนุ่มเมื่ออายุ 14 ความสามารถในการขี่มังกรน้ำและอากาศทำให้เขาเป็นผู้สมัครที่มีแนวโน้มจะได้เป็นผู้บังคับบัญชามากที่สุด เขามีความจงรักภักดีต่อพระราชามากและทำตามคำสังอย่างไม่มีเงื่อนไข แต่ความเที่ยงตรงแบบนั้นก็ทำให้เขาตกต่ำลงในที่สุด
raw.vi: Một kỵ sĩ rồng tới từ vương quốc Sama đổ nát. Chàng tập luyện dưới sự hướng dẫn của cha và trở thành một tay đua rồng trẻ tuổi khi mới 14. Khả năng cưỡi rồng biển và trên không giúp chàng trở thành ứng cử viên đầy hứa hẹn cho chức chỉ huy. Chàng vô cùng trung thành và chấp nhận lệnh của nhà vua vô điều kiện, nhưng cứng nhắc, cuối cùng dẫn đến chính mình bị suy yếu và sụp đổ.

id: Penunggang naga dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Harapannya untuk menjadi komandan ksatria naga berikutnya hancur karena dia melakukan perintah yang dikiranya datang dari raja. Meskipun menjadi tahanan rumah, kesetiaannya tidak berubah. Dia malah melanjutkan berlatih. Dia dikenal sebagai Ksatria Naga Es, memakai tombak yang dibuat dari es unik kerajaannya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20022_DESCRIPTION
desc: A dragon rider from the ruined Sama Kingdom. His hopes of becoming the next dragon knight commander were lost when he mistakingly took orders which he thought were from the king. Even under house arrest, his loyalty didn't falter. Instead, he continued to hone his skills. He was known as the Ice Dragon Knight, wielding his spear made from his kingdom's unique ice.

raw.en: A dragon rider from the ruined Sama Kingdom. His hopes of becoming the next dragon knight commander were lost when he mistakingly took orders which he thought were from the king. Even under house arrest, his loyalty didn't falter. Instead, he continued to hone his skills. He was known as the Ice Dragon Knight, wielding his spear made from his kingdom's unique ice.
raw.es: Jinete de dragones del antiguo reino de Sama. Su sueño de convertirse en el próximo comandante del ejército de dragones se esfumó cuando decidió seguir órdenes que pensó eran del rey. Incluso tras ser arrestado por ello, mantuvo su lealtad y continuó entrenando sus habilidades. Se conocía como el caballero dragontino, famoso por su gélida lanza fabricada en su reino.
raw.id: Penunggang naga dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Harapannya untuk menjadi komandan ksatria naga berikutnya hancur karena dia melakukan perintah yang dikiranya datang dari raja. Meskipun menjadi tahanan rumah, kesetiaannya tidak berubah. Dia malah melanjutkan berlatih. Dia dikenal sebagai Ksatria Naga Es, memakai tombak yang dibuat dari es unik kerajaannya.
raw.pt: Um cavaleiro de dragões do Reino arruinado de Sama. Suas esperanças de se tornar o próximo comandante dos cavaleiros de dragões foram minadas quando ele aceitou por engano ordens que acreditava serem do rei. Mesmo sob prisão domiciliar, sua lealdade não falhou. Pelo contrário, ele ainda continuou a aprimorar suas habilidades. Ele era conhecido como o Cavaleiro de Dragão do Gelo, empunhando sua lança feita com o peculiar gelo do seu Reino.
raw.th: ผู้ขี่มังกรจากราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย ความหวังที่จะเป็นผู้บัญชาการอัศวินมังกรของเขาต้องสลายไปเมื่อเขาทำตามคำสั่งที่เขาเข้าใจว่ามาจากพระราชา แม้จะถูกกักบริเวณภายในบ้านของตัวเองความภักดีของเขาก็ยังไม่เสื่อมคลาย กลับกัน เขายังคงฝึกฝนทักษะต่อไป เขาเป็นที่รู้จักในฐานะอัศวินมังกรน้ำแข็ง จากหอกของเขาซึ่งสร้างมาจากน้ำแข็งพิเศษของราชอาณาจักร
raw.vi: Một kỵ sĩ rồng tại vương quốc Sama tan rã đã mất hy vọng trở thành người chỉ huy con rồng tiếp theo khi ông không tuân mệnh lệnh của nhà vua. Mặc dù bị bắt giam nhưng lòng trung thành của ông vẫn không thay đổi. Thay vào đó, ông tiếp tục rèn luyện kỹ năng bản thân. Ông được gọi là Kỵ sỹ rồng băng, cầm ngọn giáo của mình làm từ loại băng đặc biệt của vương quốc của mình .

id: Penunggang naga dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Dia menjadi tahanan rumah, tapi kembali ke pasukan penunggang naga ketika para dewa menyerang. Dia punya keinginan membunuh sebagai cara melampiaskan kemarahannya. Dia mendapat kehormatan dan gelar Raja Naga Es. Dia masih setia kepada keluarga raja, dan ketika para dewa menyerang, dia menawarkan diri untuk melindungi mereka.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20023_DESCRIPTION
desc: A dragon rider from the ruined Sama Kingdom. He had been under house arrest, but returned to the dragon rider corps when the gods invaded. He had a lust for killing as a way of venting his anger. He earned respect and the title of the Ice Dragon King. He was still loyal to the royal family, and when the gods attacked, he offered himself to protect them.

He was still loyal to the royal family, and when the gods attacked, he offered himself to protect them.
raw.es: Jinete de dragones del antiguo reino de Sama. Después de su arresto, regresó al ejército de jinetes dragontinos tras el ataque de los dioses. Su rabia contenida se liberó contra sus víctimas y su fama le hizo ganarse el título de Rey de los Dragones. Su lealtad hacia el rey se mantuvo cuando los dioses atacaron, ofreciéndose a protegerlo.

raw.pt: Um cavaleiro de dragões do Reino arruinado de Sama. Ele esteve sob prisão domiciliar, mas retornou à tropa dos cavaleiros de dragão quando os deuses invadiram. Ele tinha desejo de morte como forma de descontar sua raiva. Ele ganhou respeito, e o título de Rei-Dragão de Gelo. Ele ainda era leal à família real, e quando os deuses atacaram, ele se ofereceu para protegê-los.
raw.th: ผู้ขี่มังกรจากราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย เขาถูกกักขังอยู่ในบ้านของตัวเอง แต่ก็กลับมาร่วมกองพันนักขี่มังกรเมื่อครั้งที่เทพเจ้ารุกราน เขาลุ่มหลงในการฆ่าเหมือนกับเป็นการระบายความโกรธที่กักเก็บในใจ เขาได้รับความเคารพนับถือและถูกขนานนามว่าราชันย์มังกรน้ำแข็ง เขายังคงภักดีต่อราชวงศ์ และเมื่อเหล่าทวยเทพมารุกราน เขาได้เสนอตัวเองเพื่อเข้าปกป้อง
raw.vi: Một kỵ sỹ rồng sống tại vương quốc Sama. Tuy bị bắt giam nhưng ông đã quay trở lại và tham gia vào đoàn quân chỉ huy rồng khi các vị thần xâm lược. Ông muốn chiến đấu như một cách để trút cơn giận của mình . Ông được người dân tôn trọng và đặt tên là Vua rồng băng. Ông vẫn giữ lòng trung thành với hoàng gia, và khi các vị thần tấn công, ông đã hết mình bảo vệ họ.

id: Penunggang naga dari reruntuhan Kerajaan Sima. Ketika para dewa menginvasi, ia melindungi keluarga kerajaan sehingga terluka fatal. Hampir pingsan, ia merasa jiwanya dan jiwa naga tercinta berfusi menjadi satu. Saat bangun, ia merasakan kekuatan naga mengalir dalam tubuh manusianya. Namun sang naga terbaring di sampingnya, tak bergerak.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20024_DESCRIPTION
desc: A dragon rider from the ruined Sama Kingdom. When the gods invaded, he stood up to protect the royal family, suffering a fatal wound in the process. On the brink of blacking out, he felt his and his beloved dragon's souls fuse as one. When he woke up, he felt his dragon's powers stirring in his human body. His dragon, however, lay beside him, unmoving.

raw.en: A dragon rider from the ruined Sama Kingdom. When the gods invaded, he stood up to protect the royal family, suffering a fatal wound in the process. On the brink of blacking out, he felt his and his beloved dragon's souls fuse as one. When he woke up, he felt his dragon's powers stirring in his human body. His dragon, however, lay beside him, unmoving.
raw.es: Jinete de dragones del antiguo reino de Sama. Cuando los dioses invadieron, Zephu se alzó para proteger a la familia real y recibió una herida letal. Al borde del desmayo, sintió que su alma y el alma de su querido dragón se fundieron en una. Cuando se despertó, notó que los poderes dragontinos se arremolinaban en su cuerpo humano. Su dragón, sin embargo, yacía a su lado, inmóvil.
raw.id: Penunggang naga dari reruntuhan Kerajaan Sima. Ketika para dewa menginvasi, ia melindungi keluarga kerajaan sehingga terluka fatal. Hampir pingsan, ia merasa jiwanya dan jiwa naga tercinta berfusi menjadi satu. Saat bangun, ia merasakan kekuatan naga mengalir dalam tubuh manusianya. Namun sang naga terbaring di sampingnya, tak bergerak.
raw.pt: Um ginete de dragões do Reino arruinado de Sama. Quando os deuses invadiram, ele se defendeu a família real, sofrendo um ferimento mortal no processo. Prestes a perder a consciência, ele sentiu a sua alma se fundindo com a de seu dragão. Quando ele acordou, sentiu os poderes de seu dragão em seu corpo humano. Entretanto, seu dragão estava deitado a seu lado, sem se mover.
raw.th: นักขี่มังกรจากซากราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย เขาลุกขึ้นปกป้องราชวงศ์เมื่อเทพเจ้ารุกรานและบาดเจ็บสาหัสจากเหตุการณ์นั้น ในช่วงที่จะหมดสติ เขารู้สึกว่าวิญญาณของเขาและมังกรที่เขารักได้รวมกันเป็นหนึ่ง เมื่อเขาตื่นขึ้นมา เขารู้สึกได้ถึงพลังของมังกรแผ่ซ่านไปทั่วร่างมนุษย์ของเขา อย่างไรก็ตามมังกรที่เขารักกลับหลับไหลอยู่ข้างกายเขา ไม่ขยับ ไม่ตื่นไปตลอดกาล
raw.vi: Một kỵ sĩ rồng đến từ Vương quốc Sama đổ nát. Khi các vị thần xâm lược, anh đã đứng lên bảo vệ gia đình hoàng tộc của mình, chịu một vết thương chí mạng trong quá trình này. Trong lúc sắp ngất đi, anh cảm thấy linh hồn của mình và con rồng anh yêu quý hòa làm một. Khi anh tỉnh dậy, anh cảm thấy sức mạnh của con rồng đang khuấy động trong cơ thể con người của mình. Tuy nhiên, con rồng của anh nằm bên trong anh, không động đậy.

id: Pasukan naga yang melindungi keluarga bangsawan Kerajaan Sama sampai titik darah penghabisan selama perang besar dengan para dewa. Zephu terus bertarung meski sudah menyelamatkan Pangeran Arius. Ia bertarung sepenuh hati sehingga jiwa dan raganya terfusi dengan naganya. Tombaknya bertransformasi juga, dengan nama baru "Naga Es" dan menjadi ekstensi tubuh Zephu sendiri. Zephu tahu semakin ia memaksakan tubuh dan pikiran, maut akan semakin dekat.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20025_DESCRIPTION
desc: A dragoon who protected the royal family of the Sama Kingdom until the very end during the great war with the gods. Zephu, who continued to fight even after having rescued Prince Arius, fought so arduously that both his soul and his body began fusing with those of his dragon. His beloved lance went through the same transformation, and under the new name "Ice Dragon," became an extension of Zephu's own body. However, Zephu knew that the more he strained both his mind and body, the closer it would bring him to his death.

raw.en: A dragoon who protected the royal family of the Sama Kingdom until the very end during the great war with the gods. Zephu, who continued to fight even after having rescued Prince Arius, fought so arduously that both his soul and his body began fusing with those of his dragon. His beloved lance went through the same transformation, and under the new name "Ice Dragon," became an extension of Zephu's own body. However, Zephu knew that the more he strained both his mind and body, the closer it would bring him to his death.
raw.es: Caballero dragontino que protegió a la familia real del imperio de Sama hasta el mismísimo final durante la guerra contra los dioses. Zephu, que siguió luchando incluso luego de haber rescatado al príncipe Arius, luchó tan arduamente que tanto su alma como su cuerpo comenzaron a fusionarse con los de su dragón. Su amada lanza sufrió la misma metamorfosis, se convirtió en una extensión del cuerpo de Zephu y ganó el apelativo de "Dragón gélido". Sin embargo, Zephu sabía que mientras más cansancio sufrieran su mente y su cuerpo, más rápido se acercaría a las garras de la muerte.

Zephu terus bertarung meski sudah menyelamatkan Pangeran Arius. Ia bertarung sepenuh hati sehingga jiwa dan raganya terfusi dengan naganya. Tombaknya bertransformasi juga, dengan nama baru "Naga Es" dan menjadi ekstensi tubuh Zephu sendiri. Zephu tahu semakin ia memaksakan tubuh dan pikiran, maut akan semakin dekat.
raw.pt: Um dragão que protegeu a família real do Reino Sama até o fim durante a grande guerra com os deuses. Zephu, que continuou lutando até mesmo depois de resgatar o Príncipe Arius, lutou tão arduamente que sua alma e corpo se fundiram com os do seu dragão. Sua adorada lança passou pela mesma transformação, e sob seu novo nome, “Dragão Gelado”, começou uma extensão do seu próprio corpo. Porém, Zephu sabia que, quanto mais forçasse sua mente e corpo, mais próximo da morte ele estaria.
raw.th: ดรากูนผู้ปกป้องครอบครัวราชวงศ์แห่งราชอาณาจักรซามะจะกระทั่งใกล้ถึงวาระสุดท้าย ระหว่างสงครามครั้งใหญ่กับเทพเจ้า เซปพู ผู้ที่ยังคงต่อสู้แม้ว่าจะหลังจากได้ช่วยเหลือเจ้าชายอาเรียสแล้ว ต่อสู้ตัวเป็นเกลียวจนทั้งร่างกายและวิญญาณของเขาเริ่มที่จะหลอมรวมเข้ากับมังกรของเข หอกสุดรักของเขาได้ผ่านการเปลี่ยนแปลงแบบเดียวกัน และภายใต้ชื่อใหม่ " มังกรน้ำแข็ง" ก็ได้กลายเป็นส่วนเสริมของร่างกายเซปพูเอง อย่างไรก็ตาม เซปพู รู้ว่ายิ่งเขาโหมใช้ทั้งร่างกายและวิญญาณมากเท่าไหร่ ก็ยิ่งทำให้เขาเข้าใกล้ความตายมากขึ้นเท่านั้น
raw.vi: Một kỵ sĩ rồng đã bảo vệ gia đình hoàng tộc của Vương quốc Sama cho đến tận khi cuộc đại chiến với các vị thần kết thúc. Zephu, người đã tiếp tục chiến đấu ngay cả sau khi đã giải cứu Hoàng tử Arius, chiến đấu hết sức mình đến mức cả linh hồn và cơ thể anh bắt đầu hợp nhất với con rồng của anh. Cây thương mà anh yêu quý cũng trải qua những biến đổi tương tự, và dưới cái tên mới "Rồng băng", đã trở thành một phần nối dài của chính cơ thể Zephu. Tuy nhiên, Zephu biết rằng anh càng lợi dụng quá mức cả tâm trí và cơ thể mình, nó sẽ càng mang anh đến gần với cái chết.

id: Setan yang lahir dari tetesan di bawah air terjun besar. Mereka lemah dan berpangkat paling renjadh dari semua monster. Mereka bertindak dalam grup dan suka tempat berair, tapi pengecut dan biasanya lari dari manusia. Tapi, beberapa kasar dan menyerang dengan menempelkan diri di kepala musuh. Katanya mereka tidak cocok untuk diminum, tapi belum ada yang pernah mencoba teori ini.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20030_DESCRIPTION
desc: A demon born from drops at the bottom of a giant waterfall. They are weak and the lowest ranked of all monsters. They exhibit pack behavior and like watery places, but are cowardly and usually run from humans. However, some of them are violent and attack by attaching themselves to an enemy's head. Rumor is they're not suitable for drinking, but no one has ever tested this theory.

raw.en: A demon born from drops at the bottom of a giant waterfall. They are weak and the lowest ranked of all monsters. They exhibit pack behavior and like watery places, but are cowardly and usually run from humans. However, some of them are violent and attack by attaching themselves to an enemy's head. Rumor is they're not suitable for drinking, but no one has ever tested this theory.
raw.es: Demonio que emanó del fondo de una enorme cascada. Se considera una de las unidades más básicas. Le gusta ir en manada y frecuenta lugares húmedos, pero son cobardes y casi siempre huyen de los humanos. No obstante, algunos son violentos y atacan a sus enemigos tirándose a su cabeza. Se rumora que no son potables, pero nadie ha podido comprobar esta teoría.
raw.id: Setan yang lahir dari tetesan di bawah air terjun besar. Mereka lemah dan berpangkat paling renjadh dari semua monster. Mereka bertindak dalam grup dan suka tempat berair, tapi pengecut dan biasanya lari dari manusia. Tapi, beberapa kasar dan menyerang dengan menempelkan diri di kepala musuh. raw.pt: Um demônio nascido das gotas ao pé de uma cascata gigante. Eles são fracos e pertencem ao menor escalão de todos os monstros. Também exibem comportamento de bando e gostam de lugares molhados, mas são covardes e geralmente fogem de humanos. Porém, alguns deles são violentos e atacam prendendo-se à cabeça de um inimigo. Dizem que eles não são aptos a serem bebidos, mas essa teoria nunca foi testada.
raw.th: ปีศาจที่เกิดจากหยดน้ำตรงก้นบึ้งของน้ำตกยักษ์ พวกมันอ่อนแอเป็นเป็นพวกระดับต่ำที่สุด พวกมันมีพฤษติกรรมชอบอยู่กันเป็นฝูงและอาศัยอยู่ใกล้แหล่งน้ำแต่ก็ขี้ขลาดและมักจะหลบหน้าพวกมนุษย์ แต่ก็มีพวกมันบางตัวที่ดุร้ายและโจมตีด้วยการเกาะอยู่บนหัวของศัตรู ร่ำลือกันว่ามันไม่เหมาะที่จะนำมาใช้ดื่ม แต่ก็ยังไม่เคยมีใครทดสอบทฤษฎีดังกล่าว
raw.vi: Một con quỷ sinh ra từ những giọt nước ở tầng dưới cùng một thác nước khổng lồ. Chúng còn yếu và thuộc hàng thấp nhất trong tất cả các quái vật. Chúng sống theo bầy và thích những nơi nhiều nước, nhưng lại hèn nhát và thường bỏ chạy khi gặp con người. Tuy nhiên, có những con rất bạo lực và tấn công bằng cách thúc mình vào đầu của kẻ thù. Theo như lời đồn, chúng không uống máu nhưng chưa ai từng thử nghiệm giả thuyết này.

id: Jelly Air katanya berubah menjadi Raja jelly Air setelah mendaki air terjun di mana dia dilahirkan. Tidak seperti Jelly Air, dia suka bertarung, tapi air jernih yang suka diminumnya membuat habitatnya terbatas. Kalau berhati-hati, orang bisa menghindari bertemu dengan Raja Jelly Air. Jauh lebih kuat dari Jelly Air, banjir air yang dimuntahkannya cukup untuk menenggelamkan seseorang meski di atas tanah.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20031_DESCRIPTION
desc: Squirty is said to evolve into King Squirty after climbing the waterfall under which it was born. Unlike a normal Squirty, it likes fighting, yet the clear water that it enjoys drinking limits this habitat. If one is careful, it is possible to avoid an encounter with this liquid-type creature. Considerably more powerful than its lesser form, the flood of water it spews is mighty enough to drown someone even on land.

raw.en: Squirty is said to evolve into King Squirty after climbing the waterfall under which it was born. Unlike a normal Squirty, it likes fighting, yet the clear water that it enjoys drinking limits this habitat. If one is careful, it is possible to avoid an encounter with this liquid-type creature. Considerably more powerful than its lesser form, the flood of water it spews is mighty enough to drown someone even on land.
raw.es: El rey Espumito mutó tras lograr escalar la cascada de la que emanó. Su carácter cambió y ahora es más combativo, aunque no suele salir del agua. Por ello, es fácil evitar un combate con él. Puede expulsar un torrente de agua tan poderoso que es capaz de ahogar a una persona incluso en tierra.
raw.id: Jelly Air katanya berubah menjadi Raja jelly Air setelah mendaki air terjun di mana dia dilahirkan. Tidak seperti Jelly Air, dia suka bertarung, tapi air jernih yang suka diminumnya membuat habitatnya terbatas. Kalau berhati-hati, orang bisa menghindari bertemu dengan Raja Jelly Air. Jauh lebih kuat dari Jelly Air, banjir air yang dimuntahkannya cukup untuk menenggelamkan seseorang meski di atas tanah.
raw.pt: Dizem que o Visco Aquático evolui ao Rei dos Viscos Aquáticos após subir a cascata onde nasceu. Ao contrário do Visco Aquático, ele gosta de lutar, mas a água limpa que ele gosta de beber limita seu hábitat. Ao tomar cuidado, é possível evitar um confronto com o Rei dos Viscos Aquáticos. Consideravelmente mais poderoso do que o Visco Aquático, o fluxo de água que ele expele é poderoso o suficiente para fogar alguém mesmo em terra.
raw.th: ว่ากันว่าสไลม์น้ำจะพัฒนาเป็นราชันย์สไลม์น้ำหลังจากปีนน้ำตกที่พวกมันเกิด มันชอบการต่อสู้ซึ่งจากสไลม์น้ำทั่วไป แต่แหล่งน้ำสะอาดที่พวกมันชอบดื่มนั้นมีจำกัดจึงไม่ค่อยมีแหล่งอาศัยสำหรับมัน ถ้าระวังตัวดีๆ ก็จะสามารถหลีกเลี่ยงพวกมันได้ พวกมันจัดได้ว่าเป็นสไลม์น้ำที่มีพลังมาก อาจจะทำให้คนจมน้ำทั้งที่ยังอยู่บนบกเลยก็ได้
raw.vi: Water Slime được cho là trở thành Vua Water Slime sau khi leo lên được thác nước mà nó đã sinh ra . Không giống như Water Slime, nó thích đánh nhau, nhưng lại chỉ thích uống nước sạch trong thác này. Nếu cẩn thận, nó có thể tránh được một cuộc chạm trán với Vua Water Slime. Nó có sức mạnh hơn cả Water Slime vì dòng lũ nó phun ra đủ để nhấn chìm ai đó ngay cả khi ở trên mặt đất .

id: Pendeta dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Kebanyakan dari kerajaan ini berhubungan dengan laut, jadi banyak yang memuja dewa laut, Salam. Dari usia muda, Merith sangat tergerak oleh ajaran itu. Dia bercita-cita menjadi pendeta dari usia muda, dan akhirnya berhasil pada usia 16. Pendeta dari Kerajaan Sama mendapat kekuatan penyembuh untuk melindungi orang, dan kebanyakan terbiasa dengan sihir air.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20040_DESCRIPTION
desc: A monk from the ruined Sama Kingdom. Much of the kingdom had contact with the sea, so many worshiped the sea god, Salam. From a young age, Merith was also deeply moved by those teachings. She endeavored to become a monk at an early age, formally becoming one at 16. The monks of the Sama Kingdom acquired healing powers to protect the people, and are most accustomed to water magic.

raw.en: A monk from the ruined Sama Kingdom. Much of the kingdom had contact with the sea, so many worshiped the sea god, Salam. From a young age, Merith was also deeply moved by those teachings. She endeavored to become a monk at an early age, formally becoming one at 16. The monks of the Sama Kingdom acquired healing powers to protect the people, and are most accustomed to water magic.
raw.es: Sacerdotisa del antiguo reino de Sama. Dada la cercanía del reino con el mar, muchos son los seguidores del dios marino Salam. Meri fue una de sus seguidoras más fervientes. Desde joven, quiso convertirse en sacerdotisa y llegó a cumplir su sueño a los 16 años. Las sacerdotisas del reino de Sama adquieren poderes curativos para proteger a su pueblo y son afines a la magia acuática.
raw.id: Pendeta dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Kebanyakan dari kerajaan ini berhubungan dengan laut, jadi banyak yang memuja dewa laut, Salam. Dari usia muda, Merith sangat tergerak oleh ajaran itu. Dia bercita-cita menjadi pendeta dari usia muda, dan akhirnya berhasil pada usia 16. Pendeta dari Kerajaan Sama mendapat kekuatan penyembuh untuk melindungi orang, dan kebanyakan terbiasa dengan sihir air.
raw.pt: Uma monja do Reino arruinado de Sama. Boa parte do reino tinha contato com o mar, então muitos veneravam o deus do mar Salam. Desde cedo, Merith foi comovida profundamente por estes ensinamentos. Ela esforçou-se para se tornar uma monja antes da idade, formalmente recebendo o título aos 16. Os monges do Reino de Sama adquiriam poderes para proteger as pessoas, e eram mais acostumados à magia aquática.
raw.th: พระจากราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย พื้นที่หลายส่วนของราชอาณาจักร์ติดอยู่กับทะเล จึงมีผู้บูชาเทพเจ้าแห่งทะเล "ซาลาม" เป็นจำนวนมากในวัยเยาว์ "เมอริธ" ประทับใจเทคนิคเหล่านั้นมาก เธอมีความแน่วแน่ที่จะเป็นมั้งนับตั้งแต่นั้นและก็ได้เป็นเมื่ออายุ 16 พระแห่งราชอาณาจักรซามะได้รับพลังแห่งการรักษาเพื่อปกป้องผู้คนและส่วนใหญ่จะคุ้นเคยกับเวทมนตร์น้ำ
raw.vi: Một tu sĩ tại vương quốc Sama tan rã . Nhiều vương quốc gắn liền với biển nên họ tôn thờ thần biển Salam . Từ khi còn nhỏ, Merith cũng vô cùng xúc động bởi những lời dạy đó. Cô cố gắng để trở thành nữ tu sĩ ở tuổi còn rất trẻ , đó là khi cô chính thức tròn 16 tuổi. Các tu sĩ của vương quốc Sama có khả năng chữa bệnh để bảo vệ người dân  và hầu hết họ thường sử dụng phép thuật nước .

id: Pendeta besar dari kuil dewa air, Salam, di Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Karena mengutamakan doktrin, dia dikritik habis-habisan, tapi dia tetap memegang prinsipnya. Selalu memperlakukan orang dengan adil tanpa melihat posisi mereka membuatnya memperoleh banyak dukungan. Dia sangat populer dan sihirnya kuat. Dia menyelamatkan banyak orang, kaya dan misin, dengan sihir penyembuhnya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20041_DESCRIPTION
desc: A great monk from the church of the water god, Salam, in the ruined Sama Kingdom. Putting dogma first led to harsh criticism, but she stuck steadfast to her principles. Always treating people fair regardless of their position led to many supporting her. She was popular and her magic was strong. She saved countless, rich and poor, with her healing magic.

raw.en: A great monk from the church of the water god, Salam, in the ruined Sama Kingdom. Putting dogma first led to harsh criticism, but she stuck steadfast to her principles. Always treating people fair regardless of their position led to many supporting her. She was popular and her magic was strong. She saved countless, rich and poor, with her healing magic.
raw.es: Gran sacerdotisa de la iglesia del dios marino Salam, en el antiguo reino de Sama. A pesar de las críticas, Meri siempre se mantuvo fiel a sus principios y trató a toda la gente por igual sin importar su estatus social. Esto hizo que ganara fama al tiempo que perfeccionaba sus dotes para salvar las vidas de miles de personas, ricos y pobres.
raw.id: Pendeta besar dari kuil dewa air, Salam, di Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Karena mengutamakan doktrin, dia dikritik habis-habisan, tapi dia tetap memegang prinsipnya. Selalu memperlakukan orang dengan adil tanpa melihat posisi mereka membuatnya memperoleh banyak dukungan. Dia sangat populer dan sihirnya kuat. Dia menyelamatkan banyak orang, kaya dan misin, dengan sihir penyembuhnya.
raw.pt: Uma grande monja da igreja do deus da água Salam, no Reino arruinado de Sama. Colocar o dogma como prioridade levou a duras críticas, mas ela se manteve fiel a seus princípios. Seu costume de sempre tratar pessoas de forma justa independentemente de posição levou muitos a mostrarem seu suporte a ela. Ela era popular e sua magia era forte. Ela salvou muitos, pobres e ricos, com sua magia de cura.
raw.th: พระผู้ยิ่งใหญ่จากโบสถ์ของเทพเจ้าน้ำซาลามในราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย  การปล่อยวางเรื่องความเชื่อในตอนแรกนำไปสู่การวิพากษ์วิจารญ์ที่รุนแรงแต่เธอก็ยังคงตั้งมั่นอยู่ในหลักการของเธอ การรักษาคนโดยไม่สนใจสถานะทางสังคมทำให้คนจำนวนมากสนับสนุนเธอ เธอมีชื่อเสียงโด่งดังและเวทมนตร์ของเธอก็แข็งแกร่ง เธอช่วยชีวิตคนมานับไม่ถ้วนไม่ว่ารวยหรือจนด้วยเวทรักษาของเธอ
raw.vi: Một nữ tu sĩ vĩ đại sống tại nhà thờ của thần nước , Salam , trong vương quốc Sama đã tan dã . Cô là người đầu tiên chỉ trích gay gắt các giáo điều nhưng lại bị mắc kẹt trong những nguyên tắc của mình. Việc cô luôn luôn đối xử với mọi người công bằng không phân biệt địa vị đã khiến cô được nhiều người ủng hộ. Cô được nhiều người biết đến với sức mạnh phép thuật. Cô đã cứu vô số người giàu và nghèo bằng phép thuật chữa bệnh của mình .

id: Biksu besar dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur pernah berdoa ke dewa air, Saram. Setelah perang dengan para dewa dimulai, dia gundah tentang apa yang harus dilakukannya karena dia dulu melayani mereka. Tapi akhirnya, dia maju ke medan perang dan menggunakan sihir penyembuhnya untuk menyelamatkan manusia. Tanpa berperang melawan para dewa, dia menyelamatkan manusia yang terluka. Mungkin hanya itu yang bisa dilakukannya untuk melawan para dewa.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20042_DESCRIPTION
desc: A great monk from the ruined Sama Kingdom that once prayed to the water god, Saram. After the war with the gods began, she was torn as to what she should do as she had previously served them. In the end, she went to the front lines and used her healing magic to save people. Without fighting against the gods, she saved the people who were hurt. That was probably as far as she could go in resisting the gods.

raw.en: A great monk from the ruined Sama Kingdom that once prayed to the water god, Saram. After the war with the gods began, she was torn as to what she should do as she had previously served them. In the end, she went to the front lines and used her healing magic to save people. Without fighting against the gods, she saved the people who were hurt. That was probably as far as she could go in resisting the gods.
raw.es: Gran sacerdotisa del antiguo imperio de Sama que antaño supo entregarse el dios marino Saram. Tras el comienzo de la guerra contra los dioses, Merith estaba indecisa, porque previamente había servido a las deidades. Después de mucho pensarlo, Merith corrió hacia el frente de la batalla y usó sus magias sanadoras para salvar gente. Sin pelear contra los dioses, salvó a muchos heridos. Es probable que eso fuera todo lo que Merith podía hacer para resistirse a los dioses.
raw.id: Biksu besar dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur pernah berdoa ke dewa air, Saram. Setelah perang dengan para dewa dimulai, dia gundah tentang apa yang harus dilakukannya karena dia dulu melayani mereka. Tapi akhirnya, dia maju ke medan perang dan menggunakan sihir penyembuhnya untuk menyelamatkan manusia. Tanpa berperang melawan para dewa, dia menyelamatkan manusia yang terluka. Mungkin hanya itu yang bisa dilakukannya untuk melawan para dewa.
raw.pt: Uma grande monge do Reino arruinado de Sama que outrora rezou ao deus da água, Saram. Após o início da guerra com os deuses, ela estava dividida sobre o que fazer, pois havia servido aos deuses antes. No final, ela foi às frentes de batalha e usou sua magia de cura para salvar pessoas. Sem lutar contra os deuses, ela salvou aqueles que estavam feridos. Foi provavelmente o máximo que ela poderia fazer contra os deuses.
raw.th: พระผู้ยิ่งใหญ่จากราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย ซึ่งครั้งหนึ่งเคยเคารพบูชาเทพน้ำซาลาม หลังจากที่สงครามกับเหล่าเทพเริ่มขึ้น เธอสับสนว่าควรทำเช่นไรเพราะว่าเธอเคยเป็นผู้รับใช้ของพวกนั้น ในท้ายที่สุด เธอไปร่วมการรบในแนวหน้าและใช้พลังรักษาของเธอเพื่อช่วยเหลือคน โดยไม่ได้ต่อสู้กับพวกเทพเจ้า เธอช่วยเหลือผู้คนที่บาดเจ็บ และนั่นคงเป็นสิ่งที่เธอทำได้มากที่สุดในการต่อต่านเหล่าเทพเจ้า
raw.vi: Một thầy tu đến từ Vương quốc Sama bị phá hủy đã từng cầu nguyên cho chúa nước Saram. Sau khi chiến tranh nổ ra, cô ta chiến đấu như những gì cô ta vẫn thường làm trước đây. Cuối cùng, cô ta đi dến những hàng trước và sử dụng phép thuật chữa lành của mình để cứu vớt mọi người. Không đánh lại chúa, cô ta cứu được những người bị thương. Đó có là những gì cô ta có thể làm khi chống lại chúa

id: Makhluk laut yang magis tinggal di lautan Gaia Besar. Mereka sering disebut dalam cerita manusia. Biasanya mereka tinggal di lautan atau di tepi pantai, tapi mereka bisa ditemukan di mana saja selama ada air, termasuk sungai dan danau. Orang cukup mudah bertemu dengan mereka. Mereka bergerak dalam grup dan sangat berbahanya ketika berburu monster yang lebih besar.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20050_DESCRIPTION
desc: A magical aquatic being that lives in the oceans of Grand Gaia. They are often found in the tales of humans. They usually live in the sea or on the shore, but they are found anywhere where there is water, including rivers and lakes. A human can easily run into one. They move in groups and are observed to be very dangerous when hunting larger beasts.

raw.en: A magical aquatic being that lives in the oceans of Grand Gaia. They are often found in the tales of humans. They usually live in the sea or on the shore, but they are found anywhere where there is water, including rivers and lakes. A human can easily run into one. They move in groups and are observed to be very dangerous when hunting larger beasts.
raw.es: Ser acuático que habita en los océanos de Gran Gaia y suele aparecer en muchísimos relatos. Suelen vivir en el mar o en la costa, aunque también en otros lugares con agua como ríos o lagos donde es fácil encontrarlos. Suelen moverse en grupos y son bastante peligrosos al unirse a otras bestias más fuertes.
raw.id: Makhluk laut yang magis tinggal di lautan Gaia Besar. Mereka sering disebut dalam cerita manusia. Biasanya mereka tinggal di lautan atau di tepi pantai, tapi mereka bisa ditemukan di mana saja selama ada air, termasuk sungai dan danau. Orang cukup mudah bertemu dengan mereka. Mereka bergerak dalam grup dan sangat berbahanya ketika berburu monster yang lebih besar.
raw.pt: Uma criatura aquática mágica que vive nos oceanos de Grand Gaia. Eles são encontrados com frequência nos contos dos humanos. Geralmente vivem no mar ou na costa, mas são encontrados em todo lugar onde houver água, incluindo rios e lagos. Um humano pode facilmente encontrar um. Eles se movem em grupos e pode ser observado o quão perigosos são quando eles caçam feras maiores.
raw.th: สัตว์น้ำเวทมนตร์ที่อาศัยอยู่ในมหาสมุทรของแกรนด์ไกอา มักจะกล่าวถึงกันบ่อยๆ ตามตำนานของมนุษย์ พวกมันมักอาศัยอยู่ในทะเลหรือริมฝั่ง แต่สามารถพบพวกมันได้ทั่วไปในที่ๆ มีน้ำ รวมถึง แม่น้ำและทะเลสาบ ซึ่งทำให้มนุษย์พบเจอมันได้ง่าย พวกมันเคลื่อนที่กันเป็นกลุ่มและจะอันตรายมากเมื่อร่วมกันล่าสัตว์ที่ใหญ่กว่า
raw.vi: Một con thủy quải có phép thuật sống trong các đại dương vùng Grand Gaia. Chúng thường xuất hiện trong những câu chuyện dân gian của con người. Chúng sống ở biển hoặc trên bờ, nhưng chúng được tìm thấy ở bất cứ nơi nào có nước bao gồm cả sông và hồ. Con người có thể dễ dàng bắt gặp chúng. Chúng di chuyển theo bầy, nhóm và được cho là vô cùng nguy hiểm khi chúng cùng nhau đi săn những con thú lớn hơn.

id: Ketika sihir air merman bangkit, dia berubah menjadi Sahuagin. Bentuknya sangat cocok untuk bergerak di dalam air. Bagian bawahnya berubah dari dua kaki menjadi sirip ikan. Lebih kejam dari merman, mereka sering menyerang kapal untuk mencari darah manusia. Katanya ada harta karun di tempat tinggal Sahuagin, tapi tidak ada petualang yang menyelam untuk mengecek yang pernah kembali.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20051_DESCRIPTION
desc: When a merman's inherent water magic awakens, it evolves into a Sahuagin. Its shape is perfect for moving in water. Its lower half changes from two legs into a tail fin. Crueler than mermen, they often attack ships looking for human blood. Rumor is that there is treasure where Sahuagins live, but none of the adventurers that dove down to check have ever returned.

raw.en: When a merman's inherent water magic awakens, it evolves into a Sahuagin. Its shape is perfect for moving in water. Its lower half changes from two legs into a tail fin. Crueler than mermen, they often attack ships looking for human blood. Rumor is that there is treasure where Sahuagins live, but none of the adventurers that dove down to check have ever returned.
raw.es: Cuando un tritón libera todo su poder, muta en un kraken. Con una fisionomía perfecta para nadar en el agua, este monstruo tiene aletas en lugar de piernas. Los krakens son crueles y suelen atacar barcos en busca de sangre humana. Dicen que en lo más profundo del océano ocultan un tesoro, pero todos los que han bajado en su búsqueda han desaparecido.
raw.id: Ketika sihir air merman bangkit, dia berubah menjadi Sahuagin. Bentuknya sangat cocok untuk bergerak di dalam air. Bagian bawahnya berubah dari dua kaki menjadi sirip ikan. Lebih kejam dari merman, mereka sering menyerang kapal untuk mencari darah manusia. Katanya ada harta karun di tempat tinggal Sahuagin, tapi tidak ada petualang yang menyelam untuk mengecek yang pernah kembali.
raw.pt: Quando a magia inerente de água em um Tritão é despertada, ele se torna um Sahuagin. Sua forma é perfeita para a movimentação na água. Sua metade inferior se transforma de um par de pernas para uma cauda com barbatanas. Mais cruéis do que os tritões, eles frequentemente atacam navios em busca de sangue humano. Dizem que existem tesouros onde os Sahuagins vivem, mas os aventureiros que mergulham para verificar jamais retornam.
raw.th: เมื่อเวทน้ำที่มนุษย์ปลาสืบทอดมาได้ตื่นขึ้น มันจะพัฒนาเป็นซาฮัวกิน มันมีร่างการที่เคลื่อนที่ในน้ำได้อย่างยอดเยี่ยม ท่อนล่างเปลี่ยนจากขาสองข้างเป็นหางปลาและดุร้ายมากกว่ามนุษย์ปลา พวกมันมักจะโจมตีเรือเพื่อหาเลือดของมนุษย์ ลือกันว่ามีสมบัติซ่อนอยู่ในที่อยู่อาศัยของพวกมันแต่ไม่เคยมีนักประดาน้ำคนไหนที่ดำไปสำรวจและได้กลับมาอีกเลย
raw.vi: Khi người cá với phép thuật nước vốn có của mình tỉnh giấc , nó sẽ biến thành Sahuagin. Hình dạng của nó rất hoàn hảo khi di chuyển trong nước. Hai chân ở nửa dưới thân nó biến đổi thành vẩy ở đuôi . Chúng ác độc hơn người cá và thường tấn công các tàu để tìm người để hút máu.  Người ta đồn rằng nơi Sahuagins sống có kho báu , nhưng trong số các nhà thám hiểm lặn xuống để kiểm tra sẽ chẳng bao giờ có ai trở về .

id: Sahuagin yang berevolusi, yang juga menyerang kapal untuk harta karunnya. Organisasi mereka lebih besar daripada beberapa kerajaan, dan katanya bahkan ada beberapa dia antara mereka yang mengerti bahasa manusia. Sepertinya mereka kadang muncul di kediaman manusia untuk menukar benda yang sulit ditemukan dengan harta karun. Manusia Kadal dikenal karena teknik perang grup mereka yang hebat, dan sepertinya beberapa lebih suka kemiliteran daripada harta karun.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20052_DESCRIPTION
desc: An evolved Sahuagin which, like them, attacks ships for their treasure. Their organization is larger than some kingdoms, and it's said there are even some among them who understand human languages. It seems they sometimes appear in human settlements looking to trade hard to find items for treasure. Lizard Men are known for their superior group battle techniques, and it seems some even favor militarization over treasure.

raw.en: An evolved Sahuagin which, like them, attacks ships for their treasure. Their organization is larger than some kingdoms, and it's said there are even some among them who understand human languages. It seems they sometimes appear in human settlements looking to trade hard to find items for treasure. Lizard Men are known for their superior group battle techniques, and it seems some even favor militarization over treasure.
raw.es: Tritón evolucionado que, al igual que ellos, ataca naves en busca de tesoros. Su organización es más grande que la de muchos reinados, y las historias cuentan que algunos de sus integrantes comprenden idiomas humanos. Aparentemente, suelen aparecer en pueblos humanos para intercambiar objetos difíciles de encontrar por tesoros. Los Hombres lagarto son famosos por sus majestuosas técnicas de batallas grupales. Además, se dice que algunos de ellos prefieren la militarización a los tesoros.
raw.id: Sahuagin yang berevolusi, yang juga menyerang kapal untuk harta karunnya. Organisasi mereka lebih besar daripada beberapa kerajaan, dan katanya bahkan ada beberapa dia antara mereka yang mengerti bahasa manusia. Sepertinya mereka kadang muncul di kediaman manusia untuk menukar benda yang sulit ditemukan dengan harta karun. Manusia Kadal dikenal karena teknik perang grup mereka yang hebat, dan sepertinya beberapa lebih suka kemiliteran daripada harta karun.
raw.pt: Uma bruxa Sahuagin evoluída, como elas, ataca navios pelos tesouros. Sua organização é maior que alguns reinos e dizem que algumas delas entendem até idiomas humanos. Parece que elas aparecem em áreas de humanos de vez em quando para tentar negociar itens raros por tesouro. Homens Lagarto são conhecidos por suas técnicas superiores de batalha em grupo e parece que alguns preferem a militarização do que tesouros.
raw.th: ซาฮัวจินที่วิวัฒนาการแล้ว แล้วก็ชอบโจมตีเรือเพื่อชิงสมบัติเหมือนกันAn องค์กรของพวกมันมีขนาดใหญ่กว่าราชอาณาจักรบางแห่งเสียอีก และว่ากันว่ามีพวกมันบางส่วนเข้าใจภาษามนุษย์อีกด้วย ดูเหมือนว่าพวกมันปรากฎตัวในแหล่งอาศัยของมนุษย์ในบางครั้งเพื่อแลกเปลี่ยนสิ่งของหายากกับสมบัติ ลิซาร์ดแมนเป็นที่รู้จักกันในเรื่องเทคนิคการต่อสู้เป็นกลุ่มที่สูงส่ง และดูเหมอนว่าพวกมันบางส่วนจะชอบสงครามมากกว่าสมบัติ
raw.vi: Một Sahuagin đã phát triển, giống như họ, tấn công những con tàu lấy kho báu. Tổ chức của họ lớn hơn một số vương quốc và người ta nói rằng thậm chí một số còn hiểu tiếng người. Có vẻ đôi khi họ xuất hiện trong các khu dân cư của con người tìm cách giao dịch tích cực để tìm đồ cho kho báu. Người thằn lằn được biết đến vì kỹ thuật chiến đấu theo nhóm siêu việt và dường như một số thậm chí còn ủng hộ quân sự hóa vấn đề kho báu.

id: Bajak laut pemula yang aktif di lautan sekitar Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Dari penampilan dan cara bicaranya yang santai, dia sering dianggap remeh oleh lawannya yang segera menyesailinya. Dengan gerakan tipuannya yang cepat dan serangan yang kuat, dia akan mengalahkan musuhnya dengan cepat. Pada masanya, kaptennya akan berkata, "Selama ada cecunguk, pasti ada anggur untuk diminum."
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20061_DESCRIPTION
desc: A novice pirate active in the seas near the ruined Sama Kingdom. From his relaxed appearance and speech, he was often made light of by enemies who would soon regret it. With deceivingly quick movements and a hearty strike, he would cut down opponents in a flash. In his day, his captain would always say, "As long as there be scum around, there be wine to drink."

raw.en: A novice pirate active in the seas near the ruined Sama Kingdom. From his relaxed appearance and speech, he was often made light of by enemies who would soon regret it. With deceivingly quick movements and a hearty strike, he would cut down opponents in a flash. In his day, his captain would always say, "As long as there be scum around, there be wine to drink."
raw.es: Aprendiz de pirata de los mares cercanos al antiguo reino de Sama. Bajo su aire bonachón, se oculta un poderoso guerrero al que no conviene subestimar. Sus rápidos y potentes ataques son capaces de derribar a sus enemigos en segundos. En su época, su capitán solía decirle: "Mientras haya escoria en este mundo, habrá ron que llevarse al gaznate".
raw.id: Bajak laut pemula yang aktif di lautan sekitar Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Dari penampilan dan cara bicaranya yang santai, dia sering dianggap remeh oleh lawannya yang segera menyesailinya. Dengan gerakan tipuannya yang cepat dan serangan yang kuat, dia akan mengalahkan musuhnya dengan cepat. Pada masanya, kaptennya akan berkata, "Selama ada cecunguk, pasti ada anggur untuk diminum."
raw.pt: Um pirata novato que age nos mares próximos ao Reino arruinado de Sama. Por causa de sua aparência relaxada e fala mansa, seus inimigos não o levavam a sério mas logo se arrependiam. Com movimentos enganosamente rápidos e um ataque poderoso, ele abatia inimigos num piscar de olhos. Em seus dias, o capitão sempre dizia “Enquanto houver escória por aí, vai ter vinho pra beber.”
raw.th: โจรสลัดมือใหม่ที่ปล้นอยู่ในทะเลใกล้ราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย จากท่าทางและคำพูดที่ดูผ่อนคลาย เขามักจะถูกปรามาศโดยพวกศัตรูที่มักจะต้องเสียใจในภายหลัง ด้วยการเคลื่อนที่หลอกอย่างรวดเร็วและโจมตีอย่างรุนแรง เขาสามารถตัดศัตรูออกเป็นเสี่ยงๆ ในช่วงนั้นกัปตันของเขามักจะพูดเสมอว่า "ตราบใดที่ยังมีพวกสวะอยู่ มันก็จะยังมีไวน์ให้ดื่ม"
raw.vi: Cướp biển mới hoạt động ở các vùng biển gần vương quốc Sama. Bằng giọng nói tự tin và sự xuất hiện thoải mái của mình, hắn xem thường kẻ thù - những người sẽ sớm hối tiếc về điều này. Với những chuyển động đánh lừa nhanh chóng và đòn tấn công táo bạo, hắn sẽ hạ gục đối thủ trong nháy mắt. Trong ngày đó , đội trưởng của hắn sẽ luôn luôn nói: " Ở đâu chỉ cần có bọt  xung quanh, ở đó sẽ có rượu để uống. "

id: Kapten bajak laut  yang aktif di lautan sekitar Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Badannya yang besar dan janggutnya yang tampan membuat orang yang melihatnya terpana. Dia bicara lebih lembut dari tampangnya, dan catatan navigasinya menyatakan dia mempertahankan kapal yang damai. Tapi, dia menjadi setan dalam perang. Dia sangat kuat sehingga angkatan laut akan lari kalau melihat benderanya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20062_DESCRIPTION
desc: A pirate captain active in the seas near the ruined Sama Kingdom. His huge body and handsome beard awed those who stood before him. He spoke much softer than he looked, and his navigation log states that he maintained a peaceful ship. However, he was a demon in battle. He was so strong that whole navies would flee when they saw his flag.

raw.en: A pirate captain active in the seas near the ruined Sama Kingdom. His huge body and handsome beard awed those who stood before him. He spoke much softer than he looked, and his navigation log states that he maintained a peaceful ship. However, he was a demon in battle. He was so strong that whole navies would flee when they saw his flag.
raw.es: Capitán pirata de los mares cercanos al antiguo reino de Sama. Su enorme cuerpo y lustrosa barba son la envidia de su banda. Su habla es sorprendentemente dulce y sus cuadernos de bitácora sugieren que prefiere evitar conflictos. No obstante, su furia en combate era de lo más temida, y muchos navíos huían con solo ver su bandera.
raw.id: Kapten bajak laut  yang aktif di lautan sekitar Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Badannya yang besar dan janggutnya yang tampan membuat orang yang melihatnya terpana. Dia bicara lebih lembut dari tampangnya, dan catatan navigasinya menyatakan dia mempertahankan kapal yang damai. Tapi, dia menjadi setan dalam perang. Dia sangat kuat sehingga angkatan laut akan lari kalau melihat benderanya.
raw.pt: Um capitão pirata ativo nos mares perto do Reino arruinado de Sama. Seu corpo gigantesco e bela barba intimidavam os que ficama perante ele. Sua fala era muito mais mansa do que sua aparência, e seus registros de navegação mostravam que ele comandava um navio pacífico. Entretanto, ele era um demônio em batalha. Ele era tão forte que armadas inteiras fugiam ao ver sua bandeira.
raw.th: กัปตันโจรสลัดที่ปล้นอยู่ในทะเลใกล้ราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย ร่างที่ใหญ่โตและเคราหล่อเหลาทำให้คนที่ประจันหน้าเขาต้องหวาดกลัว เขาพูดจานุ่มนวลกว่าหน้าตาของเขาและบันทึกการเดินเรือของเขาบันทึกไว้ว่าเขาทำให้เรือมีสันติสุข อย่างไรก็ดี เขาคือปีศาจในการรบ เขาแข็งแกร่งถึงขนาดทัพเรือยังต้องหนีเมื่อเห็นธงเรือของเขา
raw.vi: Cướp biển hoạt động ở các vùng biển gần Vương quốc Sama. Cơ thể khổng lồ và bộ râu đẹp của hắn làm những người đứng trước mặt cảm thấy sợ hãi. Tuy nhiên hắn nói chuyện nhẹ nhàng hơn nhiều so với thân hình khổng lồ, và  hắn xác định sẽ duy trì một con tàu hòa bình. Tuy nhiên, hắn là một con quỷ trong trận chiến. Hắn mạnh đến nỗi toàn bộ lực lượng hải quân sẽ bỏ chạy khi nhìn thấy lá ​​cờ của hắn .

id: Komandan bajak laut yang memimpin gerombolan bajak laut di daerah sekitar Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Meskipun dia hidup bebas sebagian besar dari hidupnya, ketika dia mulai merawat Mega, bocah yang nantinya akan dikenal sebagai si Komandan, dia mulai mengumpulkan bajak laut dari berbagai daerah. Memimpin hampir semua bajak laut di sekitarnya, Verica dikenal sebagai Pangeran Laut. Tapi, dia sepertinya lebih terfokus pada perkembangan anak itu.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20063_DESCRIPTION
desc: A pirate commander that led a group of pirates in the seas near the ruined Sama Kingdom. Though he lived much of his life carefree and without aim, once he started caring for Mega, the boy who would come to be known as the Commander, he began gathering pirates from all around. Taking lead over most of the other pirates around him, Verica came to be known as the Sea Prince. However, he seemed much more focused on the development of the child Mega.

raw.en: A pirate commander that led a group of pirates in the seas near the ruined Sama Kingdom. Though he lived much of his life carefree and without aim, once he started caring for Mega, the boy who would come to be known as the Commander, he began gathering pirates from all around. Taking lead over most of the other pirates around him, Verica came to be known as the Sea Prince. However, he seemed much more focused on the development of the child Mega.
raw.es: Comandante que guió a un grupo de piratas a través de los mares cercanos al reino perdido de Sama. A pesar de que vivió gran parte de su vida sin problemas y sin objetivos, cuando empezó a interesarse por Mega, el joven que luego se convertiría en Comandante, Verica comenzó a reclutar piratas de todas partes. Al alzarse por sobre la mayoría de los demás piratas, Verica comenzó a ser llamado el Príncipe marítimo. Sin embargo, lo que a él más le interesaba era el desarrollo del joven Mega.
raw.id: Komandan bajak laut yang memimpin gerombolan bajak laut di daerah sekitar Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Meskipun dia hidup bebas sebagian besar dari hidupnya, ketika dia mulai merawat Mega, bocah yang nantinya akan dikenal sebagai si Komandan, dia mulai mengumpulkan bajak laut dari berbagai daerah. Memimpin hampir semua bajak laut di sekitarnya, Verica dikenal sebagai Pangeran Laut. Tapi, dia sepertinya lebih terfokus pada perkembangan anak itu.
raw.pt: Um comandante pirata que liderou um grupo de bucaneiros nos mares próximos ao Reino arruinado de Sama. Apesar de viver a maior parte de sua vida despreocupado e sem objetivo, uma vez que começou a cuidar de Mega, o garoto que viria a ser conhecido como Comandante, ele começou a reunir piratas de todas as partes. Tomando a liderança da maioria dos piratas a seu redor, Verica seria conhecido como Príncipe do Mar. Porém, ele parecia muito mais preocupado no desenvolvimento do pequeno Mega.
raw.th: ผู้บัญชาการโจนสลัดที่เป็นผู้นำกลุ่มโจรสลัดในทะเลใกล้ราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย แม้ว่าเขาจะใช้ชีวิตส่วนใหญ่อย่างอิสระไร้เป้าหมาย แต่เมื่อเขาได้เริ่มมีความห่วงใยให้กับ "เมก้า" เด็กน้อยที่จะเป็นทีรู้จักกันในฐานะผู้บัญชาการ เขาเริ่มที่จะรวบรวมโจรสลัดทั้งหมด และกลายเป็นผู้นำเหนือเหล่าโจรสลัดทั้งหลายในแถบนั้น เวริก้ากลายเป็นที่รู้จักกันในนาม เจ้าชายแห่งท้องทะเล อย่างไรก็ดี ดูเหมือนว่าเขาจะสนใจในการพัฒนาตัวเองของเด็กชายเมก้าเสียมากกว่า
raw.vi: Một chỉ huy hải tắc đã cầm đầu một nhóm hải tặc ở các khu biển gần Vương quốc Sama bị tàn phá. Mặc dù anh ta đã sống được phần lớn cuộc đời với sự tự do tự tại và không phải phiền lòng, nhưng một khi anh ta bắt đầu chăm sóc cho Mega, cậu con trai mà sau này sẽ được làm thủ lĩnh, anh ta bắt đầu tập hợp những tên hải tắc từ xung quanh. Đứng đầu chỉ huy hầu hết các hải tặc xung quanh anh ta, Verica được biết là Hoàng tử biển. Tuy vậy, anh ta dường như tập trung rất nhiều vào sự phát triển của con mình là Mega

id: Makhluk magis yang setengah wanita setengah ular. Katanya badan mereka menarik untuk lelaki yang tersesat di laut. Ketika seorang lelaki mendekat, ekor ular mereka menangkapnya dan menyeret mereka ke dasar laut. Lelaki yang tertangkap katanya menjadi makanan atau budak Ramia, tapi karena tidak ada yang pernah kembali, tidak jelas kebenarannya. Mereka berbahaya, tapi banyak yang ingin bertemu mereka sekali saja.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20071_DESCRIPTION
desc: Magic beings that are half woman, half snake. It is rumored their bodies attract men lost at sea. When a man gets close, their snake tail grabs them and drags them to the ocean floor. Captured men are said to become Ramia's food or slaves, but since none have ever returned, it's unclear which is true. They are dangerous, but many men still wish to see one just once.

raw.en: Magic beings that are half woman, half snake. It is rumored their bodies attract men lost at sea. When a man gets close, their snake tail grabs them and drags them to the ocean floor. Captured men are said to become Ramia's food or slaves, but since none have ever returned, it's unclear which is true. They are dangerous, but many men still wish to see one just once.
raw.es: Seres mágicos mitad mujeres, mitad serpientes. Se dice que sus cuerpos atraían a los náufragos. Cuando un hombre se acerca a ellas, su cola de serpiente los agarra y los lleva a la profundidad del mar. No se sabe bien si sus prisioneros son devorados o esclavizados. A pesar de esto, muchos hombres ansían ver una.
raw.id: Makhluk magis yang setengah wanita setengah ular. Katanya badan mereka menarik untuk lelaki yang tersesat di laut. Ketika seorang lelaki mendekat, ekor ular mereka menangkapnya dan menyeret mereka ke dasar laut. Lelaki yang tertangkap katanya menjadi makanan atau budak Ramia, tapi karena tidak ada yang pernah kembali, tidak jelas kebenarannya. Mereka berbahaya, tapi banyak yang ingin bertemu mereka sekali saja.
raw.pt: Seres mágicos metade mulher, metade serpente. Dizem que seus corpos atraem homens que se perdem no mar. Quando um homem se aproxima, sua cauda de serpente os agarra e arrasta para o fundo do mar. Dizem que os homens capturados se tornam comida ou escravos, mas como ninguém volta, não se sabe qual é a verdade. Eles são perigosas, mas muitos homens ainda desejam ver uma ao menos uma vez.
raw.th: สิ่งมีชีวิตเวทมนตร์ครึ่งหญิงครึ่งงู ลือกันว่าร่างของพวกมันดึงดูดใจผู้ชายที่หลงในทะเล เมื่อผู้ชายเข้าใกล้มันจะใช้หางงูพันเขาเอาไว้และลากลงทะเล ว่ากันว่าผู้ชายที่ถูกจับจะถูก "ราเมีย" เอาไปเป็นทาสไม่ก็เหยื่อ แต่เพราะยังไม่เคยมีใครรอดกลับมายืนยันเรื่องนี้จึงยังไม่ได้รับการพิสูจน์ว่าจริงหรือไม่ พวกมันมีความน่ากลัวมากแต่ก็ยังมีผู้ชายที่หมายจะได้พบตัวเป็นๆสักครั้ง
raw.vi: Những sinh vật nửa người nửa rắn có phép thuật. Người ta đồn rằng thân hình của chúng thu hút đàn ông và họ dần mất tích trên biển . Khi một người đàn ông đến gần, đuôi rắn của chúng tóm lấy và kéo họ xuống đáy đại dương. Người đàn ông bị bắt giữ sẽ trở thành thực phẩm hoặc nô lệ của Ramia , nhưng vì chưa bao giờ có ai quay trở lại nên không thể chắc chắn điều đó là sự thật . Chúng tuy nguy hiểm nhưng nhiều người đàn ông vẫn ước muốn đượcnhìn thấy chúng dù chỉ một lần.

id: Makhluk magis dari legenda pelayar yang bagian atasnya wanita cantik dan bawahnya beberapa ular. Lebih kuat dari Ramia, pelaut sering bercerita bagaimana kapal yang disiapkan untuk membunuh mereka langsung tenggelam begitu berlayar. Ada cerita yang berkata dia dikutuk oleh penyihir laut karena dendam.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20072_DESCRIPTION
desc: A magical being from legends of sailors whose top half is a beautiful woman and bottom half is multiple snakes.More powerful Ramia, sailors often tell stories of how ships prepped to exterminate them were sunk as soon as they set sail. There is a tale that says she was a queen cursed by a sea witch due to a grudge.

raw.en: A magical being from legends of sailors whose top half is a beautiful woman and bottom half is multiple snakes.More powerful Ramia, sailors often tell stories of how ships prepped to exterminate them were sunk as soon as they set sail. There is a tale that says she was a queen cursed by a sea witch due to a grudge.
raw.es: Ser mágico que aparece en leyendas de marinos, con el torso y cara de una hermosa mujer, y serpientes en lugar de piernas. Es más poderosa que Ramia y se dice que todo barco que se ha propuesto darle caza ha acabado hundido en cuestión de segundos. Cuentan que fue una reina a la que una bruja marina maldijo por celos.
raw.id: Makhluk magis dari legenda pelayar yang bagian atasnya wanita cantik dan bawahnya beberapa ular. Lebih kuat dari Ramia, pelaut sering bercerita bagaimana kapal yang disiapkan untuk membunuh mereka langsung tenggelam begitu berlayar. Ada cerita yang berkata dia dikutuk oleh penyihir laut karena dendam.
raw.pt: Uma criatura mágica das lendas de marujos, com o torso de uma linda mulher e múltiplas serpentes no lugar das pernas. Mais poderosa do que a Lâmia, marujos costumam contar histórias de como navios preparados para exterminá-las afundavam assim que partiam. Existe uma história de que ela foi uma rainha amaldiçoada por uma bruxa do mar devido a uma rixa entre as duas.
raw.th: สิ่งมีชีวิตเวทมนตร์จากในตำนานของกลาสี ซึ่งมีร่างกายท่อนบนเป็นสาวงามแต่ท่อนล่างเป็นงูหลายตัว แข็งแกร่งกว่าราเมีย กลาสีมักจะเล่าเรื่องราวของเรือที่เตรียมตัวจะออกไปไล่ล่ากำจัดพวกมันแต่ก็ถูกจมโดยทันทีทีออกเรือ มีเรื่องเล่าว่าเธอคือราชินีที่ถูกทะเล สาปเอาไว้ด้วยความแค้น
raw.vi: Một sinh vật kì diệu trong truyền thuyết của các thủy thủ có nửa đầu là một phụ nữ xinh đẹp và nửa dưới là những con rắn. Nó mạnh hơn cả Ramia , những thủy thủ thường kể những câu chuyện về con tàu họ đã chuẩn bị để tiêu diệt chúng bị chìm như thế nào ngay sau khi họ ra khơi. Có câu chuyện kể rằng đó là một nữ hoàng bị nguyền rủa bởi một phù thủy ở biển do hận thù.

id: Setan dengan bagian atas badannya seperti dewi yang cantik, dan bagian bawah badannya dari beberapa ular laut. Disebut sebagai "Ratu dari Setan Laut", dia memanggil banyak setan untuk melakukan keinginannya dengan lagu yang menghanyutkan dari kedalaman laut. Tapi, tidak ada yang pernah kembali ke daratan setelah diserang oleh ratu ular laut ini, jadi kebenarannya masih merupakan misteri. Banyak cerita yang mengatakan bahwa seorang penyihir menjadi gila karena Raja Laut tidak membalas cintanya, dan katanya itu adalah identitas asli Lotan.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20073_DESCRIPTION
desc: A demon with the upper body of a beautiful goddess, and a lower body composed of multiple sea serpents. Referred to as the "Queen of the Sea Demons," she calls legions of demons to do her bidding by singing an alluring song from the bottom of the ocean. However, no one has returned to land from an attack by this sea serpent queen, so the truth is still shrouded in mystery. Some stories tell of a witch who went mad after the Sea God did not return her affections, and it is believed that this is the true identity of Lotan.

raw.en: A demon with the upper body of a beautiful goddess, and a lower body composed of multiple sea serpents. Referred to as the "Queen of the Sea Demons," she calls legions of demons to do her bidding by singing an alluring song from the bottom of the ocean. However, no one has returned to land from an attack by this sea serpent queen, so the truth is still shrouded in mystery. Some stories tell of a witch who went mad after the Sea God did not return her affections, and it is believed that this is the true identity of Lotan.
raw.es: Este demonio tiene el cuerpo dividido: la parte superior es de una diosa, la parte inferior es un mar de serpientes. Conocida como la "Reina de los demonios marinos", esta diosa invoca legiones demoníacas para que cumplan sus deseos mediante canciones seductoras desde el fondo del océano. Sin embargo, nadie ha regresado a tierra luego de un ataque de la reina de las serpientes marinas, así que la verdad es un completo misterio. Hay historias que hablan de una bruja que enloqueció cuando su amor no fue correspondido por el Dios marino. Se cree que esa es la verdadera identidad de Lotan.
raw.id: Setan dengan bagian atas badannya seperti dewi yang cantik, dan bagian bawah badannya dari beberapa ular laut. Disebut sebagai "Ratu dari Setan Laut", dia memanggil banyak setan untuk melakukan keinginannya dengan lagu yang menghanyutkan dari kedalaman laut. Tapi, tidak ada yang pernah kembali ke daratan setelah diserang oleh ratu ular laut ini, jadi kebenarannya masih merupakan misteri. Banyak cerita yang mengatakan bahwa seorang penyihir menjadi gila karena Raja Laut tidak membalas cintanya, dan katanya itu adalah identitas asli Lotan.
raw.pt: Um demônio com a parte superior do corpo de uma linda deusa e a parte inferior composta de várias serpentes marinhas. Chamada de “Rainha dos Demônios Marinhos”, ela invoca legiões de demônios para fazer suas vontades cantando uma canção atraente do fundo do oceano. No entanto, ninguém voltou à terra depois de um ataque desta rainha serpente marinha, então a verdade ainda está envolta em mistério. Algumas histórias falam de uma bruxa que enlouqueceu depois que o Deus do Mar não retribuiu sua afeição, e acreditam que essa é a verdadeira identidade de Lotan.
raw.th: สัตว์ประหลาดที่มีครึ่งบนเป็นหญิงสาวที่สวยงามแต่ครึ่งล่างเป็นงูทะเลหลายตัวรวมกัน ถูกเรียกกันว่า "ราชินีปีศาจแห่งท้องทะเล" เธอสามารถเรียกปีศาจจำนวนมากมายมาเพื่อทำงานให้เธอโดยการร้องเพลงมาจากใต้ทะเลลึก อย่างไรก็ตามไม่มีใครรอดออกมาจากการเผชิญหน้ากับเธอ ฉะนั้นสิ่งที่พูดต่อๆ กันมานี้ยังคงเป็นปริศนา บางเรื่องราวกล่าวไว้ว่า บางคนถึงกับเป็นบ้าถ้าราชินีปีศาจแห่งท้องทะเลไม่ตอบรับการจีบ และเชื่อว่านี้คือตัวตนที่แท้จริงของโลทาน
raw.vi: Một con quỷ với phần trên cơ thể là một vị nữ thần xinh đẹp, còn phần dưới lại toàn lũ rắn biển. Được gọi là "Nữ hoàng Thủy Quái", ả gọi đến đội quân quỷ dữ theo lệnh mình bằng cách cất lên một bài hát lôi cuốn từ dưới đáy đại dương. Tuy nhiên, chẳng ai trở lại mặt đất sau cuộc tấn công của hải xà nữ hoàng này, bởi thế sự thật vẫn còn đầy bí ẩn. Vài câu chuyện kể về một nữ phù thủy phát điên sau khi Hải Thần không đáp lại tình cảm của mình, và người ta tin rằng đây là danh tính thực sự của Lotan.

id: Monster laut dalam yang besar dengan sepuluh tentakel. Katanya adalah jelmaan dewa laut, yang bertujuan menghukum mereka yang mengotori laut. Meskipun dikatan menyerang dan menghancurkan kapal, kadang-kadang dia menunjukkan sisi dewanya dengan membersihkan laut. Kapal-kapal selalu menyiapkan sesaji untuk mengurangi kemarahan Rantoul.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20081_DESCRIPTION
desc: A giant, deep-sea beast with ten tentacles. It's said to be the sea god incarnate, manifested to punish polluters of the sea. Though said to attack and destroy ships, it would also occasionally show it's god-like side by clensing the seas. Either way, ships always have offerings ready to ease Rantoul's wrath.

raw.en: A giant, deep-sea beast with ten tentacles. It's said to be the sea god incarnate, manifested to punish polluters of the sea. Though said to attack and destroy ships, it would also occasionally show it's god-like side by clensing the seas. Either way, ships always have offerings ready to ease Rantoul's wrath.
raw.es: Enorme bestia marina con diez tentáculos. Dicen que es la encarnación de un dios marino que se manifiesta para vengarse de los que contaminan el mar. Cuando no está destruyendo barcos, se ocupa de limpiar el mar. Muchos marineros suelen preparar ofrendas para apaciguar su furia.
raw.id: Monster laut dalam yang besar dengan sepuluh tentakel. Katanya adalah jelmaan dewa laut, yang bertujuan menghukum mereka yang mengotori laut. Meskipun dikatan menyerang dan menghancurkan kapal, kadang-kadang dia menunjukkan sisi dewanya dengan membersihkan laut. Kapal-kapal selalu menyiapkan sesaji untuk mengurangi kemarahan Rantoul.
raw.pt: Uma besta marítima gigante com dez tentáculos. Dizem que ela é a encarnação de um deus do mar, manifestando-se para punir os que poluem o oceano. Apesar dos boatos de atacar e destruir navios, a criatura também mostra seu lado divino limpando os mares. De qualquer maneira, navios sempre têm oferendas à mão para apaziguar a ira de Rantoul.
raw.th: ยักษ์ใหญ่แห่งท้องทะเลที่มีหนวดปลาหมึกสิบเส้น ว่ากันว่ามันคือร่างอวตาลของเทพเจ้าจุติมาเพื่อลงโทษมนุษย์ที่ทำลายท้องทะเล แม้จะมีการพูดถึงว่ามันโจมตีและทำลายเรือ แต่บางครั้งพวกมันก็แสดงอำนาจเทพด้วยการทำให้ท้องทะเลบริสุทธิ์ อย่างไรก็ดี เรือมักจะมีเครื่องบรรณาการเพื่อลดความพิโรธของ "แรนโทล"
raw.vi: Một con quái vật khổng lồ dưới biển sâu với mười chiếc xúc tu . Người ta cho rằng nó là hiện thân của thần biển để trừng phạt những ai gây ô nhiễm biển. Mặc dù nhiều người nói nó thường tấn công và tiêu diệt các tàu nhưng thỉnh thoảng nó giống như vị thần canh giữ biển. Dù bằng cách nào , những con tàu luôn luôn sẵn sàng để làm dịu đi cơn thịnh nộ của Rantoul.

id: Spesies drake laut yang tinggal lautan Gaia Besar. Ada beberapa daerah yang memujanya karena bentuknya yang besar. Seperti Rantoul, katanya merupakan penjelmaan dewa laut yang kuat. Katanya bertanggung jawab untuk menjaga lautan tetap bersih. Kekuatannya jauh di atas Rantoul, dan pengelana laut selalu memberinya sesaji sebelum berlayar.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20082_DESCRIPTION
desc: A species of water drake that lives in Grand Gaia's oceans. There are some regions that worship it due to its huge form. Like Rantoul, it is said to be an incarnation of a powerful sea god. It's said to be responsible for keeping the oceans clean. Its powers are much greater than Rantoul's, and sea voyagers always make offerings to it before setting sail.

raw.en: A species of water drake that lives in Grand Gaia's oceans. There are some regions that worship it due to its huge form. Like Rantoul, it is said to be an incarnation of a powerful sea god. It's said to be responsible for keeping the oceans clean. Its powers are much greater than Rantoul's, and sea voyagers always make offerings to it before setting sail.
raw.es: Dragón marino que vive en los océanos de Gran Gaia. Algunas regiones lo adoran por su gran tamaño. Al igual que Tentul, es la encarnación de un dios marino responsable de mantener las aguas limpias. Su poder es mucho mayor que el de este último y los marineros suelen hacerle ofrendas antes de hacerse a la mar.
raw.id: Spesies drake laut yang tinggal lautan Gaia Besar. Ada beberapa daerah yang memujanya karena bentuknya yang besar. Seperti Rantoul, katanya merupakan penjelmaan dewa laut yang kuat. Katanya bertanggung jawab untuk menjaga lautan tetap bersih. Kekuatannya jauh di atas Rantoul, dan pengelana laut selalu memberinya sesaji sebelum berlayar.
raw.pt: Uma espécie de dragão aquático que vive nos oceanos de Grand Gaia. Em algumas regiões ele é venerado por sua forma gigantesca. Como Rantoul, dizem que é a encarnação de um poderoso deus do mar. Dizem que ele é responsável por manter a limpeza dos oceanos. Seus poderes são muito maiores do que os de Rantoul, e os viajantes do mar sempre fazem oferendas a ele antes de zarpar.
raw.th: สายพันธุ์ของมังกรน้ำที่อาศัยอยู่ในมหาสมุทรของแกรนด์ไกอา มีบางพื้นบูชามันเพราะขนาดที่มหึมา เช่นเดียวกัน แรนโทล ว่ากันว่ามันคือร่างอวตาลของเทพเจ้าทะเลผู้ทรงพลังเพื่อคอยทำให้ท้องทะเลสะอาด มันมีพลังมากมายมหาศาลยิ่งการแรนโทลและชาวเลมักจะมีเครื่องบรรณาการมอบให้มันก่อนจะออกเดินทาง
raw.vi: Một loài vịt nước sống trong các đại dương vùng Grand Gaia. Có một số vùng tôn thờ do hình dạng khổng lồ của nó . Giống như Rantoul, nó được coi là hóa thân của một vị thần biển đầy sức mạnh. Nó chịu trách nhiệm canh giữ sự trong sạch của các đại dương sạch. Nó mạnh hơn nhiều so Rantoul , và các nhà thám hiểm biển luôn lập bàn cúng cho nó trước khi ra khơi .

id: Naga air yang katanya muncul untuk membersihkan laut setelah polusi. Air bersih yang mengalir dari badannya punya kekuatan menyembuhkan semua penyakit. Setiap muncul, badannya melemah dan hidupnya lebih pendek. Teori utama adalah karena racun yang terkumpul di tubuhnya. Teori lain itu karena ia terus bertarung melawan sumber polusi laut.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20083_DESCRIPTION
desc: A water dragon that is said to have appeared only to cleanse the sea after it had been polluted. The clean water that poured from its body was said to have the power to heal all kinds of sicknesses. However, with every appearance it made its body grew weak and its life short. The main theory is that this was due to the toxins that had built up in its body, though others say it was because of its continuous fighting against the source of the sea pollution.

raw.en: A water dragon that is said to have appeared only to cleanse the sea after it had been polluted. The clean water that poured from its body was said to have the power to heal all kinds of sicknesses. However, with every appearance it made its body grew weak and its life short. The main theory is that this was due to the toxins that had built up in its body, though others say it was because of its continuous fighting against the source of the sea pollution.
raw.es: Dragón acuático que se cree apareció solo para limpiar el mar contaminado. Se dice que el agua pura que emana de su cuerpo tiene el poder de curar cualquier clase de enfermedad. Sin embargo, con cada aparición, su cuerpo se debilitaba y su vida se acortaba. La teoría principal apunta a que esto era debido a las toxinas que había creado en su cuerpo, a pesar de que otros dicen que se debe a su continua batalla contra la fuente de la contaminación del mar.
raw.id: Naga air yang katanya muncul untuk membersihkan laut setelah polusi. Air bersih yang mengalir dari badannya punya kekuatan menyembuhkan semua penyakit. Setiap muncul, badannya melemah dan hidupnya lebih pendek. Teori utama adalah karena racun yang terkumpul di tubuhnya. Teori lain itu karena ia terus bertarung melawan sumber polusi laut.
raw.pt: Um dragão marinho que supostamente apareceu somente para limpar o mar que fora poluído. Dizem que a água limpa que escorria de seu corpo tem o poder de curar toda sorte de doenças. Porém, a cada aparição, seu corpo enfraquecia e sua vida encurtava. A principal teoria é que isso se devia às toxinas acumuladas em seu corpo, embora outros dizem que a causa era sua luta contínua contra a fonte da poluição do mar.
raw.th: มังกรน้ำที่ว่ากันว่าจะปรากฎตัวมาเพื่อชำระล้างท้องทะเลหลังจากที่ถูกทำให้ปนเปื้อนเท่านั้น กล่าวกันอีกว่าน้ำสะอาดที่ไหลออกมาจากตัวมันมีอำนาจที่จะรักษาความเจ็บป่วยได้ทุกชนิด อย่างไรก็ตาม การปรากฎตัวในแต่ละครั้งจะทำให้ร่างกายของมันอ่อนแอและอายุสั้นลงด้วย ทฤษฎีหลักก็คือสารพิษที่ได้สะสมเพิ่มขึ้นในตัวมัน กระนั้นก็มีทฤษฎีอื่นกล่าวว่าเป็นเพราะมันยังคงต่อสู้กับต้นตอที่สร้างมลภาวะให้กับทะเลไปเรื่อยๆ
raw.vi: Một con rồng nước được cho rằng chỉ xuất hiện để làm sạch biển sau khi biển bị ô nhiễm. Người ta nói rằng nước sạch chảy ra từ cơ thể nó có sức mạnh chữa khỏi mọi loại bệnh tật. Tuy nhiên, mỗi lần xuất hiện sẽ khiến cơ thể nó yếu hơn và tuổi thọ của nó giảm đi. Giả thuyết chính cho rằng đó là do chất độc tích tụ trong cơ thể nó, mặc dù những người khác nói đó là do việc sự chiến đấu liên tục của nó chống lại nguồn gây ô nhiễm biển.

id: Roh air cantik dan berpangkat tinggi yang tinggal di danau. Roh yang lahir untuk mempertahankan danaunya sendiri, dia tidak mau berpindah dari danau di mana dia dilahirkan. Tapi, kalau dia jatuh cinta, dia mungkin meninggalkan danaunya dan bersumpah untuk pergi bersama kekasihnya. Dia sangat bersemangat dan juga lembut, tapi karena penampakannya tiba-tiba berubah kalau dikhianati, lelaki takut bertemu dengannya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20092_DESCRIPTION
desc: A beautiful, high-ranked water spirit that lives in lakes. A spirit born to defend her own lake, she won't move from the lake she's born in. However, if she falls in love, she may leave her lake and pledge to go with her lover. She has a fiery and loving personality, but since her appearance suddenly changes when betrayed, men fear meeting with her.

raw.en: A beautiful, high-ranked water spirit that lives in lakes. A spirit born to defend her own lake, she won't move from the lake she's born in. However, if she falls in love, she may leave her lake and pledge to go with her lover. She has a fiery and loving personality, but since her appearance suddenly changes when betrayed, men fear meeting with her.
raw.es: Espíritu acuático de gran belleza y poder que vive en lagos. Su misión es proteger las aguas en las que habita y de las que nunca sale a menos que se enamore de alguien que vea de paso. Suele ser dulce y encantadora, aunque su apariencia cambia completamente cuando se siente engañada. Muchos hombres temen encontrarse con ella.
