Dia sangat bersemangat dan juga lembut, tapi karena penampakannya tiba-tiba berubah kalau dikhianati, lelaki takut bertemu dengannya.
raw.pt: Um belo espírito da água de alto escalão, que vive em lagos. Ela nasce com o intuito de defender o lago onde nasce, e não sairá de lá. Porém, caso se apaixone, ela pode deixar seu lar na promessa de acompanhar seu amante. Ela tem uma personalidade amável e impetuosa, mas como sua aparência muda de súbito quando traída, os homens temem encontrá-la.
raw.th: จิตวิญญาณแห่งน้ำระดับสูงที่สวยงามอาศัยอยู่ในทะเลสาบ วิญญาณนี้เกิดขึ้นมาเพื่อพิทักษ์ทะเลสาบของเธอและจะไม่ยอมย้ายออกจากสถานที่นั้น อย่างไรก็ดี เมื่อเธอตกอยู่ในความรัก เธออาจจะยอมละถิ่นฐานและถวายตัวติดตามผู้ที่เธอหลงรัก เธอมีบุคลิกที่น่ารักและร้อนแรงแต่เมื่อถูกทรยศรูปร่างของเธอจะเปลี่ยนไปโดยทันที ผู้ชายถึงกลัวที่จะพบพวกเธอ
raw.vi: Một linh hồn bậc cao xinh đẹp sống trong hồ. Nó sinh ra để bảo vệ hồ của riêng mình, nó sẽ không di chuyển khỏi hồ - nơi nó sinh ra. Tuy nhiên, khi yêu, nó có thể rời khỏi hồ và cam kết sẽ sống cùng người yêu . Nó yêu nồng nhiệt nhưng vì hình dáng bên ngoài thay đổi đột ngột khi bị phản bội nên những người đàn ông thấy sợ khi gặp nó.

id: Roh air cantik dan berpangkat tinggi yang tinggal di lautan. Dia punya kekuatan sihir yang kuat, jago dengan sihir air. Ketika kekuatan Siren meningkat, sayap tumbuh padanya dan dia bisa terbang ke semua air. Cinta adalah sumber sihirnya, dan dia memberi perhatian tanpa batas untuk kekasihnya. Tapi, dia menunjukkan taringnya pada musuh kekasihnya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20093_DESCRIPTION
desc:
A beautiful, high-ranked water spirit that lives in oceans. She has strong magical power, excelling in water magic.
When the power of Undine increases, it grows wings and can freely fly to all waters. Love is her magic's source,
and she showers unlimited affection on their lovers. However, she bares her fangs towards their lover's enemies.

raw.en:
A beautiful, high-ranked water spirit that lives in oceans. She has strong magical power, excelling in water magic.
When the power of Undine increases, it grows wings and can freely fly to all waters. Love is her magic's source,
and she showers unlimited affection on their lovers. However, she bares her fangs towards their lover's enemies.
raw.es:
Espíritu acuático de gran belleza y poder que vive en el océano. Puede lanzar potentes hechizos de agua y,
a medida que se fortalece, desarrolla alas con las que puede volar de un lado a otro. El amor es su fuente mágica,
por lo que muestra un cariño incondicional hacia su invocador y un odio encarnizado hacia los enemigos que este tenga.

raw.pt:
Um belo espírito da água de alto escalão, que vive no oceano. Ela tem fortes poderes mágicos, em especial magias de água.
Quando o poder da Ondina cresce, ela cria asas e pode voar livremente a qualquer corpo de água. A fonte de sua magia é o amor,
e ela banha seus amantes com afeto interminável. Mas ela pode mostrar seu verdadeiro poder contra os inimigos de seu amado.
raw.th: จิตวิญญาณแห่งน้ำระดับสูงที่สวยงามอาศัยอยู่ในมหาสมุทร เธอมีพลังเวทที่แข็งแกร่ง โดยเฉพาะอย่างยิ่งเวทที่เกี่ยวกับน้ำ เมื่อพลังของอุนดีนเพิ่มขึ้น เธอจะมีปีกงอกและสามารถบินไปน่านน้ำใดก้ได้ รักเป็นขุมพลังเวทของเธอและแสดงความเสน่หาไม่มีขีดจำกัดต่อผู้ที่เธอรัก อย่างไรก็ดี เธอจะแยกเขี้ยวเข้าโจมตีศัตรูของคนรักเธอในทางกลับกัน
raw.vi: Linh hồn bậc cao xinh đẹp sống trong các đại dương . Nó có sức mạnh ma thuật mạnh mẽ và đặc biệt trong nước . Khi sức mạnh của Undine tăng lên, nó mọc cánh và có thể tự do bay trong nước . Tình yêu là nguồn phép thuật của nó và nó dành nhiều tình cảm không kể xiết cho trên những người nó yêu thương. Tuy nhiên, nó sẽ giương nanh với kẻ thù của họ.

id: Roh berpangkat tinggi yang memerintah semua air. Bahkan di tempat dengan air sedikit, ia bergerak bebas di udara. Saat pelangi muncul di langit, ia akan menari. Siapa pun yang melihatnya akan beruntung, danbanyak yang mencoba menangkapnya di langit. Ia tidak suka ini, dan siapa pun yang mencoba menyentuhnya, dia akan menyelubungi semuanya dalam air dan tampang dingin.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20094_DESCRIPTION
desc: A high-ranked spirit that rules over all water. Even in places with small amounts of water, she moves freely through the air. It's said that when a rainbow filled the sky she would appear dancing above. It's thought that anyone who sees her is lucky, and many have reached toward the skies trying to catch her. She doesn't like this, however, and should anyone try to touch her she encases everything in water with a cold look on her face.

raw.en: A high-ranked spirit that rules over all water. Even in places with small amounts of water, she moves freely through the air. It's said that when a rainbow filled the sky she would appear dancing above. It's thought that anyone who sees her is lucky, and many have reached toward the skies trying to catch her. She doesn't like this, however, and should anyone try to touch her she encases everything in water with a cold look on her face.
raw.es: Espíritu de alto rango que rige sobre el agua. Incluso en lugares donde hay poca agua, ella se mueve libremente a través del aire. Se dice que cuando un arcoíris se hacía presente en el cielo, se podía ver a Meltia bailando encima de él. Aparentemente, el que la ve será bendecido con la suerte. Muchos se han aventurado hacia el cielo para atraparla. Sin embargo, a Meltia esto no le agrada, y si alguien intenta tocarla, su mirada se vuelve muy fría y recubre todo con agua.
raw.id: Roh berpangkat tinggi yang memerintah semua air. Bahkan di tempat dengan air sedikit, ia bergerak bebas di udara. Saat pelangi muncul di langit, ia akan menari. Siapa pun yang melihatnya akan beruntung, danbanyak yang mencoba menangkapnya di langit. Ia tidak suka ini, dan siapa pun yang mencoba menyentuhnya, dia akan menyelubungi semuanya dalam air dan tampang dingin.
raw.pt: Um espírito de alto nível que governa a água. Mesmo em lugares com pequenas quantias de água, ela se move livremente pelo ar. Dizem que quando um arco-íris preenchia o céu ela apareceria dançando acima. Acreditava-se que quem a visse teria sorte, e muitos tentaram alcançá-la nos céus. Mas ela não gosta disso e cobre tudo em água quando qualquer um tenta tocá-la, com um olhar frio.
raw.th: จิตวิญญาณระดับสูงที่ควบคุมน้ำทั้งหมด แม้แต่ในที่ๆ มีน้ำอยู่เพียงเล็กน้อย เธอก็เคลื่อนไหวไปได้อย่างอิสระในอากาศ กล่าวกันว่าเมื่อสายรู้งพาดผ่านท้องฟ้า เธอจะประกฎตัวมาเต้นรำอยู่บนนั้น เคยคิดกันว่าใครก็ตามที่ได้เห็นเธอจะถือว่าโชคดี และหลายคนก็พยายามเอื้อมมือไปบนท้องฟ้าเพื่อจะจับเธอ แต่อย่างไรก็ตามเธอไม่ชอบพฤติกรรมแบบนี้ และหากใครก็ตามที่พยายามจะสัมผัสเธอ เธอจะห่อหุ้มทุกอย่างมิดชิดด้วยน้ำและจ้องมองด้วยสายตาที่เย็นชา
raw.vi: Một linh hồn có thứ hạng cao ngự trị tất cả nước. Ngay cả ở những nơi chỉ có một lượng nước nhỏ, cô có thể di chuyển thoải mái qua không khí. Người ta nói rằng khi cầu vồng xuất hiện trên bầu trời, cô sẽ xuất hiện nhảy múa trên đó. Người ta cho rằng bất kỳ ai nhìn thấy cô sẽ may mắn và nhiều người đã cố gắng chạm đến bầu trời để bắt được cô. Tuy nhiên, cô không thích điều này và nếu ai cố gắng chạm cô, cô bọc mọi thứ trong nước với cái nhìn lạnh lẽo trên khuôn mặt của cô.

id: Jiwa yang terbungkus cinta yang tersublimasi ke dalam bentuk yang lebih tinggi. Menurut rumor, dengan putus asa ia mencari cinta sehingga ia tidak bisa berubah dari statusnya yang hanya roh air. Setelah bertahun-tahun mempelajari cinta, akhirnya ia memahami arti sejati cinta. Berkat pencerahan ini, ia berhasil menjadi dewi bahkan sebelum ia menyadarinya. Sampai sekarang, ia terus mencurahkan cinta tiada akhir ke seluruh penjuru dunia.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20095_DESCRIPTION
desc: A spirit enveloped by love who sublimated into a higher form of existence. Rumor has it that she once searched for love desperately, which kept her from transcending her state as a mere water spirit. However, after many long years of studying love, she finally came to understand its true meaning. It was thanks to this enlightening that she ascended to her goddess status before she even realized it. And even now, she continues to pour her endless love into every corner of the world.

raw.en: A spirit enveloped by love who sublimated into a higher form of existence. Rumor has it that she once searched for love desperately, which kept her from transcending her state as a mere water spirit. However, after many long years of studying love, she finally came to understand its true meaning. It was thanks to this enlightening that she ascended to her goddess status before she even realized it. And even now, she continues to pour her endless love into every corner of the world.
raw.es: Un espíritu envuelto en amor que se canalizó en una forma de existencia más elevada. Los rumores dicen que buscó el amor con desesperación, lo que evitó que trascendiera su estado de mero espíritu acuático. Sin embargo, luego de estudiar el amor durante muchos años, finalmente comprendió su significado. Gracias a esta iluminación ascendió al rango de diosa antes siquiera de haberse dado cuenta. Aún ahora continúa vertiendo su amor infinito en cada rincón del mundo.
raw.id: Jiwa yang terbungkus cinta yang tersublimasi ke dalam bentuk yang lebih tinggi. Menurut rumor, dengan putus asa ia mencari cinta sehingga ia tidak bisa berubah dari statusnya yang hanya roh air. Setelah bertahun-tahun mempelajari cinta, akhirnya ia memahami arti sejati cinta. Berkat pencerahan ini, ia berhasil menjadi dewi bahkan sebelum ia menyadarinya. Sampai sekarang, ia terus mencurahkan cinta tiada akhir ke seluruh penjuru dunia.
raw.pt: Um espírito envolvido em amor que sublimou a uma forma de existência superior. Rumores dizem que outrora ela buscou desesperadamente o amor, o que a impediu de transcender como um mero espírito aquático. Porém, depois de muitos anos estudando o amor, ela finalmente entendeu seu verdadeiro significado. Foi graças a essa iluminação que ela ascendeu a seus status de deusa antes mesmo de perceber. Mesmo agora, ela continua a cobrir o mundo com seu amor interminável.
raw.th: วิญญาณที่ถูกห่อหุ้มด้วยความรัก ผู้ที่ระเหยกายเป็นรูปแบบสิ่งมีชีวิตที่สูงส่งขึ้น ลือกันว่าครั้งหนึ่งเธอเคยค้นหาความรักอย่างสิ้นหวัง ซึ่งทำให้เธอไม่สามารถเปลี่ยนสถานนะของตนจากการเป็นแค่จิตวิญญาณแห่งน้ำได้ อย่างไรก็ตาม หลังจากได้ศึกษาความรักผ่านไปหลายปี ในที่สุดเธอก็ได้เข้าใจความหมายที่แท้จริงของมัน ต้องขอบคุณการรับรู้นี้ที่ทำให้เธอจุติเป็นเทพธิดาก่อนที่เธอจะรู้ตัวเสียอีก และกระทั่งตอนนี้ เธอก็ยังคงมอบความรักที่ไม่สิ้นสุดของเธอไปยังทั่วทุกมุมโลก
raw.vi: Một linh hồn được bao bọc bởi tình yêu đã thăng hoa thành một hình thức. Có tin đồn rằng cô từng tìm kiếm tình yêu một cách tuyệt vọng, điều giữ cô khỏi vượt quá trạng thái là một linh hồn nước đơn thuần. Tuy nhiên, sau nhiều năm nghiên cứu về tình yêu, cuối cùng cô đã hiểu ý nghĩa thực sự của nó. Nhờ sự giác ngộ ngày, cô đã thăng lên địa vị nữ thần trước cả khi cô nhận ra điều này. Và thậm chí đến bây giờ, cô vẫn tiếp tục trút tình yêu bất tận của mình vào mọi ngóc ngách của thế giới.

id: Kastria dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Sergio diasingkan sebagai pengkhianat karena berlatih sendiri di Pasukan Berukda, yang tujuannya adalah perang dalam grup. Tapi, keahliannya jauh di atas yang lain, dan dia akhirnya diangkat sebagai pemimpin dari unit komando. Unitnya sendiri menakutinya, dan memanggilnya Ksatria Es karena dia dengan dinginnya membunuh musuhnya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20102_DESCRIPTION
desc: A knight from the ruined Sama Kingdom. Sergio was isolated as a heretic for secretly training by himself in the Cavalry Corps, whose aim was group combat. However, his skills far surpassed the others, and he was reluctantly made the leader of a commando unit. His own unit feared him, and called him the Ice Knight after the cold way he cuts down his enemies.

raw.en: A knight from the ruined Sama Kingdom. Sergio was isolated as a heretic for secretly training by himself in the Cavalry Corps, whose aim was group combat. However, his skills far surpassed the others, and he was reluctantly made the leader of a commando unit. His own unit feared him, and called him the Ice Knight after the cold way he cuts down his enemies.
raw.es: Caballero del antiguo reino de Sama. Sergio fue recluido para formar parte de la guarda de caballería del reino. Sin embargo, sus dotes superaron a las de sus compañeros y pronto se hizo líder de un grupo comando. Sus propios compañeros le temían y le llamaban el Caballero de Hielo por la crueldad con la que mataba a sus enemigos.
raw.id: Kastria dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Sergio diasingkan sebagai pengkhianat karena berlatih sendiri di Pasukan Berukda, yang tujuannya adalah perang dalam grup. raw.pt: Um cavaleiro do Reino arruinado de Sama. Sergio foi isolado como herege por por treinar sozinho em segredo na Tropa de Cavalaria, cujo foco é o combate em grupo. Porém, suas habilidades superavam em muito a de outros, e ele foi relutantemente posto como líder de uma unidade de comandos. Sua própria unidade o temia, e apelidou o comandante de Cavaleiro do Gelo pela forma fria como ele abatia seus inimigos.
raw.th: อัศวินจากราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย เซอจิโอถูกลอยแพในฐานะคนนอกรีตเนื่องจากแอบฝึกฝนโดยลำพังทั้งที่กองพลทหารม้านั้นมีเป้าหมายในการสู้รบเป็นกลุ่ม อย่างไรก็ดีทักษะของเขาก็ก้าวล้ำเกินคนอื่นๆและถูกแต่งตั้งให้เป็นหัวหน้าหน่วยคอมมานโดอย่างไม่ค่อยเต็มใจ หน่วยของเขาหวาดกลัวเขาและเรียกเขาว่าอัศวินน้ำแข็งจากการที่เขาผ่าสังหารศัตรูอย่างเลือดเย็น
raw.vi: Một hiệp sĩ tại vương quốc tan rã Sama. Sergio đã bị cô lập như một kẻ dị giáo bởi rèn luyện bí mật của mình trong Quân đoàn kỵ binh với mục đích là chiến đấu theo đội nhóm . Tuy nhiên , kỹ năng của ông vượt xa những người khác, và ông đã miễn cưỡng làm lãnh đạo của một đơn vị biệt kích . Những người trong đơn vị rất sợ ông ta, và gọi ông là Ice Hiệp sĩ Băng  sau khi ông hạ gục kẻ thù của mình một cách lạnh lùng.

id: Kastria dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Dia adalah komandan dari unit komando Pasukan Berkuda Kerajaan Sama, tapi harus melawan para dewa ketika perang dimulai. Beberapa mengaguminya dan mencoba untuk bergabung, tapi Sergio menolak mereka. Dia selalu menjauh meskipun dikagumi oleh orang karena pertarungannya melawan para dewa. Suatu waktu, dia mendapat gelar Pejabat Es.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20103_DESCRIPTION
desc: A knight from the ruined Sama Kingdom. He was the commander of a Sama Kingdom Cavalry commando unit, but left to face the gods alone when the war began. Some admired him and tried to join, but Sergio refused them. He was always aloof even while being admired by people for his battles with the gods. At some point, he earned the title Ice Ruler.

raw.en: A knight from the ruined Sama Kingdom. He was the commander of a Sama Kingdom Cavalry commando unit, but left to face the gods alone when the war began. Some admired him and tried to join, but Sergio refused them. He was always aloof even while being admired by people for his battles with the gods. At some point, he earned the title Ice Ruler.
raw.es: Caballero del antiguo reino de Sama. Fue el comandante de un grupo comando de la caballería del reino de Sama, pero decidió hacer frente él solo a los dioses en cuanto empezó la guerra. Animados por su valentía, algunos trataron de unirse a él pero Sergio los rechazó. Su carácter distante le hizo ganarse el título de Rey Gélido.
raw.id: Kastria dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Dia adalah komandan dari unit komando Pasukan Berkuda Kerajaan Sama, tapi harus melawan para dewa ketika perang dimulai. raw.pt: Um cavaleiro do Reino arruinado de Sama. Ele foi o comandante de uma unidade de comandos da Cavalaria do Reino de Sama, mas partiu para enfrentar os deuses sozinho quando a guerra começou. Alguns o admiravam e buscaram se unir a ele, mas Sergio os recusou. Ele sempre foi indiferente, mesmo quando admirado pelas pessoas por suas batalhas contra os deuses. Em algum ponto, ele obteve o título de Soberano do Gelo.
raw.th: อัศวินจากราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย เขาเคยเป็นผู้บัญชาการหน่วยกองพลทหารม้าคอมมานโด แต่ได้จากไปเผชิญหน้าเหล่าเทพเจ้าเพียงลำพังเมื่อสงครามเกิดขึ้น มีบางคนชิ่นชมและพยายามติดตามแต่ก็ถูกเซอจิโอปฏิเสธ เขามักจะทำตัวเหินท่างแม้ในขณะที่ถูกชื่นชมจากวีรกรรมในการรบกับเทพเจ้า ณ จุดหนึ่ง เข้าได้รับสมญาว่า "จ้าวแห่งน้ำแข็ง"
raw.vi: Một hiệp sĩ tại vương quốc tan rã Sama. Ông là chỉ huy của một đơn vị biệt kích Sama Anh Kỵ , nhưng lại phải đối mặt với các vị thần một mình khi cuộc chiến bắt đầu . Một số người ngưỡng mộ anh ta và cố gắng tham gia vào đơn vị nhưng Sergio từ chối họ . Ông luôn luôn sống khép kín ngay cả khi được mọi người ngưỡng mộ trong những trận đấu với các vị thần. Ở khía cạnh nào đó , anh được gọi với danh hiệu Người thống trị Sắt đá.

id: Ksatria dari reruntuhan Kerajaan Sima. Terluka dalam perang melawan para dewa, ia pingsan dan siap mati. Namun saat serbuan terakhir datang, pasukannya maju untuk melindunginya. Meski ia menolak untuk berwkawan, banyak yang mengagumi sikapnya yang tidak membeda-bedakan. Menonton pasukannya, Sergio menemukan kekuatan untuk mengayunkan pedang esnya demi melindungi rakyat.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20104_DESCRIPTION
desc: A knight from the ruined Sama Kingdom. Injured in the fight against the gods, he collapsed and was prepared to die. But as the final strike came, his troops rushed forward to protect him. Though he refused to befriend them, many of them admired his indifference. Watching them, Sergio found the strength to swing his sword of ice to protect the people.

raw.en: A knight from the ruined Sama Kingdom. Injured in the fight against the gods, he collapsed and was prepared to die. But as the final strike came, his troops rushed forward to protect him. Though he refused to befriend them, many of them admired his indifference. Watching them, Sergio found the strength to swing his sword of ice to protect the people.
raw.es: Caballero del antiguo reino de Sama. Lo hirieron durante la lucha contra los dioses. El ataque lo hizo colapsar, y Sergio se preparó para morir. Sin embargo, cuando el golpe de gracia estaba a punto de caer sobre él, sus tropas se abalanzaron para protegerlo. Si bien él no quiso formar ningún vínculo afectivo con ellos, muchos admiraron su indiferencia. Luego de aquella situación, Sergio encontró la fuerza para blandir su espada gélida y proteger a su gente.
raw.id: Ksatria dari reruntuhan Kerajaan Sima. Terluka dalam perang melawan para dewa, ia pingsan dan siap mati. Namun saat serbuan terakhir datang, pasukannya maju untuk melindunginya. Meski ia menolak untuk berwkawan, banyak yang mengagumi sikapnya yang tidak membeda-bedakan. Menonton pasukannya, Sergio menemukan kekuatan untuk mengayunkan pedang esnya demi melindungi rakyat.
raw.pt: Um cavaleiro do Reino arruinado de Sama. Ferido na luta contra os deuses, ele caiu e estava pronto para morrer. Mas quando o último golpe veio, suas tropas avançaram para protegê-lo. Apesar de ter se recusado a fazer amizade com eles, muitos o admiravam por sua indiferença. Vendo isto, Sergio encontrou a força para empunhar sua espada gélida em defesa das pessoas.
raw.th: อัศวินจากซากราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย เพราะบาดเจ็บจากการต่อสู้กับเทพเจ้า เขาล้มลงและเตรียมตัวที่จะตาย แต่ก่อนที่การโจมตีครั้งสุดท้ายจะมาถึง กองทัพของเขาก็พุ่งเข้ามาเพื่อปกป้องเขา แม้ว่าเขาจะเคยปฏิเสธที่จะเป็นเพื่อนกับพวกนั้น แต่หลายคนชื่นชอบกลับความไม่แยแสของเซอจิโอ เมื่อมองดูพวกนั้น เซอจิโอก็พบความแข็งแกร่งที่จะตวัดดาบน้ำแข็งและต่อสู้เพื่อปกป้องผู้คน
raw.vi: Một hiệp sĩ đến từ Vương quốc Sama đổ nát. Đã bị thương trong cuộc chiến chống lại các vị thần, anh đã ngã gục xuống và sắp hy sinh. Nhưng khi cuộc tấn công cuối cùng đã đến, quân đội của chàng đã lao về phía trước để bảo vệ chàng. Mặc dù, anh từ chối sự giúp đỡ của họ, nhưng nhiều người trong số họ cảm phục thái độ không quan tâm đến tính mạng của anh. Quan sát họ, Sergo đã tìm thấy sức mạnh giúp vung thanh kiếm băng của mình để bảo vệ người dân.

id: Ksatria dari Kerajaan Sama. Setelah mendapatkan kekuatan untuk melindungi yang lain, kemampuan Sergio diakui oleh sang pangeran, yang mempercayainya dengan rencana strategi yang penting. Pada akhirnya, Sergio juga mengakui pertumbuhan sang pangeran, yang membuat hubungan persahabatan mereka semakin dalam dan saling percaya dalam medan perang. Melihat kekalahan tak terhindarkan dari Pasukan Dewa, Sergio dikirim ke medan perang atas perintah sang pangeran. Karena ini, Pasukan Sama berhasil menghindari kekalahan, meskipun setelah kemenangan kecil itu, Sergio tidak pernah terdengar lagi.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20105_DESCRIPTION
desc: A knight from the Sama Kingdom. Having attained his powers in order to protect others, Sergio's prowess was acknowledged by the prince, who entrusted him with crucial strategic plans. In turn, Sergio also acknowledged the prince's progress, which led them to develop a deep bond of friendship and trust on the battlefield. At the sight of imminent defeat at the hands of the God Army, Sergio was sent to the battlefield under the prince's command. Thanks to his actions, the Sama Army was able to avoid destruction, though after that small victory Sergio was never heard from again.

raw.en: A knight from the Sama Kingdom. Having attained his powers in order to protect others, Sergio's prowess was acknowledged by the prince, who entrusted him with crucial strategic plans. In turn, Sergio also acknowledged the prince's progress, which led them to develop a deep bond of friendship and trust on the battlefield. At the sight of imminent defeat at the hands of the God Army, Sergio was sent to the battlefield under the prince's command. Thanks to his actions, the Sama Army was able to avoid destruction, though after that small victory Sergio was never heard from again.
raw.es: Un caballero del reino de Sama. Luego de conseguir sus poderes para proteger a los demás, el príncipe reconoció la destreza de Sergio y le confió planes estratégicos cruciales. En respuesta, Sergio reconoció el progreso del príncipe, lo que les permitió desarrollar un gran lazo de amistad y confianza en el campo de batalla. Cuando la victoria del ejército de los dioses era inminente, el príncipe ordenó que Sergio fuera al campo de batalla. Gracias a sus habilidades, el ejército de Sama pudo escapar de la destrucción, si bien nunca más se volvió a ver a Sergio luego de esa victoria.
raw.id: Ksatria dari Kerajaan Sama. Setelah mendapatkan kekuatan untuk melindungi yang lain, kemampuan Sergio diakui oleh sang pangeran, yang mempercayainya dengan rencana strategi yang penting. Pada akhirnya, Sergio juga mengakui pertumbuhan sang pangeran, yang membuat hubungan persahabatan mereka semakin dalam dan saling percaya dalam medan perang. Melihat kekalahan tak terhindarkan dari Pasukan Dewa, Sergio dikirim ke medan perang atas perintah sang pangeran. Karena ini, Pasukan Sama berhasil menghindari kekalahan, meskipun setelah kemenangan kecil itu, Sergio tidak pernah terdengar lagi.
raw.pt: Um cavaleiro do Reino de Sama. Tendo obtido seus poderes para proteger os outros, Sergio teve suas habilidades reconhecidas pelo príncipe, que o confiou planos estratégicos importantíssimos. Em retribuição, Sergio também reconheceu o progresso do príncipe, o que fez com que eles criassem um forte laço de amizade e confiança em batalha. Com o vislumbre da derrota iminente nas mãos do exército dos deuses, Sergio foi enviado ao campo de batalha sob comando do príncipe. Graças a suas ações, o exército de Sama conseguiu evitar a destruição, embora nunca mais se tenha visto Sergio novamente depois dessa pequena vitória.
raw.th: นายทหารจากอานาจักรซาม่าได้รับพลังเพื่อจะช่วยเหลือและปกป้องผู้อื่น ความกล้าหาญของเซอร์จิโอได้ถูกเห็นโดยเจ้าชายผู้ที่เชื่อใจเขากับแผนการสำคัญที่วางไว้ ในทางกลับกัน เซอร์จิโอก็ชื่นชมความกล้าหาญของเจ้าชาย ทำให้ทั้งสองคนมีความสัมพันธ์มั่นคงและช่วยเหลือกันในระหว่างสงคราม ระหว่างการต่อสู้กับทหารเทพที่ใกล้จะแพ้ เจ้าชายได้ส่ง เซอร์จิโอไปช่วย เพราะการช่วยเหลือของเซอร์จิโอ ทำให้กองทหารซาม่าพ้นจากความพินาจ อย่างไรก็ตามเซอร์จิโอได้หายสาปสูญไป
raw.vi: Một hiệp sĩ đến từ Vương quốc Sama. Sau khi có được sức mạnh để bảo vệ những người khác, sức mạnh của Sergio đã được công nhận bởi hoàng tử, người đã tin cậy anh với những kế hoạch chiến lược quan trọng. Đổi lại, Sergio cũng cảm nhận được sự tiến bộ của hoàng tử, giúp họ phát triển một tình bạn và sự tin cậy sâu đậm trên chiến trường. Khi thấy thất bại sắp xảy ra dưới bàn tay của Đội quân các Vị Thần, Sergio đã được gửi đến chiến trường dưới sự chỉ huy của hoàng tử. Nhờ hành động của anh, quân đội Sama đã tránh khỏi bị tiêu diệt, mặc dù sau chiến thắng nhỏ đấy chẳng còn ai nghe đến Sergio nữa.

id: Iblis Laut, yang ditakuti para pelaut sejak zaman dahulu. Tidak hanya ganas dan kasar, tapi juga sangat cerdas dan bisa berbicara dengan manusia. Tapi, karena Leviathan menilai manusia itu orang jahat yang mengotori lautan, dia mengirim semua kapal yang dijumpainya ke dalam kubur laut. Pelaut takut melihatnya dan selalu berdoa dan memberi sesaji sebelum berlayar.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20112_DESCRIPTION
desc: The Devil of the Sea, feared by sailors since ancient times. Not only ferocious and violent, but also very intelligent and able to talk with humans. However, since Leviathan has judged humans as evil that pollutes the sea, it sends every ship it meets to a watery grave. Sailors fear seeing it and always offer prayers and sacrifices before setting sail.

raw.en: The Devil of the Sea, feared by sailors since ancient times. Not only ferocious and violent, but also very intelligent and able to talk with humans. However, since Leviathan has judged humans as evil that pollutes the sea, it sends every ship it meets to a watery grave. Sailors fear seeing it and always offer prayers and sacrifices before setting sail.
raw.es: Demonio marino temido por los marineros desde tiempos ancestrales. No solo es feroz y violento, sino inteligente y capaz de entender el lenguaje humano. Su pasatiempo favorito es hundir los barcos de los marineros, quienes considera culpables de toda la polución que hay en el mar. Muchos temen encontrarse con él y ofrecen plegarias y sacrificios antes de surcar los mares.
raw.id: Iblis Laut, yang ditakuti para pelaut sejak zaman dahulu. Tidak hanya ganas dan kasar, tapi juga sangat cerdas dan bisa berbicara dengan manusia. Tapi, karena Leviathan menilai manusia itu orang jahat yang mengotori lautan, dia mengirim semua kapal yang dijumpainya ke dalam kubur laut. Pelaut takut melihatnya dan selalu berdoa dan memberi sesaji sebelum berlayar.
raw.pt: O Demônio do Mar, temido por marujos desde tempos antigos. Não somente feroz e violento, mas também inteligente e capaz de falar com humanos. Porém, como Leviatã considera os humanos um mal que polui o mar, ele manda cada navio que encontra a um túmulo submerso. Marujos temem avistá-lo e sempre oferecem preces e sacrifícios antes de zarpar.
raw.th: ปีศาจแห่งท้องทะเล เหล่ากะลาสีต่างหวาดกลัวมันมาตั้งแต่สมัยโบราณ นอกจากดุร้ายโหดเหี้ยมแล้ว มันยังฉลาดมากและสามารถพูดคุยกับมนุษย์ได้อีกด้วย อย่างไรก็ดี ลีเวียธาน มองมนุษย์ว่าเป็นปีศาจที่ทำลายท้องทะเล มันส่งเรือทุกลำที่มันเจอลงสู้สุสานก้นบึ้งทะเล กะลาสีกลัวที่จะต้องพบกับมันและมักจะสวดภาวนาหรือเสนอเครื่องสังเวยให้กับมันก่อนจะออกเรือ
raw.vi: Quái vật dưới biển làm các thủy thủ vô cùng sợ hãi từ thời cổ đại . Mặc dù hung dữ và bạo lực nhưng cũng rất thông minh và có thể nói chuyện với con người. Tuy nhiên , kể từ khi Leviathan  thấy con người như ác quỷ gây ô nhiễm biển, nó biến mỗi con tàu thành một ngôi mộ dưới nước . Thủy thủ sợ nhìn thấy nó và luôn luôn cầu nguyện và tế lễ trước khi ra khơi.

id: Naga besar yang paling kuat di antara drake laut dan sangat ditakuti oleh manusia. Sangat pintar, dia tidak akan menyerang kalau tidak dilukai. Kemampuannya jauh melebihi drake laut yang normal, sampai badai akan terjadi kalau dia muncul. Logness, pemimpin drake laut yang bangga, adalah pemandangan yang luar biasa dan beberapa pelaut memujanya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20113_DESCRIPTION
desc: A giant dragon strongest among the sea drakes and deathly feared by man. Extremely intelligent, it will not attack others as long as it is unharmed. Its abilities far surpass a normal sea drake, to the extent that storms rise when it appears. Logness, leader of the proud sea drakes, is an impressive sight, and some sailors worship it.

raw.en: A giant dragon strongest among the sea drakes and deathly feared by man. Extremely intelligent, it will not attack others as long as it is unharmed. Its abilities far surpass a normal sea drake, to the extent that storms rise when it appears. Logness, leader of the proud sea drakes, is an impressive sight, and some sailors worship it.
raw.es: Poseidón se considera el dragón marino más poderoso y letal que existe. Es extremadamente inteligente y no te atacará a menos que le hagas daño. Su enorme poder, superior al del resto de los dragones acuáticos, hace que se libere una tormenta con su mera presencia. Esta bestia, que pocos han logrado ver, es adorada por algunos marineros.
raw.id: Naga besar yang paling kuat di antara drake laut dan sangat ditakuti oleh manusia. Sangat pintar, dia tidak akan menyerang kalau tidak dilukai. Kemampuannya jauh melebihi drake laut yang normal, sampai badai akan terjadi kalau dia muncul. Logness, pemimpin drake laut yang bangga, adalah pemandangan yang luar biasa dan beberapa pelaut memujanya.
raw.pt: Um dragão gigante, o mais forte dentre os dragões marítimos e temido mortalmente pelos homens. Extremamente inteligente, ele não ataca outros enquanto não for ferido. Suas habilidades superam em muito as de um dragão marítimo normal, ao ponto que tempestades surgem quando aparece. O Monstro de Ness, líder dos orgulhosos dragões do mar, é uma vista impressionante e alguns marujos até o veneram.
raw.th: มังกรยักษ์ที่แข็งแกร่งที่สุดในบรรดามังกรทะเลและเป็นหวาดผวาโดยมนุษย์ มีปัญญาสูงมันจำไม่ทำร้ายผู้อื่นนอกเสียจากถูกคุกคาม ความสามารถของมันเหนือกว่ามังกรทะเลทั่วไปขนาดเมื่อมันปรากฎตัวขึ้นก็จะเกิดพายุ "ล็อคเนส" หัวหน้าเหล่ามังกรทะลผู้ทรนง น่าประทับใจเมื่อพบเจอ และกะลาสีบางคนเคารพบูชามัน
raw.vi: Một con rồng khổng lồ mạnh nhất trong các quái vật biển và là nỗi sợ hãi khủng khiếp của con người. Nó là sinh vật cực kỳ thông minh và sẽ không tấn công người khác nếu họ không gây tổn hại đến nó. Khả năng của nó vượt xa quái vật biển bình thường, đến mức bão tăng lên khi nó xuất hiện . Logness , lãnh đạo của sinh vật biển , là một hiện tượng ấn tượng, và có một số thủy thủ tôn thờ nó .

id: Drake air paling hebat, yang katanya adalah pencipta para drake. Legenda kelahirannya terlacak sampai pada kelahiran dunia, dan bahwa semua lautan di dunia diciptakan olehnya. Katanya lebih lembut dibanding yang lain, tapi kalau diprovokasi, tidak akan memaafkan, kemarahannya membuat badai demi badai sampai lautan terbelah dan semuanya tenggelam ke dalam jurang dalam.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20114_DESCRIPTION
desc: The greatest of all of the sea drakes, said to be their creator. Legend has it that its birth traces back to the birth of the world, and that all of the world's seas were created by it. It is said to be comparatively gentle, but once provoked, its rage is unforgiving, causing storm after storm until the the seas part and everything sinks to the abyss.

raw.en: The greatest of all of the sea drakes, said to be their creator. Legend has it that its birth traces back to the birth of the world, and that all of the world's seas were created by it. It is said to be comparatively gentle, but once provoked, its rage is unforgiving, causing storm after storm until the the seas part and everything sinks to the abyss.
raw.es: Líder supremo del resto de los dragones marinos. Se dice que nació cuando el mundo aún no se había formado y que fue el creador de los mares y océanos. De carácter bondadoso, no conviene provocarlo ya que su furia es incesante y puede invocar tormenta tras tormenta hasta juntar los mares y hundirlo todo en el abismo.
raw.id: Drake air paling hebat, yang katanya adalah pencipta para drake. Legenda kelahirannya terlacak sampai pada kelahiran dunia, dan bahwa semua lautan di dunia diciptakan olehnya. Katanya lebih lembut dibanding yang lain, tapi kalau diprovokasi, tidak akan memaafkan, kemarahannya membuat badai demi badai sampai lautan terbelah dan semuanya tenggelam ke dalam jurang dalam.
raw.pt: O maior dos dragões do mar, dizem que foi ele que os criou. A lenda diz que seu nascimento data da época do nascimento do mundo, e que ele criou os mares. Dizem que ele pode ser gentil, mas uma vez provocado, sua ira é impiedosa, causando tempestades atrás de tempestades até que o oceano se parta e tudo afunde no abismo.
raw.th: ผู้ยิ่งใหญ่ที่สุดในบรรดามันกรทะเล ว่ากันว่ามันคือผู้สร้างพวกนั้นขึ้นมา ตำนานการขานถึงการกำเนิดของมันย้อนไปถึงการกำเนิดของโลก และทะเลทั้งหมดของโลกถูกสร้างขึ้นด้วยพลังของมัน มีการกล่าวเทียบว่าแม้มันจะอ่อนโยนแต่ถ้าหากถูกยั่วยุเมื่อไหร่ ผู้ที่ทำให้โกระจะไม่ได้การให้อภัยและจะเกิดพายุลูกแล้วลูกเล่าจนกระทั่งทะเลแยกออกแล้วทุกอย่างถูกกลืนลงสู่ห้วงลึก
raw.vi: Loài lớn nhất trong các loại sinh vật dưới biển , chúng được cho là đời sau của các loài khác. Truyền thuyết kể rằng dự ra đời của nó là dấu hiệu về sự ra đời của thế giới, và tất cả các vùng biển trên thế giới đều được tạo ra bởi nó . Người ta nói rằng nó khá hiền lành nhưng một khi kích động , sự giận dữ của nó rất khủng khiếp. Nó tạo ra các cơn bão nối tiếp nhau cho đến khi biển và tất cả mọi thứ chìm xuống vực thẳm.

id: Zaman dahulu nama Felneus hanya dibicarakan di dongeng. "Dahulu kala ada naga yang memurnikan air di dasar laut." Atau "Semua jiwa yang tersesat di laut kembali ke Felneus." Luas diartikan, setiap naga laut selalu digambarkan sangat kuat dan agung. Begitu ditemukan, orang berteriak, "Dunai telah kehilangan satu lagi rahasianya."
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20115_DESCRIPTION
desc: For a long time the name Felneus was only spoken of in stories. One such story said, "There was once a dragon that purified the water at the bottom of the sea." Another said, "All souls lost at sea return to Felneus." As widely and broadly depicted as it was, every mention of the sea dragon spoke of how powerful and magnificent it was. Once discovered there was an outcry that "The world has lost another of its secrets."

raw.en: For a long time the name Felneus was only spoken of in stories. One such story said, "There was once a dragon that purified the water at the bottom of the sea." Another said, "All souls lost at sea return to Felneus." As widely and broadly depicted as it was, every mention of the sea dragon spoke of how powerful and magnificent it was. Once discovered there was an outcry that "The world has lost another of its secrets."
raw.es: Durante mucho tiempo, el nombre Felneus solo se oía en historias. Uno de esos cuentos decía: "Antaño existió un dragón que purificó las aguas del fondo del mar". Otro decía: "Todas las almas perdidas en el mar, regresan hacia Felneus". Aun cuando se lo describía en líneas generales, todas las menciones sobre el dragón de agua recalcaban su poder y magnificencia. Cuando lo descubrieron, se alzaron voces que protestaban y decían que "El mundo había perdido otro de sus secretos".
raw.id: Zaman dahulu nama Felneus hanya dibicarakan di dongeng. "Dahulu kala ada naga yang memurnikan air di dasar laut." Atau "Semua jiwa yang tersesat di laut kembali ke Felneus." Luas diartikan, setiap naga laut selalu digambarkan sangat kuat dan agung. Begitu ditemukan, orang berteriak, "Dunai telah kehilangan satu lagi rahasianya."
raw.pt: Por muito tempo o nome Felneus só foi proferido em histórias. Uma história dizia: “Havia um dragão que purificava a água, no fundo do mar”. Outra dizia que “todas as almas perdidas no mar voltam a Felneus”. Por mais variadas e espalhadas que fossem, todas as menções ao dragão marinho falavam sobre o quão poderoso e magnífico ele era. Uma vez descoberto, houveram protestos de que “o mundo perdia mais um de seus segredos”.
raw.th: นานมาแล้วที่ชื่อ เฟลนิอัส ได้ถูกเอ่ยถึงในเรื่องเล่าเท่านั้น  มีเรื่องหนึ่งเล่าว่า "ครั้งหนึ่งเคยมีมังกรที่ทำน้ำให้สะอาดอยู่ที่ก้นมหาสมุทร" อีกเรื่องเล่าว่า "ทุกวิญญาณที่สาบสูบในทะเล จะกลับไปสู่เฟลนิอัส" มีการอธิบายถึงมันอย่างแพร่หลายและกว้างขวาง ทุกครั้งที่มีการเอ่ยถึงมังกรน้ำจะพูดกันว่ามันทรงพลังและสวยงามแค่ไหน แต่มันถูกค้นพบก็มีการร้องโวยวายว่า "โลกได้สูญเสียความลึกลับอีกเรื่องหนึ่งแล้ว"
raw.vi: Trong một thời gian dài, cái tên Felneus chỉ được kể trong các câu chuyện. Một câu chuyện như vậy kể rằng "Có một lần một con rồng đã làm sạch nước ở dưới đáy biển." Một câu chuyện khác kể rằng "Tất cả các linh hồn lưu lạc ở biển đã trở về với Felneus." Như những miêu tả rộng rãi và phổ biến về nó, mỗi lần nhắc đến rồng biển là người ta nói đến sức mạnh và vẻ đẹp lộng lẫy của nó. Khi bị phát hiện, đã có tiếng la ó lớn rằng "Thế giới đã mất đi một bí mật khác."

id: Kapten bajak laut dari lautan di sekitar Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Dibesarkan oleh Verica setelah ditemukan di bangkai kapal di mana dia adalah satu-satunya orang yang selamat. Ketika Mega mewarisi kursi kapten dari Verica, dia mendapatkan kepercayaan dari krunya dan juga bajak laut lokal karena dia berperangai baik dan humoris, dan keahliannya yang luar biasa dengan kapak. Dia dikenal sebagai sang Kapten.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20122_DESCRIPTION
desc:
A pirate captain from the seas near the ruined Sama Kingdom.
He was raised by Verica after being found in a shipwreck of which he was the only survivor. When Mega inherited the captain's chair from Verica he gained the trust of his crew as well as the local pirates due to his good humored nature and incredible skill with an axe. He became known as the Captain.

raw.en:
A pirate captain from the seas near the ruined Sama Kingdom.
He was raised by Verica after being found in a shipwreck of which he was the only survivor. When Mega inherited the captain's chair from Verica he gained the trust of his crew as well as the local pirates due to his good humored nature and incredible skill with an axe. He became known as the Captain.
raw.es:
Capitán de una banda de piratas que surcaba los mares cercanos al reino de Sama.
Verica fue quien lo crió tras rescatarlo de un naufragio en el que solo él logró sobrevivir. Tras suceder a Verica como capitán, se ganó la confianza de los piratas de la zona por su buen carácter y su increíble talento con el hacha, lo que le valió el apodo de Capitán Hacha.
raw.id: Kapten bajak laut dari lautan di sekitar Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Dibesarkan oleh Verica setelah ditemukan di bangkai kapal di mana dia adalah satu-satunya orang yang selamat. Ketika Mega mewarisi kursi kapten dari Verica, dia mendapatkan kepercayaan dari krunya dan juga bajak laut lokal karena dia berperangai baik dan humoris, dan keahliannya yang luar biasa dengan kapak. Dia dikenal sebagai sang Kapten.
raw.pt:
Um capitão pirata dos mares próximos ao Reino arruinado de Sama.
Ele foi criado por Verica depois de ser encontrado em um naufrágio do qual foi o único sobrevivente. Quando Mega herdou o posto de capitão de Verica ele ganhou a confiança de sua tripulação assim como os piratas locais devido à sua natureza bem-humorada e incrível habilidade com um machado. Ele ficou conhecido como O Capitão.
raw.th: กัปตันโจรสลัดจากทะเลใกล้ราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย เขาถูกเลี้ยงดูมาโดย "เวริก้า" หลังจากที่ถูกพบในซากเรือซึ่งเขาเป็นผู้รอดชีวิตเพียงคนเดียว เมื่อ "เมก้า" สืบทอดตำแหน่งกัปตันจาเวริก้า เขาได้รับความเชื่อถือจากลูกเรือและโจรสลัดท้องถิ่นเพราะความขำขันของเขากับทักษะในการใช้ขวานได้อย่างน่าอัศจรรย์ เขาเป็นที่รู้จักกันในฉายาว่า "กัปตัน"
raw.vi: Cướp biển tại các vùng biển gần vương quốc sụp đổ Sama .Ông được Verica nuôi dưỡng sau khi được tìm thấy trong một con tàu đắm mà ông là người duy nhất . Khi Mega thừa kế ngôi vị thuyền trưởng từ Verica ông đã giành được sự tín nhiệm của các thủy thủ cũng như những tên cướp biển địa phương bởi lẽ tính cách tốt bụng, vui vẻ và tài năng phi thường với chỉ một cái rìu . Ông được nhiều người biết đến như một vị thuyền trưởng.

id: Kapten bajak laut dari lautan di sekitar Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Mega piawai mengomandani kru bajak lautnya sampai suatu hari Angkatan Laut Kerajaan Sama muncul. Mereka memintanya bergabung dengan mereka sebagai admiral baru mereka dan mengatur ulang pasukan mereka. Dia selalu benci angkatan laut yang korup, tapi setuju dengan persyaratan mereka dan melakukan yang terbaik untuk meningkatkan reputasi mereka.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20123_DESCRIPTION
desc: A pirate captain from the seas near the ruined Sama Kingdom. Mega masterfully commanded his pirate crew until one day the Sama Kingdom Navy appeared. They requested he join them as their new admiral and help reorganize their forces. He had always hated the corrupt navy, but agreed to their terms and did his best to improve their reputation.

raw.en: A pirate captain from the seas near the ruined Sama Kingdom. Mega masterfully commanded his pirate crew until one day the Sama Kingdom Navy appeared. They requested he join them as their new admiral and help reorganize their forces. He had always hated the corrupt navy, but agreed to their terms and did his best to improve their reputation.
raw.es: Capitán de una banda de piratas que surcaba los mares cercanos al reino de Sama. Mega dirigió con talento a su banda hasta que un día el reino de Sama se presentó ante él y le ofreció convertirse en el nuevo almirante de sus tropas. A pesar de que odiaba a la marina del reino, llena de corrupción, acabo aceptando e hizo lo que pudo por mejorar su fama.
raw.id: Kapten bajak laut dari lautan di sekitar Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Mega piawai mengomandani kru bajak lautnya sampai suatu hari Angkatan Laut Kerajaan Sama muncul. Mereka memintanya bergabung dengan mereka sebagai admiral baru mereka dan mengatur ulang pasukan mereka. Dia selalu benci angkatan laut yang korup, tapi setuju dengan persyaratan mereka dan melakukan yang terbaik untuk meningkatkan reputasi mereka.
raw.pt: Um capitão pirata dos mares próximos ao Reino arruinado de Sama. Mega comandou sua tripulação com maestria até que um dia a Marinha do Reino de Sama apareceu. Eles pediram a ele que se alistasse como novo almirante e ajudasse a reorganizar suas forças. Ele sempre odiou a corrupta marinha, mas concordou com seus termos e fez o melhor que pôde para melhorar sua reputação.
raw.th: กัปตันโจรสลัดจากทะเลใกล้ราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย "เมก้า" ผู้เชี่ยวชาญในการบัญชาทัพโจรสลัดของเขาจนกระทั่งวันหนึ่งเมื่อทัพเรือของราชอาณาจักรซามะปรากฎตัวขึ้น พวกนั้นร้องขอให้เขาเข้าร่วมกองทัพในฐานะพลเรือเอกคนใหม่ของพวกนั้น และขอให้ช่วยจัดระเบียบกองกำลังใหม่ แม้เขาเกลียดกองทัพเรือที่ฉ้อฉลมาเสมอ แต่ก็ยอมตกลงกับเงื่อนไขของพวกนั้นและทำดีที่สุดของเขาในการปรับปรุงชื่อเสียงของกองทัพ
raw.vi: Cướp biển tại các vùng biển gần vương quốc sụp đổ Sama. Mega hách dịch chỉ huy phi hành đoàn cướp biển của mình cho đến một ngày Hải quân vương quốc Sama xuất hiện . Họ yêu cầu hắn tham gia cùng họ với vai trò đô đốc mới và giúp họ tổ chức lại lực lượng . Hắn luôn ghét hải quân tham nhũng nhưng lại đồng ý với các điều khoản của họ và đã làm hết sức mình để nâng cao danh tiếng của họ.

id: Komandan Master dari angkatan laut Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Dia pertama menerima pekerjaan sebagai admiral untuk main-main, tapi setelah dia tahu bahwa dia keturunan dari admiral sebelumnya, dia mulai menunjukkan sifat aslinya. Dia melawan para dewa, membebaskan lautan, sambil membangun ulang angkatan laut yang korup. Untuk jasanya, dia mendapatkan kapak pusaka Poseidon.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20124_DESCRIPTION
desc: Master Commander of the ruined Sama Kingdom's navy. He first took his job as admiral as a joke, but after learning he was descended from the previous admiral began showing his true fortitude. He took on the gods, liberating the seas, all whilst rebuilding a corrupt navy. For his merits he received the treasured axe Poseidon.

raw.en: Master Commander of the ruined Sama Kingdom's navy. He first took his job as admiral as a joke, but after learning he was descended from the previous admiral began showing his true fortitude. He took on the gods, liberating the seas, all whilst rebuilding a corrupt navy. For his merits he received the treasured axe Poseidon.
raw.es: Jefe comandante de la marina del antiguo reino de Sama. Tras aceptar el puesto de almirante, Mega descubrió que su padre ocupó el mismo cargo que él y esto le dio ánimos a dar su máximo. Luchó contra los dioses con la furia del mar y restituyó la marina del ejército, motivo por el que recibió la preciada hacha Poseidón.
raw.id: Komandan Master dari angkatan laut Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Dia pertama menerima pekerjaan sebagai admiral untuk main-main, tapi setelah dia tahu bahwa dia keturunan dari admiral sebelumnya, dia mulai menunjukkan sifat aslinya. Dia melawan para dewa, membebaskan lautan, sambil membangun ulang angkatan laut yang korup. Untuk jasanya, dia mendapatkan kapak pusaka Poseidon.
raw.pt: Mestre comandante da marinha do Reino arruinado de Sama. Primeiro ele levou seu posto como almirante como uma piada, até descobrir que descendia do almirante anterior e começar a mostrar sua verdadeira força. Ele enfrentou os deuses liberando o mar, enquanto reconstruía uma marinha corrupta. Por seus méritos ele recebeu o cobiçado machado Poseidon.
raw.th: ผู้บัญชาการสูงสุดของกองทัพเรือแห่งราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย ในตอนแรกเขายอมรับตำแหน่งพลเรือเอกแบบไม่จริงจังแต่หลังจากที่ได้รู้ว่าเขาสืบเชื้อสายมาจากพลเรือเอกคนก่อนหน้านี้ เขาจึงเริ่มแสดงให้เห็นความแข็งแกร่งที่แท้จริงของเขา เขาเอาชนะเทพเจ้าและปลดปล่อยท้องทะเลในขณะที่ปรับปรุงกองทัพไปพร้อมๆ กัน สำหรับคุณงามความดีของเขาทำให้เขาได้รับขวานล้ำค่า "โพไซดอน"
raw.vi: Tổng Tư Lệnh hải quân vương quốc sụp đổ Sama. Công việc đầu tiên của ông là đô đốc. Chuyện này như một trò đùa nhưng sau khi biết mình là hậu duệ của các đô đốc trước đó ông bắt đầu chứng minh sự dũng cảm, kiên cường của mình. Ông chiến đấu với các vị thần , giải phóng các vùng biển đồng thời xây dựng lại lực lượng hải quân. Ông đã nhận được chiếc rìu quý giá Poseidon cho những công lao của mình.

id: Bekas pemimpin bajak laut dan laksamana dari Angkatan Laut Kerajaan Sama. Setelah tidak lagi menjadi bajak laut, beberapa bajak laut lain membencinya. Untuk membujuk mereka agar berubah pikiran, Mega mengorbankan dirinya untuk menyelamatkan mereka dari serangan tiba-tiba para dewa. Dia terluka parah, tapi berhasil mengubah pandangan para bajak laut. Mega tersenyum selagi dia menghembuskan napasnya yang terakhir, tapi pada saat itu juga dia dihidupkan kembali oleh roh dari laut, berikut dengan kapak kesayangannya dan roh hebat yang diam di dalamnya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20125_DESCRIPTION
desc: Former pirate leader and admiral of the Sama Kingdom Navy. Having lost his place as a pirate, some other pirates came to despise him. In order to pursuade them to change their minds, Mega sacrificed himself to save them from the gods' surprise attack. This left him gravely wounded, but resulted in the pirates having a change of heart. Mega smiled at this as he began to succumb to his wounds, but just then he was brought back by spirits from the sea, along with his treasured axe and the great spirit that resided within it.

raw.en: Former pirate leader and admiral of the Sama Kingdom Navy. Having lost his place as a pirate, some other pirates came to despise him. In order to pursuade them to change their minds, Mega sacrificed himself to save them from the gods' surprise attack. This left him gravely wounded, but resulted in the pirates having a change of heart. Mega smiled at this as he began to succumb to his wounds, but just then he was brought back by spirits from the sea, along with his treasured axe and the great spirit that resided within it.
raw.es: Antiguo líder pirata y almirante de la marina del reino de Sama. Tras perder su lugar como pirata, algunos antiguos compañeros comenzaron a mirarlo con desprecio. Para persuadirlos a cambiar de opinión, Mega se sacrificó para salvarlos del ataque sorpresa de los dioses. Esta estrategia lo dejó gravemente herido, pero logró que los piratas cambiaran su actitud hacia él. Ante esta situación, Mega sonrió, mientras las heridas le quitaban el último aliento. Sin embargo, los espíritus del mar lo devolvieron a la vida, junto con su preciada hacha y el gran espíritu que vivía en su interior.
raw.id: Bekas pemimpin bajak laut dan laksamana dari Angkatan Laut Kerajaan Sama. Setelah tidak lagi menjadi bajak laut, beberapa bajak laut lain membencinya. Untuk membujuk mereka agar berubah pikiran, Mega mengorbankan dirinya untuk menyelamatkan mereka dari serangan tiba-tiba para dewa. Dia terluka parah, tapi berhasil mengubah pandangan para bajak laut. Mega tersenyum selagi dia menghembuskan napasnya yang terakhir, tapi pada saat itu juga dia dihidupkan kembali oleh roh dari laut, berikut dengan kapak kesayangannya dan roh hebat yang diam di dalamnya.
raw.pt: Antigo líder pirata e almirante da Marinha do Reino de Sama. Ao perder seu lugar como pirata, alguns outros piratas passaram a desprezá-lo. Para convencê-los a mudar de ideia, Mega se sacrificou para salvá-los do ataque surpresa dos deuses. Isto o deixou gravemente ferido, mas resultou no convencimento dos piratas. Mega sorriu por conta disso ao começar a sucumbir aos ferimentos, mas nesse momento ele foi trazido de volta pelos espíritos do mar, junto com seu precioso machado e o espírito grandioso que tinha dentro de si.
raw.th: อดีตหัวหน้าโจรสลัดและผู้การกองทัพเรือของราชอาณาจักรซามะ หลังจากสูญเสียฐานะโจรสลัดไป พวกโจรสลัดอื่นๆ บางส่วนก็เริ่มจะดูถูกเขา และเพื่อที่จะเปลี่ยนแปลงความคิดของพวกนั้น เมก้า ได้เสียสละตัวเองเพื่อปกป้องพวกนั้นจากการโจมตีโดยไม่ทันตั้งตัวของเทพเจ้า และมันก็ทำให้เขาบาดเจ็บสาหัสแต่ผลที่ได้ก็คือเหล่าโจรสลัดเปลี่ยนใจ เมก้ามีรอยยิ้มในขณะที่เขาเริ่มจะทนพิษบาดแผลไม่ไหว แต่ในตอนนั้นเขาก็ถูกนำกลับมาโดยจิตวิญญาณจากท้องทะเลพร้อมกับขวานคู่ใจของเขารวมถึงจิตวิญญาณที่ยิ่งใหญ่ที่อยู่ในนั้นด้วย
raw.vi: Cựu thủ lĩnh cướp biển và đô đốc Hải quân vương quốc Sama. Sau khi đánh mất vị trí cướp biển của mình, một số cướp biển khác trở nên coi thường anh. Để thuyết phục họ thay đổi suy nghĩ, Mega đã hy sinh bản thân để cứu họ khỏi cuộc tấn công bất ngờ của các vị thần. Việc này khiến anh bị thương nặng, nhưng kết quả là những tên cướp biển đã thay đổi thái độ. Mega mỉm cười vì điều này khi anh bắt đầu chống chọi với vết thương, nhưng ngay lúc đó, anh đã hồi phục nhờ các linh hồn của biển cả, cùng với cây rìu quý và linh hồn vĩ đại cư trú trong nó.

id: Nymph kecil yang diduga lahir dari air, satu dari enam elemen yang diciptakan para dewa. Sifatnya tenang, dia juga menyukai air dan jarang muncul di depan manusia. Tapi, kalau teritorinya diganggu, dia akan melepaskan sihir tanpa henti. Meskipun demikian, Pemanggil yang mencari kemampuan Nymph yang bisa memberi kekuatan pada orang lain sering berusaha masuk ke wilayah mereka.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20130_DESCRIPTION
desc: A small nymph thought to be born from water, one of the six elements made by the gods. Along with its quiet demeanor, it prefers the water and rarely appears before humans. However, if its territory is invaded it will unleash relentless magic. Even still, Summoners seeking the Nymph's ability to grant powers to others frequently attempt to enter its realm.

raw.en: A small nymph thought to be born from water, one of the six elements made by the gods. Along with its quiet demeanor, it prefers the water and rarely appears before humans. However, if its territory is invaded it will unleash relentless magic. Even still, Summoners seeking the Nymph's ability to grant powers to others frequently attempt to enter its realm.
raw.es: Pequeña ninfa nacida del agua, uno de los seis elementos creados por los dioses. Es tranquila y prefiere nadar en aguas mansas, lejos de los humanos. Todo aquel que ose invadir su territorio deberá enfrentarse a su devastadora magia. Esto no desanima a los invocadores, quienes a menudo irrumpen en su reino en busca de sus poderes.
raw.id: Nymph kecil yang diduga lahir dari air, satu dari enam elemen yang diciptakan para dewa. Sifatnya tenang, dia juga menyukai air dan jarang muncul di depan manusia. Tapi, kalau teritorinya diganggu, dia akan melepaskan sihir tanpa henti. Meskipun demikian, Pemanggil yang mencari kemampuan Nymph yang bisa memberi kekuatan pada orang lain sering berusaha masuk ke wilayah mereka.
raw.pt: Uma pequena ninfa que acredita-se ter nascido da água, um dos seis elementos criados pelos deuses. De comportamento quieto, ela prefer a água e raramente aparece aos humanos. Porém, quando seu território é invadido ela irá usar magia implacavelmente. Ainda assim, Invocadores buscando a habilidade da Ninfa de dar poderes a outros tentam entrar em seu domínio frequentemente.
raw.th: ผีตัวเล็กที่คิดกันว่าเกิดจากน้ำ หนึ่งในธาตุทั้งหกที่ถูกสร้างโดยพระเจ้า ด้วยพฤษติกรรมที่สงบนิ่งมันชอบน้ำและไม่ค่อยออกมาให้ใครพบเจอ อย่างไรก็ดีถ้าถานของมันถูกบุกรุกมันจะปลดปล่อยเวทมนตร์ไม่หยุดยั้ง ถึงจะเป็นแบบนั้นแต่ก็ยังมีเหล่าซัมมอนเนอร์ที่ต้องการความสามารถที่จะเสริมพลังให้กับผู้อื่น จนยอมเสี่ยงเข้าไปในพื้นที่ของพวกมัน
raw.vi: Một nữ thần nhỏ được sinh ra từ nước , một trong sáu yếu tố do các vị thần tạo nên.  Với tính cách trầm lặng , cô thích nước và hiếm khi xuất hiện trước mặt con người . Tuy nhiên, nếu lãnh thổ của mình bị xâm lược cô sẽ tạo ra ma thuật không ngừng . Thậm chí cho đến khi người ta phát hiện ra khả năng trao sức mạnh cho người khác để có thể vào được lãnh địa của cô.

id: Roh yang berkuasa atas air, satu dari enam elemen yang diciptakan para dewa. Dia benci pengotor lautan dan akan pura-pura menjadi anak kecil untuk menipu dan menarik manusia yang beristirahat di dekat air. Tapi, sebenarnya jinak, dan kisah menceritakan dia memberikan air penyembuh ke pengelana yang capek. Katanya dia akan memberikan kekuatan yang besar kepada siapapun yang mau menerimanya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20131_DESCRIPTION
desc: A spirit that rules water, one of the six elements made by the gods. It hates polluters of ocean and will pretend to be a child to trick and pull in humans resting near the sea. However, it is naturally docile, and lore says it gives healing water to weary travelers. It is also said to bestow a great power to anyone willing to receive it.

raw.en: A spirit that rules water, one of the six elements made by the gods. It hates polluters of ocean and will pretend to be a child to trick and pull in humans resting near the sea. However, it is naturally docile, and lore says it gives healing water to weary travelers. It is also said to bestow a great power to anyone willing to receive it.
raw.es: Un espíritu que domina el agua, uno de los seis elementos creados por los dioses. Odian a los que contaminan las aguas y suelen hacer de las suyas con quien descansa a orillas del mar. A pesar de todo, son dóciles y dicen que ofrecen agua curativa a los viajeros cansados, además de un poder increíble a todo aquel que lo acepte.
raw.id: Roh yang berkuasa atas air, satu dari enam elemen yang diciptakan para dewa. Dia benci pengotor lautan dan akan pura-pura menjadi anak kecil untuk menipu dan menarik manusia yang beristirahat di dekat air. Tapi, sebenarnya jinak, dan kisah menceritakan dia memberikan air penyembuh ke pengelana yang capek. Katanya dia akan memberikan kekuatan yang besar kepada siapapun yang mau menerimanya.
raw.pt: Um espírito que governa a água, um dos seis elementos criados pelos deuses. Ele odeia aqueles que poluem o oceano e finge ser uma criança para enganar e atrair humanos descansando perto do mar. Porém, ele é naturalmente dócil, e é de conhecimento geral que ele dá águas com poderes de cura a viajantes cansados. Também dizem que concede um grande poder àqueles dispostos a recebê-lo.
raw.th: วิญญาณที่ปกครองน้ำ หนึ่งในธาตุทั้งหกที่ถูกสร้างโดยพระเจ้า มันไม่ชอบผู้ที่ทำให้มหาสมุทรปนเปือ้นและจะแกล้งแปลงเป็นเด็กเพื่อหลอกคน ดึงดูดมนุษย์ที่อาศัยอยู่ใกล้ทะเล อย่างไรก็ดีมันมีความอ่อนน้อมตามธรรมชาติและมีนิทานเล่าว่ามันมอบน้ำรักษาให้กับนักเดินทางที่บาดเจ็บ และยังมีการพูดถึงอีกว่ามันจะมอบอำนาจยิ่งใหญ่ให้กับคนที่ยินดีจะรับมัน
raw.vi: Linh hồn điều khiển được nước , một trong sáu yếu tố do các vị thần tạo nên. Nó ghét những người gây ô nhiễm đại dương và sẽ giả vờ là một đứa trẻ để lừa và kéo những ai ở gần đó xuống biển. Thật ra nó rất hiền lành và truyền thuyết kể rằng nó dùng nước để chữa bệnh nước cho những du khách mệt mỏi. Người ta cho rằng sẽ trao tặng sức mạnh tuyệt vời cho bất cứ ai muốn nhận lấy.

id: Pemuja Dewa Air membuat idola ini hidup melalui doa. Dulu dikira hanyalah legenda di Elgaia, tapi Pemanggil menemukannya secara nyata di Gaia Besar. Meskipun patung itu melukai penemunya, dia masih diikuti oleh mereka yang percaya legenda bahwa dia mempunyai kekuatan yang besar.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20132_DESCRIPTION
desc: Worshipers of the Water God brought this idol to life through prayer. Though originally thought to be a fairy tale in Elgaia, it was found for real by a Summoner in Grand Gaia. Although the statue injured the discoverer, it is still followed by those who believe the legend that it holds within it a great power.

raw.en: Worshipers of the Water God brought this idol to life through prayer. Though originally thought to be a fairy tale in Elgaia, it was found for real by a Summoner in Grand Gaia. Although the statue injured the discoverer, it is still followed by those who believe the legend that it holds within it a great power.
raw.es: Ídolo legendario al que dieron vida los devotos del agua con sus oraciones. Fue considerado una leyenda durante años en Elgaia, hasta que un invocador descubrió uno en Gran Gaia. A pesar de que el ídolo atacó a su descubridor, muchos lo buscan con la convicción de que alberga un tremendo poder.
raw.id: Pemuja Dewa Air membuat idola ini hidup melalui doa. Dulu dikira hanyalah legenda di Elgaia, tapi Pemanggil menemukannya secara nyata di Gaia Besar. Meskipun patung itu melukai penemunya, dia masih diikuti oleh mereka yang percaya legenda bahwa dia mempunyai kekuatan yang besar.
raw.pt: Adoradores do deus da água deram vída a este ídolo através de preces. Apesar de originalmente acreditar-se que era um conto de fadas em Elgaia, ele foi descoberto como real por um Invocador em Grand Gaia. Apesar da estátua ter ferido o descobridor, ela ainda é seguida por aqueles que acreditam na lenda de que ela contém um grande poder.
raw.th: ผู้บูชาเทพแห่งน้ำทำให้เทวรูปนี้มีชีวิตขึ้นมาด้วยการสวดภาวนา แม้ดั้งเดิมจะถูกคิดว่าเป็นแค่นิยายในเอลไกอา มันกลับเป็นเรื่องจริงของเหล่าซัมมอนเนอร์ในแกรนด์ไกอา ถึงรูปปั้นจะทำให้ผู้ที่ค้นพบมันบาดเจ็บ แต่มันก็ยังมีผู้ติดตามที่เชื่อในตำนานว่ามันครอบครองพลังที่ยิ่งใหญ่
raw.vi: Nhiều người tôn sùng Thần nước đã mang vị thần này đến cuộc sống qua nững lời cầu nguyện . Mặc dù lúc đầu chuyện này được coi là một câu chuyện cổ tích trong Elgaia , nhưng nó đã được chứng thực bởi một Summoner ở Grand Gaia. Mặc dù tượng thần đã gây tổn hại đến người phát hiện ra nó nhưng nhiều người vẫn tin vào truyền thuyết rằng nó nắm giữ một sức mạnh tuyệt vời.

id: Diciptakan oleh para dewa, dia melambangkan kekuatan air. Diceritakan sebagai bencana besar dalam tulisan kuno, dia muncul bersama dengan kemarahan para dewa, membawa banjir dengannya. Ada beberapa laporan tentangnya di Gaia Besar. Hujan besar selalu turun di sekitar badannya yang besar. Legenda berkata bahwa hanya Pemanggil yang diakui oleh para dewa mampu mengalahkannya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20133_DESCRIPTION
desc: Created by the gods, it embodies the power of water. Referred to as a great disaster in ancient writings, it appeared along with the wrath of the gods, bringing floods along with it. There are a few reports of it in Grand Gaia. Torrential rains always fall around its massive body. Legend says that only those Summoners recognized by the gods can defeat it.

raw.en: Created by the gods, it embodies the power of water. Referred to as a great disaster in ancient writings, it appeared along with the wrath of the gods, bringing floods along with it. There are a few reports of it in Grand Gaia. Torrential rains always fall around its massive body. Legend says that only those Summoners recognized by the gods can defeat it.
raw.es: Tótem creado por los dioses que encarna el poder del agua. Cuentan que en tiempos lejanos fue el portador de la ira de los dioses y que inundó todo lo que encontró a su paso. Poco más se sabe de él en Gran Gaia, excepto que una lluvia torrencial rodea su enorme cuerpo. Solo los invocadores que cuenten con el reconocimiento de los dioses podrán derrotarlo.
raw.id: Diciptakan oleh para dewa, dia melambangkan kekuatan air. Diceritakan sebagai bencana besar dalam tulisan kuno, dia muncul bersama dengan kemarahan para dewa, membawa banjir dengannya. Ada beberapa laporan tentangnya di Gaia Besar. Hujan besar selalu turun di sekitar badannya yang besar. Legenda berkata bahwa hanya Pemanggil yang diakui oleh para dewa mampu mengalahkannya.
raw.pt: Criado pelos deuses, ele encarna o poder da água. Citado em escrituras antigas como um grande desastre, ele sempre aparecia junto da ira dos deuses, trazendo enchentes. Existem alguns relatos dele em Grand Gaia. Chuvas torrenciais caem o tempo todo ao redor de seu corpo massivo. A lenda diz que somente os Invocadores reconhecidos pelos deuses podem derrotá-lo.
raw.th: ถูกสร้างโดยพระเจ้า มันคือการรวมตัวของพลังแห่งน้ำ ถูกเรียกว่าภัยพิบัติครั้งใหญ่ในงานเขียนโบราณ มันปรากฎตัวพร้อมกับการลงโทษของพระเจ้า และนำน้ำท่วมมาพร้อมกับมัน มีรายงานเกี่ยวกับมันไม่มากในแกรนด์ไกอา ฝนกระหน่ำตกตลอดทั่วร่างกายใหญ่ของมัน ตำนานเล่าว่ามีเพียงซัมมอนเนอร์ที่ได้รับการยอมรับจากพระเจ้าเท่านั้นจึงจะเอาชนะมันได้
raw.vi: Được tạo ra bởi các vị thần,  thể hiện sức mạnh của nước . Nó được coi là thảm họa lớn trong các tác phẩm cổ đại, nó xuất hiện và mang lũ đến cùng với cơn thịnh nộ của các vị thần. Chỉ có một vài báo cáo của nó ở Grand Gaia. Mưa xối xả xung quanh cơ thể khổng lồ của nó . Truyền thuyết kể rằng chỉ những Summoner được các vị thần công nhận mới có thể đánh bại nó .

id: Bajak laut yang terkenal karena perbuatan jahatnya di sepanjang pantai Kerajaan Sarma. Ditakuti dengan pedang panjang bermata duanya, Stya dikenal karena kekejamannya terhadap siapapun yang berani mendekatinya. Gambaran rambutnya yang seputih salju bernoda merah dengan darah korbannya membuatnya dijuluki "Bunga Salju", meskipun yang lain mengklaim nama itu datang dari sifatnya yang dingin dan penampilannya yang cantik.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20141_DESCRIPTION
desc: A pirate notorious for her misdeeds along the Kingdom of Sarma’s coast. Fearsome with a double-pronged pole sword, Stya is known for the savage work she made of any who dared to approach her. The image of her snow-white hair stained crimson with the blood of her victims gave rise to her sobriquet “Snow Flower”, though others claim the name came from her frosty demeanor coupled with her beautiful appearance.

raw.en: A pirate notorious for her misdeeds along the Kingdom of Sarma’s coast. Fearsome with a double-pronged pole sword, Stya is known for the savage work she made of any who dared to approach her. The image of her snow-white hair stained crimson with the blood of her victims gave rise to her sobriquet “Snow Flower”, though others claim the name came from her frosty demeanor coupled with her beautiful appearance.
raw.es: Pirata conocida por sus fechorías en la costa del reino de Sama. Armada con su temible lanza de doble hoja, muchos temen a Stya por la crueldad con la que elimina todo el que ose acercarse a ella. Su pelo blanco como la nieve mezclado con la sangre carmesí de sus víctimas le ha hecho ganarse el sobrenombre de "Flor nívea", aunque muchos piensan que la llaman así por su frialdad y belleza.
raw.id: Bajak laut yang terkenal karena perbuatan jahatnya di sepanjang pantai Kerajaan Sarma. Ditakuti dengan pedang panjang bermata duanya, Stya dikenal karena kekejamannya terhadap siapapun yang berani mendekatinya. Gambaran rambutnya yang seputih salju bernoda merah dengan darah korbannya membuatnya dijuluki "Bunga Salju", meskipun yang lain mengklaim nama itu datang dari sifatnya yang dingin dan penampilannya yang cantik.
raw.pt: Uma pirata notória por seus crimes ao longo da costa do Reino de Sarma. Temida com sua espada dupla, Stya é conhecida pelas coisas horríveis que fez com quem quer que ousasse chegar perto. A imagem do cabelo branco como a neve dela manchado com o vermelho do sangue de suas vítimas deu origem ao apelido de “Flor de Neve”, embora outros digam que o nome veio do seu comportamento gélido combinado com sua beleza.
raw.th: โจรสลัดผู้ฉาวโฉ่จากพฤษติกรรมชั่วร้ายของเธอตามแนวชายฝั่งของราชอาณาจักรซามะ ความน่าเกรงขามที่มาพร้อมกับง้าวสองง่าม "สทีย่า" ขึ้นชื่อจากความโหดร้ายที่เธอทำกับใครก็ตามที่กล้าหาเรื่องเธอ ภาพของผมสีขาวราวกับหิมะของเธอถูกย้อมเป็นสีแดงด้วยเลือดจากเหยื่อของเธอจนเป็นที่มาของฉายา "ดอกไม้หิมะ" แม้จะมีคนอ้างว่าฉายานั้นมาจากท่าทางที่เยือกเย็นประกอบกับหน้าตาที่สวยงามของเธอ
raw.vi: Tên cướp biển khét tiếng chuyên làm việc xấu tại bờ biển Vương quốc Sarma . Với một thanh kiếm nhọn đáng sợ , Stya được biết đến vì đã làm những việc rất dã man đối với bất kỳ ai dám đến gần mình . Mái tóc trắng như tuyết đã nhuộm màu đỏ thẫm bởi máu của các nạn nhân. Do đó Stya có biệt danh là " Hoa Tuyết ", tuy nhiên những người khác cho rằng tên gọi đó xuất phát từ tính cách lạnh lùng cùng với vẻ ngoài xinh đẹp của cô .

id: Kapten bajak laut yang terkenal karena perbuatan jahatnya di sepanjang pantai Kerajaan Sarma. Ayunan pedang panjang bermata duatnya maupun ejekan dari lidahnya yang dingin kepada anak buahnya, Stya membuat semua yang bertemu dengannya mengigil. Kebenciannya terhadap sesama pelaut Kapten Mega sangatlah intens sehingga dia akan memukuli dengan kejam siapapun dari anak buahnya yang berani menyebut namanya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20142_DESCRIPTION
desc: A pirate captain notorious for her misdeeds along the Kingdom of Sarma’s coast. Whether swinging her frosty pole-sword or insulting her underlings with her icy tongue, Stya sent a chill down the spine of all whom she encountered. Her hatred for fellow sea-farer Captain Mega was so intense that she would dole out a vicious beating to any of her subordinates who so much as dared to mention his name.

raw.en: A pirate captain notorious for her misdeeds along the Kingdom of Sarma’s coast. Whether swinging her frosty pole-sword or insulting her underlings with her icy tongue, Stya sent a chill down the spine of all whom she encountered. Her hatred for fellow sea-farer Captain Mega was so intense that she would dole out a vicious beating to any of her subordinates who so much as dared to mention his name.
raw.es: Capitana pirata conocida por sus fechorías en la costa del reino de Sama. Stya era capaz de hacer estremecer a quien se cruzara con ella blandiendo su poderosa lanza de escarcha o insultando a sus lacayos con su gélido carácter. Odiaba al capitán Mega con tanto empeño que era capaz de dar una paliza a cualquier subordinado que se atreviera siquiera a mencionar su nombre.

raw.pt: Uma pirata notória por seus crimes ao longo da costa do Reino de Sarma. Atacando com uma fria espada dupla ou insultando seus subordinados com sua língua de gelo, Stya arrepia a espinha de todos os que a encontram. O ódio dela pelo Capitão Mega era tão intenso que ela surrava qualquer subordinado que ousasse ao menos citar o nome dele.
raw.th: กัปตันโจรสลัดผู้ฉาวโฉ่จากพฤษติกรรมชั่วร้ายของเธอตามแนวชายฝั่งของราชอาณาจักรซามะ ไม่ว่าจะกวัดเกว่งง้าวน้ำแข็งหรือพูดจากดขี่ลูกน้องด้วยวาจาเย็นชาดุจน้ำแข็ง สทีย่ามักจะทำให้ทุกคนที่ได้พบกับเธอหนาวไปจนถึงขั้วสันหลัง ความเกลียดชังของเธอที่มีต่อสหายนักเดินเรือ กัปตันเมก้า มันรุนแรงจนเธอจะสั่งเฆี่ยนตีลูกน้องของเธอคนใดก็ตามที่กล้าเอ่ยถึงชื่อของเขา
raw.vi: Cướp biển khét tiếng tại bờ biển vương quốc Sarma . Cho dù múa thanh kiếm sắc nhọn hay xúc phạm thuộc hạ của mình bằng lời nói lạnh lùng, Stya đều làm cho những người mình gặp ớn lạnh đến tận cột sống. Sự hận thù của cô đối với thuyền trưởng Mega mãnh liệt đến mức cô sẽ hành hạ tàn ác những ai dám nhắc đến tên của ông.

id: Kapten bajak laut yang terkenal karena perbuatan jahatnya di sepanjang pantai Kerajaan Sarma. Setelah mendengar berita bahwa musuh bebuyutannya Kapten Mega bergabung dengan angkatan laut, dia langsung membentuk kumpulan bajak laut untuk menyerang lebih dahulu. Dia memimpin dengan tangan besi dan juga kemampuannya untuk menghina secara kreatif, dan dicintai sebagai "putri" oleh pengikutnya. Katanya Kapten Mega yang terkenal pemberani melihat tampangnya yang dingin lalu lari menyelamatkan diri.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20143_DESCRIPTION
desc: A pirate captain notorious for her misdeeds along the Kingdom of Sarma’s coast. After hearing news that her arch-nemesis Captain Mega had joined the army, she immediately formed a band of pirates to launch a preemptory attack. She led with an iron fist as well as a predilection for creative insults, and was loved as a “princess” by those who followed her. Rumor has it that legendarily fearless Captain Mega took one look at her frosty visage before scarpering for safety.

After hearing news that her arch-nemesis Captain Mega had joined the army, she immediately formed a band of pirates to launch a preemptory attack. She led with an iron fist as well as a predilection for creative insults, and was loved as a “princess” by those who followed her. Rumor has it that legendarily fearless Captain Mega took one look at her frosty visage before scarpering for safety.
raw.es: Capitana pirata conocida por sus fechorías en la costa del reino de Sama. Tras oír la noticia de que su némesis, el capitán Mega, se había unido al ejército, Stya formó un tropel de piratas para lanzar un ataque preventivo. Dirigió a sus hombres con firmeza y predilección por los insultos creativos. Sus subordinados la tenían en alta estima por ser una "princesa" entre ellos. Cuentan que el legendario y valiente capitán Mega vio su gélido semblante antes de mandarse a mudar y buscar un lugar donde protegerse.

raw.pt: Uma pirata notória por seus crimes ao longo da costa do Reino de Sarma. Depois de ouvir a notícia de que seu arqui-inimigo, Capitão Mega, tinha entrado no exército, ela formou um bando de piratas imediatamente para lançar um ataque-surpresa. Ela liderou com punho de ferro, além de uma predileção por insultos criativos e era amada como uma “princesa” por quem a seguia. Dizem que o lendário e destemido Capitão Mega só deu uma olhada na aparência gélida dela antes de fugir para um lugar seguro.
raw.th: กัปตันโจรสลัดผู้ฉาวโฉ่จากพฤษติกรรมชั่วร้ายของเธอตามแนวชายฝั่งของราชอาณาจักรซามะ หลังจากได้ยินข่าวว่าศัตรูคู่แค้นตลอดกาลของเธอกัปตันเมก้าไปเข้าร่วมกับกองทัพเรือ เธอได้จัดตั้งกองทัพโจรสลัดสำหรับการโจมตีแบบไม่ให้ตั้งตัวโดยทันที เธอใช้กำลังขู่บังคับในขณะที่บางส่วนก็สมัครใจ เพราเจอคำดูถูกแบบสร้างสรรค์และเหล่าผู้ติดตามต่างก็รักเธอในฐานะ "เจ้าหญิง" มีเรื่องลือว่า กัปตันเมก้าในตำนานผู้ไร้ซึ่งความกลัวได้มองใบหน้าเย็นชาของเธอเพียงครั้งเดียว ก่อนจะรีบหนีไปยังที่ปลอดภัย
raw.vi: Cướp biển khét tiếng tại bờ biển đất nước Sarma . Sau khi nghe tin về kẻ thù của mình tức thuyền trưởng Mega cô đã gia nhập quân đội và ngay sau đó thành lập một đội cướp biển để bắt đầu cuộc tấn công. Cô dẫn đầu với một bàn tay sắt cũng như ưa thích những lời lăng mạ sáng tạo, và được những người đi theo đối  xử như một " công chúa ". Người ta đồn rằng thuyền trưởng Mega đã dũng cảm nhìn gương mặt băng giá của cô một lần trước khi chạy trốn để đảm bảo an toàn.

id: Bajak laut wanita yang punya reputasi jelek di Kerajaan Sama. Dia melanjutkan aktivitasnya sebagai bajak laut bahkan setelah para dewa menyerang sampai suatu hari ketika laksamana yang sangat dibencinya, Mega, datang meminta bantuan kepadanya. Setelah dia memarahi Mega habis-habisan, para dewa mulai menyerangnya. Mega langsung menyelamatkannya, tapi terluka parah. Melihat ini, Stya marah tak terbendung, meenghancurkan semua musuhnya sambil dia berkata, "Hutang harus selalu dibayar."
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20144_DESCRIPTION
desc: A female pirate with a bad reputation in the Sama Kingdom. She continued her pirate activities even after the gods invaded until one day when the commander which she so despised, Mega, came to her requesting her assistance in battle. Right after she showered him with anger the gods began attacking her. Mega rushed to save her but was gravely injured in the process. Seeing this, Stya became angry like she never had before, vanquishing all enemies around her as she said, "A debt must always be repaid."

raw.en: A female pirate with a bad reputation in the Sama Kingdom. She continued her pirate activities even after the gods invaded until one day when the commander which she so despised, Mega, came to her requesting her assistance in battle. Right after she showered him with anger the gods began attacking her. Mega rushed to save her but was gravely injured in the process. Seeing this, Stya became angry like she never had before, vanquishing all enemies around her as she said, "A debt must always be repaid."
raw.es: Una pirata con una mala reputación en el reino de Sama. Continuó sus actividades como pirata incluso luego de la invasión de los dioses, hasta el día en que el comandante a quien tanto despreciaba, Mega, le pidió ayuda en batalla. Tras expresar su ira para con Mega, los dioses comenzaron a atacarla. Mega se apresuró por salvarla, pero quedó gravemente herido. Al ver esto, la ira invadió a Stya como nunca antes. La pirata dijo "Nunca dejo una deuda sin pagar" y destruyó a todos los enemigos que la rodeaban.
raw.id: Bajak laut wanita yang punya reputasi jelek di Kerajaan Sama. Setelah dia memarahi Mega habis-habisan, para dewa mulai menyerangnya. Mega langsung menyelamatkannya, tapi terluka parah. Melihat ini, Stya marah tak terbendung, meenghancurkan semua musuhnya sambil dia berkata, "Hutang harus selalu dibayar."
raw.pt: Uma mulher pirata com má reputação no Reino de Sama. Ela continuou com as atividades de pirata mesmo depois da invasão dos deuses, até que um dia, Mega, o comandante que ela tanto desprezava, se aproximou dela pedindo ajuda na batalha. Logo depois de despejar toda sua ira no comandante, os deuses começaram a atacá-la. Mega correu para salvá-la mas foi gravemente ferido no processo. Ao ver isto, Stya se enfureceu como nunca havia se enfurecido e destruiu todos os inimigos ao redor enquanto dizia: “Dívidas sempre precisam ser pagas!”
raw.th: โจรสลัดสาวผู้มีชื่อเสียงที่เลวร้ายในราชอาณาจักรซามะ เธอยังคงทำตามวิถีของโจรสลัดต่อไปเรื่อยๆ แม้จะเป็นหลังจากที่เทพเจ้าได้เข้ามารุกรานแล้วก็ตาม จนกระทั่งวันหนึ่ง เมก้า ผู้บัญชาการซึ่งเธอเกลียดมากได้มาเพื่อขอร้องให้เธอไปช่วยเหลือในการต่อสู้ หลังจากที่เธอได้อาละวาดใส่เขาไป เทพเจ้าก็เริ่มการโจมตีใส่เธอ เมก้ารุดเข้าไปช่วยชีวิตเธอจนต้องบาดเจ็บสาหัส เมื่อได้เห็นดังนี้ สทีย่า ก็โกรธขึ้นมาในแบบที่เธอไม่เคยเป็นมาก่อนเลยในชีวิต เธอกำจัดศัตรูรอบๆ ตัวพร้อมกับพูดว่า "บุญคุณต้องทดแทน มีความแค้นก็ต้องชำระ"
raw.vi: Một nữ cướp biển có tai tiếng tại Vương quốc Sama Cô tiếp tục các hoạt động cướp biển của mình ngay cả sau khi các vị thần xâm lược cho đến tận một ngày khi vị tư lệnh mà cô rất khinh miệt, Mega, đã đến đề nghị cô hỗ trợ chiến đấu. Ngay sau khi cô trút lên anh sự giận dữ, các vị thần bắt đầu tấn công cô. Mega đã chạy đến cứu cô nhưng cũng vì thế mà anh bị thương nặng. Chứng kiến cảnh đó, Stya trở nên giận dữ chưa từng có khiến cô đánh bại tất cả các kẻ thù quanh cô như cô đã nói: "Nợ máu sẽ phải trả bằng máu".

id: Bajak laut wanita dengan reputasi buruk di Kerajaan Sama. Setelah Mega kalah dalam perang Stya menjadi tidak terkendali, bertarung melawan para dewa sambil terbawa kemarahan, dan akhirnya terpojokkan karena jumlah mereka yang banyak. Tapi, Mega, yang dikiranya meninggal, datang menyelamatkannya tepat waktu. Tanpa berkata 1 kata pun, dia menciumnya dan kembali ke kapalnya untuk memerintah krunya. Katanya sebagai ratu bajak laut, dia sangat cantik dipandang mata saat sedang memimpin kapalnya. Di pihak lain, gaya bertarungnya yang seperti setan ditakuti oleh para dewa sekalipun.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20145_DESCRIPTION
desc: A female pirate with a bad reputation in the Sama Kingdom. After Mega fell in battle Stya went berserk, fighting against the gods while consumed with rage, and eventually ending up cornered by their greater numbers. However, Mega, who she had presumed dead, came to her rescue just in time. Without saying a word, she gave him a kiss and then returned to her ship to give orders to her crew. Sin mediar palabra, Stya le dio un beso y regresó a su nave para ordenar a su tripulación. Se dice que la reina pirata se veía hermosa mientras comandaba su nave en cada batalla. raw.id: Bajak laut wanita dengan reputasi buruk di Kerajaan Sama. Setelah Mega kalah dalam perang Stya menjadi tidak terkendali, bertarung melawan para dewa sambil terbawa kemarahan, dan akhirnya terpojokkan karena jumlah mereka yang banyak. Tapi, Mega, yang dikiranya meninggal, datang menyelamatkannya tepat waktu. Tanpa berkata 1 kata pun, dia menciumnya dan kembali ke kapalnya untuk memerintah krunya. Katanya sebagai ratu bajak laut, dia sangat cantik dipandang mata saat sedang memimpin kapalnya. Di pihak lain, gaya bertarungnya yang seperti setan ditakuti oleh para dewa sekalipun.
raw.pt: Uma mulher pirata com má reputação no Reino de Sama. Porém, Mega, que parecia morto, voltou para resgatá-la na hora certa. Sem falar uma palavra, ela o beijou e depois voltou para seu navio para passar ordens á sua tripulação. Dizem que agindo como rainha pirata, era incrível vê-la no comando do navio. Por outro lado, sua luta de estilo demoníaco era temida até mesmo pelos deuses.
raw.th: โจรสลัดหญิงผู้มีชื่อเสียงเลวร้ายในราชอาณาจักรซามะ หลังจากที่เมก้าตายในสนามรบ สทีย่าก็เกิดคลั่งขึ้นมาและต่อสู้กับพวกเทพเจ้าขณะที่ถูกกลืนกินด้วยความโกรธ จนในที่สุดก็ต้องจนมุมต่อปริมาณของพวกนั้น อย่างไรก็ตาม เมก้า คนที่เธอคิดว่าตายไปแล้วได้เข้ามาช่วยเธอทันเวลาพอดี โดยที่ไม่พูดอะไร เธอมอบจูบให้กับเขาและจากนั้นก็กลับไปขึ้นเรือของเธอเพื่อออกคำสั่งแก่ลูกเรือของเธอ ว่ากันว่าในฐานะราชินีโจรสลัก เธอดูสวยงามขณะที่ออกคำสั่งบนเรือของเธอ ในขณะเดียวกัน สไตล์การต่อสู้ที่เหมือนกับปีศาจของเธอก็เป็นที่หวาดกลัวแม้กระทั่งจากพวกเทพเจ้าเองก็ตาม
raw.vi: Một nữ cướp biển có tai tiếng tại Vương quốc Sama Sau khi Mega tử trận, Stya đã nổi cáu, chiến đấu chống lại các vị thần với tâm trí đầy giận dữ và cuối cùng đã bị dồn vào chân tường bởi số lượng quân lớn hơn của họ. Tuy nhiên, Mega, người cô tưởng rằng đã chết, đã đến cứu cô đúng lúc. Không nói một lời nào, cô trao cho anh một nụ hôn và sau đó, trở về con tàu của cô để chỉ huy thủy thủ đoàn. Tương truyền rằng với tư cách là một nữ hoàng cướp biển, trông cô thật xinh đẹp khi chỉ huy tàu. Mặt khác, phong cách chiến đấu như một con quỷ của cô khiến ngay cả bản thân các vị thần cũng sợ hãi.

id: Anak perempuan dari aristokrat dari Kerajaan Sarma. Dia dikenal suka membaca, membaca catatan akademis dan bukannya buku bergambar pada masa kecilnya. Ketika dia berumur 15, dia mendapat buku yang ditulis dalam bahasa yang misterius, dan bersumpah suatu hari akan mengartikan isinya. Mendengar cerita tentang monumen batu terpencil yang ditulis dengan huruf yang mirip, dia berkelana ke tanah asing yang penuh monster, hanya dengan sihir yang dipelajarinya dari buku untuk melindunginya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20152_DESCRIPTION
desc: A daughter from an aristocratic family hailing from the Sama Kingdom. A fervent reader, she was known to read academic tomes instead of picture books as a child. When she was 15, she stumbled across a book written in a mysterious language, and swore to one day decipher its contents. Hearing tales of remote stone monuments inscribed with a similar-looking script, she embarked on a journey into unchartered lands teeming with monsters, with only the magic she had learned from her books to protect her.
