raw.th: อัลเคมิสต์ที่โด่งดังที่สุดในประวัติศาสตร์ ไม่ใช่อัลเคมิสต์ธรรมดาที่หมกตัวเองอยู่แต่ให้ห้องทดลอง, ริกเนสมักจะออกเดินทางผจญภัยเพื่อรวบรวมวัตถุดิบหายากสำหรับการทดลองของเขา วัตถุดิบหายากส่วนใหญ่ที่ใช้สร้างไอเทมต่างๆ ในทุกวันนี้ถูกตั้งชื่อโดยตัวของริกเนสเอง ไม่เพียงเท่านั้น, แต่ยังว่ากันว่าเขาได้รวบรวมข้อมูลมากมายเกี่ยวกับมอนสเตอร์ที่ไม่มีใครรุ้จักซึ่งอาศัยอยู่ในดินแดนส่วนลึกและยังไม่ได้รับการสำรวจ,ทำให้ปัจจุบันเขามีชื่อเสียงในฐานะนักเวทย์นักผจญภัยเช่นกัน สำหรับเขาแล้ว แม้กระทั้งมอนสเตอรืก็ยังเป็นขุมทรัพย์ในบรรดาวัตถุดิบล้ำค่า
raw.vi: Nhà giả kim nổi tiếng nhất trong lịch sử. Không phải nhà giả kim điển hình tự mắc kẹt trong phòng thí nghiệm, Rigness thường xuyên bước vào nhiều cuộc phiêu lưu để thu thập các vật liệu hiếm cho nghiên cứu của mình. Hầu hết các vật liệu hiếm được sử dụng để tạo ra nhiều vật phẩm khác nhau ngày nay do chính Rigness đặt tên. Không chỉ vậy, mà tương truyền rằng ông còn thu thập nhiều thông tin về các con quái vật chưa biết cư ngụ trong những vực sâu của các vùng chưa được khám phá, gần đây cũng đã đưa tên tuổi ông trở nên nổi tiếng là một nhà thám hiểm biết sử dụng ma thuật. Đối với ông, thậm chí một con quái vật là một kho tàng vật liệu có giá trị.

id: Alkimia yang paling terkenal dalam sejarah. Selagi Rigness pergi ke berbagai daerah untuk mengumpulkan materi, katanya dia menemukan keturunan dari ras dari dunia lain tinggal dalam reruntuhan. Tapi, karena reruntuhan itu penuh dengan makhluk mematikan, sihiarnya harus tumbuh lebih kuat untuk melanjutkan risetnya. Pada saat inilah dia menciptakan alat setan terkenalnya yang mampu menghindari malapetaka apa pun, dan menemukan keberadaan dari makhluk dunia lain itu. Ini dianggap sebagai buah dari risetnya selama bertahun-tahun.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20555_DESCRIPTION
desc: The most historically renowned alchemist. While Rigness traveled to different regions in order to gather materials, it is said that he discovered the descendants of some otherworldly race dwelling within some ruins. However, since the ruins where full of perilous creatures, his magic had to grow stronger in order to continue his research. It was at this point when he created his famous demon tool capable of avoiding any calamities, and discovered the existence of these otherworldly beings. This is considered to be the fruit of all of his long years of research.

raw.es: El alquimista más reconocido en la historia. Durante los viajes que Rigness llevó a cabo en distintas regiones mientras buscaba sus preciosos materiales, se dice que descubrió a los descendientes de una raza mística que habitaba en unas ruinas. Sin embargo, dado que las ruinas estaban infestadas de criaturas peligrosas, primero tuvo que fortalecer su magia para continuar con su investigación. En ese momento creó su famosa herramienta demoníaca capaz de evitar cualquier calamidad y descubrió la existencia de estos extraños seres. Se considera que ese fue el fruto de todos sus años de investigación.

No entanto, já que as ruínas eram cheias de criaturas perigosas, sua magia teve que se fortalecer para continuar a pesquisa. Foi nesse momento que ele criou sua famosa ferramenta demoníaca, capaz de evitar qualquer calamidade, e descobriu a existência dos seres de outro mundo. Esse é considerado o fruto de todos os anos de sua pesquisa.
raw.th: อัลเคมิสต์ที่โด่งดังที่สุดในประวัติศาสตร์ ขณะที่ริกเนสท่องเที่ยวดินแดนต่างๆ เพื่อรวบรวมวัตถุดิบ, ว่ากันว่าเขาได้ค้นพบผู้สืบเชื้อสายของเผ่าพันธุ์ต่างโลก ซึ่งอาศัยอยู่ในซากปรักหักพังแห่งหนึ่ง อย่างไรก็ตาม, ตั้งแต่ซากปรักหักพังที่เต็มไปด้วยสิ่งมีชีวิตที่เต็มไปด้วยอันตราย, เวทมนตร์ของเขาจำเป็นต้องเติบโตแข็งแกร่งขึ้นเพื่อที่จะได้ทำการค้นคว้าของเขาต่อไปได้ และในตอนนั้นเองเขาก้ได้สร้างเครื่องมือปีศาจที่โด่งดังของเขาซึ่งสามารถหลีกเลี่ยงทุกหายนะได้, และได้ค้นพบการมีตัวตนของสิ่งมีชีวิตต่างโลก นี่นับว่าเป็นผลผลิตจากการทำงานค้นคว้ามานานหลายปี
raw.vi: Nhà giả kim nổi tiếng nhất trong lịch sử. Trong khi Rigness du lịch đến nhiều vùng khác nhau để thu thập vật liệu, tương truyền rằng ông đã phát hiện ra các hậu duệ của một số chủng tộc ở thế giới khác cư ngụ trong một số tàn tích. Tuy nhiên, vì những tàn tích này chứa đầy các sinh vật nguy hiểm, ma thuật của ông phải phát triển mạnh hơn để tiếp tục nghiên cứu của mình. Chính vào thời điểm này ông đã tạo ra công cụ ma quỷ nổi tiếng có khả năng tránh bất kỳ tai họa nào và phát hiện ra sự tồn tại của những sinh vật của thế giới khác này. Điều này được coi là thành quả của tất cả những năm tháng dài nghiên cứu của ông.

id: Murid yang berkelana tanpa tuan. Katanya dia dulu bersumpah melayani seorang dewa, tapi nama dewa itu tidak lagi tercatat dalam sejarah. Ada juga gosip yang mengatakan bahwa dia mendapatkan kekuatannya dari bekas tuannya, membuat kekuatannya setara dengan dewa berpangkat tinggi. Selalu berjiwa bebas, Tazer menolak untuk menerima perintah dari para dewa, selalu bertindak sesukanya. Ini menyebabkan banyak dewa melihatnya sebagai ancaman terhadap kestabilan pemerintahan mereka. Sekarang nama Tazer hanya bisa ditemukan dalam sebagian kecil legenda yang diceritakan turun temurun.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20564_DESCRIPTION
desc: A wandering disciple with no real master. It is speculated that he had once sworn service to a certain god, but that god's name has been lost to history. There are also rumors which state that he inherited all of his powers from his former master, making his abilities equal to those of a high ranking god. Forever a free spirit, Tazer refused to take orders from the gods, always acting on his own accord. This caused many gods to view him as a threat to the stability of their practices. Nowadays Tazer's name can only be found in a handful of legends passed down through the ages.

raw.es: Un discípulo errante sin un verdadero maestro. Se especula que antaño sirvió a una deidad, si bien el nombre de dicho ser se ha perdido en el tiempo. También corren rumores de que heredó todos sus poderes de su antiguo maestro y que sus habilidades pueden compararse con las de un dios de alto rango. Tazer, un espíritu libre, se rehusó a recibir órdenes de los dioses y forjó su propio destino. Esto provocó que muchas deidades lo vieran como una amenaza para la estabilidad de sus prácticas. Ahora, su nombre solo puede encontrarse en leyendas que fueron legadas generación tras generación.

raw.pt: Um discípulo vagando sem um mestre real. Especula-se que ele já serviu um certo deus, mas o nome desse deus foi esquecido pela história. Também há rumores de que ele herdou todos os poderes de seu antigo mestre, deixando suas habilidades iguais às dos deuses mais fortes. Sempre um espírito livre, Tazer recusou-se a obedecer aos deuses, sempre agindo como queria. Isso fez com que muitos deuses o vissem como uma ameaça à estabilidade de suas práticas. Hoje em dia, o nome de Tazer só pode ser encontrado em algumas lendas do passado.
raw.th: สาวกพเนจรที่ไม่มีเจ้านายที่แท้จริง คาดการณ์กันว่าครั้งหนึ่งเขาเคยสาบานตนต่อเทพเจ้าตนหนึ่ง, แต่ชื่อของเทพเจ้าตนนั้นได้สูญหายไปจากประวืตศาสตร์ ยังมีข่าวลือว่าเขาได้สืบทอดพลังทั้งหมดมาจากอดีตเจ้านายของเขา, ทำให้ความสามารถของเขาเทียบเท่าเทพเจ้าชั้นสูง เป็นอิสระตลอดกาล, เทเซอร์ปฏิเสธที่จะรับคำสั่งจากทเพเจ้า, และทำตามใจปรารถนาอยู่เสมอ ทำให้เทพเจ้าต่างๆ มองเห็นเขาเป็นภัยต่อความั่นคง ทุกวันนี้ ชื่อของเทเซอร์สามารถพบเจอได้ในตำนานไม่กี่เรื่องที่ถูกเล่าขานต่อกันมาเท่านั้น
raw.vi: Một đệ tử lạc hướng không có chủ thực sự. Người ta suy đoán rằng anh từng thề phục vụ cho một vị thần nào đó, nhưng tên của vị thần đó không được lịch sử ghi chép lại. Cũng có những lời đồn nói rằng anh được thừa hưởng tất cả sức mạnh của mình từ chủ cũ, khiến khả năng của anh ngang bằng với những vị thần thứ hạng cao. Mãi mãi một tinh thần tự do, Tazer từ chối nhận lệnh từ các vị thần và luôn hành động theo cách của riêng mình. Điều này khiến nhiều vị thần xem anh là mối đe dọa đối với sự ổn định trong âm mưu của họ. Ngày nay, cái tên Tazer chỉ có thể tìm thấy trong một số ít các truyền thuyết được lưu truyền qua các thời đại.

id: Murid pengelana tanpa tuan. Satu-satunya teman Tazer menerima kemarahan Afla Dilith, yang lalu menyerap teman pengelananya ini. Setelah mengetahui kematian temannya, Tazer membuang sifat kalem dan tenangnya untuk mengejar Afla Dilith. Dia berhasil mendapatkan kembali kekuatan temannya yang dicuri ketika melawan Dewa Sesat itu, tapi diganggu oleh murid Zurg yang membuatnya tidak punya pilihan selain lari. Selagi dia lari dari pengejarnya berharap lukanya akan sembuh, dia didekati oleh dewa berpangkat lebih tinggi yang lalu menuntunnya maju.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20565_DESCRIPTION
desc: A wandering disciple with no real master. The only one true friend Tazer had incurred the wrath of Afla Dilith, who then absorbed his precious companion. After learning of his friend's death, Tazer tossed aside his usual calm and cool composure to go after Afla Dilith. He was successful in recovering the power that had been stolen from his friend when battling the Fallen God, but an interruption from the disciple Zurg left him no other choice but to flee. As he ran from his pursuer hoping his wounds would heal, he was approached by a higher ranking god who guided him forth.

raw.en: A wandering disciple with no real master. The only one true friend Tazer had incurred the wrath of Afla Dilith, who then absorbed his precious companion. After learning of his friend's death, Tazer tossed aside his usual calm and cool composure to go after Afla Dilith. He was successful in recovering the power that had been stolen from his friend when battling the Fallen God, but an interruption from the disciple Zurg left him no other choice but to flee. As he ran from his pursuer hoping his wounds would heal, he was approached by a higher ranking god who guided him forth.
raw.es: Un discípulo errante sin un verdadero maestro. El único amigo verdadero que tuvo Tazer enfureció a Afla Dilith, que terminó absorbiéndole el alma. Tras enterarse de la muerte de su amigo, Tazer dejó a un lado su comportamiento calmoso y flemático para perseguir a Afla Dilith. Tuvo éxito y logró recuperar el poder que le habían robado a su amigo en la lucha contra el Dios Caído, pero la llegada inesperada del discípulo Zurg no le dejó otra opción que escapar. Mientras huía de sus perseguidores esperando que sus heridas sanaran, un dios de alto rango se le acercó y lo guio.

raw.pt: Um discípulo vagando sem um mestre real. O único verdadeiro amigo Tazer provocou a ira de Afla Dilith, que destruiu seu grande companheiro. Após saber da morte de seu amigo, Tazer deixou de lado sua postura calma para ir atrás de Afla Dilith. Ele teve sucesso em recuperar o poder que foi roubado de seu amigo ao duelar com o Deus Caído, mas a aparição do discípulo Zurg não deixou escolha além de fugir. Enquanto fugia e torcia para se recuperar de seus ferimentos, ele foi abordado por um deus forte que o guiou.
raw.th: สาวกพเนจรที่ไม่มีเจ้านายที่แท้จริง เพื่อนที่แท้จริงเพียงคนเดียวของเขาตกเป็นเหยื่อของความพิโรธของอัฟล่า ดิลิธ,ผู้ที่ดูดกลืนสหายล้ำค่าของเขาไป หลังจากที่ได้ทราบเรื่องความตายของเพื่อ, เทเซอร์ทิ้งความใจเย็นของเขาและตามล่าอัฟล่า ดิลิธ เขาประทบความสำเร็จกับการทวงพลังที่ถูกขโมยไปจากเพื่อนของเขาคืนเมื่อได้ต่อสู้กับเทพมา, แต่การขัดขวางจากเซิร์กทำให้เขาไม่มีทางเลือกอื่นนอกจากหลบหนีไป ขณะที่เขาหนีจากผู้ไล่ล่าของเขาโดยหวังว่าแผลของเขาจะหาย, ก็มีเทพเจ้าชั้นสูงตนหนึ่งมาหาเขาและชี้นำทางให้
raw.vi: Một đệ tử lạc hướng không có chủ thực sự. Một người bạn thực sự duy nhất mà Tazer có đã làm Afla Dilith nổi cơn thịnh nộ và sau đó, Afla Dilith đã rút hết tinh khí người bạn quý hóa của anh. Sau khi biết về cái chết của bạn, Tazer đã bỏ đi sự bình tĩnh vốn có và hung hăng truy tìm Afla Dilith. Anh đã thành công trong việc thu hồi sức mạnh đã bị đánh cắp từ người bạn của anh khi chiến đấu với Đọa Lạc Chúa Thần này, nhưng sự cắt ngang của đệ tử Zurg đã khiến anh không có lựa chọn nào khác là phải trốn chạy. Khi anh chạy trốn khỏi kẻ theo đuổi mình với hy vong vết thương sẽ lành lại, một vị thần thứ hạng cao đã tìm đến anh để hướng dẫn anh thoát ra.

id: Murid yang disegel di Ishgria. Setelah terkena penghalang yang diciptakan oleh dewa berpangkat lebih tinggi, Tazer diserang oleh murid yang mempunyai guntur. Dengan menggunakan kekuatan temannya, yang baru saja didapatkannya kembali dari Afla Dilith, dia berhasil mengatasi serangan itu. Tapi, murid lain menyerangnya setelah itu, mengatakan mereka dalam kompetisi yang bertujuan memilih murid yang berhak mendapat kekuatan lebih banyak. Meskipun curiga akan perkataan murid itu, Tazer tetap ikut masuk dalam medan perang, tidak sadar bahwa dia akan disegel di mana dia berdiri.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20566_DESCRIPTION
desc: A disciple who was sealed in Ishgria. Having run into a barrier created by a higher ranking god, Tazer was attacked by a thunder wielding disciple. He used his friend's power, which he had just recovered from Afla Dilith, and managed to deal with the assault. However, another disciple attacked him promptly afterwards, stating that the situation they were in was a competition meant to select a disciple worthy of more power. Though suspicious of the disciple's words, Tazer jumped into the battlefield regardless, unaware that he would ultimately be sealed where he stood.

Though suspicious of the disciple's words, Tazer jumped into the battlefield regardless, unaware that he would ultimately be sealed where he stood.
raw.es: Un discípulo que terminó encerrado en Ishgria. Luego de entrar en una barrera creada por un dios de alto rango, un discípulo que blandía los truenos atacó a Tazer. Tazer usó el poder de su amigo, que acababa de recuperar de Afla Dilith, y lidió con el asalto. Sin embargo, de repente lo atacó otro discípulo que le dijo que todos se encontraban en una competencia para ver quién de ellos era digno de obtener más poder. Si bien sospechaba de sus palabras, Tazer saltó al campo de batalla luego de pensarlo un poco, sin saber que quedaría encerrado en el lugar.

raw.pt: Um antigo discípulo de Zevalhua que foi preso em Ishgria. Em uma barreira criada por um deus de alto escalão, Tazer foi atacado por um discípulo empunhando um trovão. Usando o poder de seu amigo, que ele havia recuperado de Afla Dilith, conseguiu lidar com o ataque. Porém, outro discípulo o atacou logo em seguida, declarando que a situação em que estavam era uma competição para selecionar o discípulo mais forte. Suspeito das palavras do discípulo, Tazer entrou na batalha sem medo, sem saber que seria preso onde ele estava.
raw.th: สาวกผู้ถูกผนึกในอิชเกรีย เทเซอร์ถูกโจมตีโดนสาวกผู้ใช้สายฟ้าเมื่อเขามาเจอกับม่านพลังที่สร้างขึ้นโดยเทพเจ้าระดับสูง เขาได้ใช้พลังของเพื่อนเขาที่พึ่งเอาคืนมาจากอัฟล่าดิลิธ, และสามารถรับมือกับการโจมตีได้ อย่างไรก็ตาม, สาวกอีกตนหนึ่งก็โจมตีเขาทันทีหลังจากนั้น, และกล่าวว่าสถานการณ์ที่พวกเขาอยู่ในตอนนี้คือการแข่งขันเพื่อหาตัวสาวกที่คู่ควรกับพลังมากที่สุด แม้จะสงสัยกับคำพูดของสาวกตนนั้น, เทเซอร์กระโดเข้าร่วมการต่อสู้โดยไม่สนใจอะไร, โดยที่ไม่รู้ว่าท้ายที่สุดเขาจะถูกผนึกอยู่ตรงที่ๆ เขายืนอยู่
raw.vi: Một đệ tử đã bị phong ấn tại Ishgria. Khi mắc vào rào chắn do một vị thần thứ hạng cao hơn tạo ra, Tazer đã bị tấn công bởi một đệ tử sử dụng lôi công. Anh đã dùng sức mạnh của bạn mình, mà anh vừa thu hồi được từ Afla Dilith và cố gắng đối phó với cuộc tấn công. Tuy nhiên, một đệ tử khác ngay sau đó đã tấn công anh, và tuyên bố rằng họ đang ở trong một cuộc cạnh tranh nhằm chọn ra một đệ tử xứng đáng có thêm sức mạnh. Mặc dù nghi ngờ về lời nói của đệ tử này, Tazer đã bất chấp nhảy vào chiến trường mà không biết rằng anh cuối cùng sẽ bị phong ấn tại nơi anh đứng.

id: One of the sacred Guardians of Meirith, who worshipped the Holy Emperor Karna Masta in the La Veda Republic. He is the younger twin brother of Claire, who also served as a Guardian. Taking great pride in being chosen by the gods themselves, Colt was always abrasive, but said to be gentle to the defenseless. He had a strong dislike for Quaid, another one of the Guardians. However, it is speculated that these feelings came as a form of jealousy that sprouted from the deep bond he shared with his twin sister. Curiously, he was also known to dislike small animals.

id: One of the sacred Guardians of Meirith. Before he was ordered to become a Guardian, he served as a knight of La Veda alongside his elder twin sister, Claire. However, he was considered a liability on the battlefield, and grew infamous amongst his peers. He was later bestowed with a blade of ice by Karna Masta himself, and sent to Ishgria on a demon slaying mission with the other Guardians. Completely different from his time as a knight, he learned how to best judge his choices on the battlefield, and protected his sister whilst in action. It is said he gradually became so powerful that he could even match the strength of a demon.

id: When Colt received word that a group of dissenters sought to destroy the Holy Emperor, he asked his partners to return to Grand Gaia with him. However, the group split up into factions, and only him, his sister, and Fadahl went back. Once home, Colt battled against those who meant to slay Karna Masta, but exhausted from his previous mission, soon found himself unable to release his full power. It is said that Claire fell trying to protect her brother, leaving her last words to him. However, he had already been at peace when he heard them, and never moved again.

id: Seorang prajurit tombak di Kerajaan Kecil Vriksha yang hancur, dia akhirnya menjadi satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Dia seorang pendiam dan baik hati, tapi suatu hari dia melihat Tombak Suci, Drevas, di gudang rumahnya. Tiba-tiba, dia memberi tahu keluarganya bahwa dia akan pergi berlatih. Orang tuanya menentangnya, tapi akhirnya dia melarikan diri dengan membawa Drevas. Katanya tombak itu berbicara padanya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30011_DESCRIPTION
desc: A pikeman from the ruined Principality of Vriksha, he eventually became one of the Six Heroes. He was a quiet, noble boy, but one day he saw the Demon Pike Drevas, lying in a storehouse on his estate. Suddenly, he informed his family he was leaving to train. His parents strongly opposed, but in the end he ran away, Drevas in hand. Rumors are that the spear spoke to him.

Sus padres se opusieron y el joven acabó huyendo y llevándose la lanza, con la que se dice que puede comunicarse.

Ele era um tranquilo filho da nobreza, mas um dia ele encontrou o Pique Demoníaco, Drevas, largado em um depósito da mansão. Subitamente ele informou sua família que estava partindo para treinar. Seus pais se opuseram fortemente, mas no final das contas ele fugiu, empunhando Drevas. Os rumores dizem que a lança falava com ele.
raw.th: พลหอกจากนครรัฐแห่งพฤกษาที่ล่มสลาย เขาได้กลายเป็นหนึ่งในหกวีรบุรุษในที่สุด เขาเป็นคนที่เงียบและเป็นเด็กดี แต่วันหนึ่งเขาเห็นหอกศักดิ์สิทธิ์ "เดรวาส" วางอยู่ที่ห้องเก็บของในบ้านของเขา ทันใดนั้นเขาก็ไปบอกให้ครอบครัวรับรู้ว่าเขาจะจากไปเพื่อฝึกฝน พ่อแม่ของเขาไม่เห็นด้วยอย่างมากแต่สุกท้ายเขาก็หนีไปพร้อมกับเดรวาสในมือ ลือกันว่าหอกนั้นได้พูดกับเขา
raw.vi: Một binh lính ở vùng Principality, Vriksha , cuối cùng ông đã trở thành một trong sáu anh hùng. Ông là một cậu bé ưu tú, ngoan ngoãn nhưng vào một ngày khi nhìn thấy Thần Pike , Drevas trong nhà kho, ông đột nhiên thông báo gia đình của mình rằng ông sẽ ra đi để học tập. Cha mẹ ông phản đối kịch liệt , nhưng trên hành trình của mình ông đã có Drevas bầu bạn. Người ta đồn rằng ngọn giáo đã nói chuyện với ông .

id: Seorang prajurit tombak di Kerajaan Kecil Vriksha yang hancur, dia akhirnya menjadi satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Mereka yang melawan Lance dalam latihannya, tidak hanya melihat kekuatan Drevas, tapi juga kagum dengan tekniknya yang tinggi. Teknik yang cantik  dari prajurit yang tidak berpengalaman membuatnya terlihat seperti jenius, tapi dia benci disebut demikian.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30012_DESCRIPTION
desc: A pikeman from the ruined Principality of Vriksha, he later became one of the Six Heroes. Those who faced Lance during his training not only saw the power of Drevas, but were also in awe of his superior technique. Seeing such beautiful technique from such an inexperienced pikeman made him seem almost genius, but he hated being referred to in this way.

Su talento lo hizo convertirse en un genio de la lanza, título que el joven llegó a odiar.

Ver uma técnica tão bela de um piqueiro tão inexperiente fez com que ele parecesse um gênio, mas ele odiava ser chamado dessa forma.
raw.th: พลหอกจากนครรัฐแห่งพฤกษาที่ล่มสลาย ภายหลังเขาได้กลายเป็นหนึ่งในหกวีรบุรุษ ใครก็ตามที่ต้องเผชิยหน้ากับ "แลนซ์" ในช่วงการฝึกของเขาจะไม่เพียงแต่ได้เจอกับพลังของเดรวาสแต่ยังต้องหวาดกลัวกับเทคนิคที่เหนือกว่าของเขาอีกด้วย การได้เห็นเทคนิคที่สวยงามจากพลหอกผู้ด้อยประสบการณ์เช่นนี้ทำให้เขาคล้ายจะเป็นอัจฉริยะ แต่เขาเกลียดที่จะถูกยกยอแบบนั้น
raw.vi: Một binh lính ở vùng Principality, Vriksha , sau này ông trở thành một trong sáu anh hùng. Những người đối mặt với Lance trong khi tập rượt không chỉ thấy được sức mạnh của Drevas mà còn kinh ngạc bởi khả năng vượt trội của ông . Nhìn những kỹ thuật đẹp mắt từ một binh lính thiếu kinh nghiệm khiến ông gần như trở thành thiên tài, nhưng ông ghét bị gọi theo cách này.

id: Seorang prajurit tombak di Kerajaan Kecil Vriksha yang hancur, pengguna Tombak Setan, Drevas. Akhirnya dia menjadi satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Dalam perjalanannya, dia berhasil membebaskan segel Pohon Dunia Altro. Meskipun tidak dikonfirmasi, katanya tujuannya dari awal adalah membebaskan Altro.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30013_DESCRIPTION
desc: A pikeman from the ruined Principality of Vriksha, wielder of the Demon Pike, Drevas. Later, he became one of the Six Heroes. During his travels, he managed to free the sealed away World Tree Altro. Though unconfirmed, it is said that freeing Altro was his objective from the very beginning.

raw.es: Lancero del antiguo principado de Vriksha, portador de la lanza sagrada Drevas y posterior miembro de los Seis Héroes. Durante sus viajes, logró liberar al sumo árbol Altro de su maldición. Hay quien dice que de hecho este fue su principal objetivo desde un principio.

raw.th: พลหอกจากนครรัฐแห่งพฤกษาที่ล่มสลายผู้ถือครองหอกปีศาจเดรวาส ภายหลังเขาได้กลายเป็นหนึ่งในหกวีรบุรุษ ในช่วงที่เขาเดินทาง เขาได้จัดการปลดผนึกออกจากต้นไม้โลก "อัลโทร" แม้จะยังไม่เป็นที่ยืนยัน ว่ากันว่าการปลดปล่อยอัลโทรนั้นเป็นเป้าหมายดั้งเดิมของเขามาตั้งแต่ต้น
raw.vi: Một binh lính ở vùng Principality, Vriksha , chủ nhân của quái vật Pike , Drevas . Sau này ông trở thành một trong sáu anh hùng . Trong cuộc hành trình của mình, ông cố gắn phá giải lời nguyền World Tree Altro . Mặc dù chưa chắc chắn nhưng người ta cho rằng phá giải Altro là mục tiêu của ông ngay lúc ban đầu .

id: Seorang prajurit tombak di Kerajaan Kecil Vriksha yang hancur, dan satu dari enam pahlawan. Setelah membebaskan Pohon Dunia, dia tidak terlihat sampai perang melawan dewa dimulai. Tombak Setan Drevas miliknya bangkit, dan pedangnya memiliki kekuatan Pohon Dunia. Dia melawan para dewa dengan kekuatannya sendiri, menolak untuk bergabung dengan militer manapun.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30014_DESCRIPTION
desc: A pikeman from the ruined Principality of Vriksha, and one of the six heroes. After releasing the World Tree he wasn't seen until the battle with the gods began. His Demon Pike Drevas had awoken, and its blade now carried the strength of the World Tree. He took on the gods with his own might, refusing to align himself with any military entity.

His Demon Pike Drevas had awoken, and its blade now carried the strength of the World Tree. He took on the gods with his own might, refusing to align himself with any military entity.
raw.es: Lancero del antiguo principado de Vriksha y uno de los Seis Héroes. Tras liberar al sumo árbol Altro no volvió a combatir hasta la guerra contra los dioses. El poder de su lanza sagrada Drevas despertó al combinarse con la magia de dicho árbol. Con ella se enfrentó a los dioses por su cuenta, negándose a aliarse con ningún ejército.

raw.pt: Um piqueiro do Principado arruinado de Vriksha, e um dos Seis Heróis. Após a libertação da Árvore do Mundo ele não foi visto novamente até o início da batalha contra os deuses. Seu Pique Demoníaco, Drevas, agora havia despertado, e sua lâmina carregava a força da Árvore do Mundo. Ele enfrentou os deuses por conta própria, recusando alianças com qualquer entidade militar.
raw.th: พลหอกจากนครรัฐแห่งพฤกษาที่ล่มสลายและหนึ่งในหกวีรบุรุษ หลังจากปลดปล่อยต้นไม้โลก เขาก็ไม่เป็นที่พบเห็นจนกระทั่งสงครามกับเทพเจ้าได้เริ่มต้น เดรวาสหอกปีศาจของเขาได้ตื่นขึ้นและคมของมันอาบด้วยพลังของต้นไม้โลก เขาล้มเทพเจ้าด้วยพลังของเขาเองและปฏิเสธที่จะรับใช้กองกำลังใดๆ
raw.vi: Một binh lính ở vùng Principality, Vriksha và một trong sáu anh hùng. Sau khi thoát khỏi lời nguyền World Tree, không ai nhìn thấy ông cho đến khi trận chiến với các vị thần bắt đầu . Quái vật Pike Drevas của ông đã tỉnh dậy và lưỡi của nó mang sức mạnh của tất cả các loài cây trên thế giới. Ông chiến đấu với các vị thần bằng sức mạnh của riêng mình; từ chối liên minh với bất kỳ tổ chức quân sự nào .

id: Jago tombak dari reruntuhan Kerajaan Vriksha, dan salah satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Terus berjuang demi massa dengan Tombak Setan Drevas. Semakin kuat dan tajam, ia mulai dimakan oleh Drevas. Meski ada kutukan di tombak yang mengasimilasi pemegangnya dengan alam, Lance tidak menahan diri dari bertempur. Sepertinya ia malah mengantisipasi perubahan.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30015_DESCRIPTION
desc: A pikeman from the ruined Principality of Vriksha, and one of the Six Heroes. He kept fighting for the masses with his Demon Pike Drevas. As he grew stronger and sharper, he started being consumed by Drevas. Despite there being a curse on the pike assimilates its wielder with nature, Lance didn't refrain from fighting. He seemed to be anticipating the change instead.

raw.en: A pikeman from the ruined Principality of Vriksha, and one of the Six Heroes. He kept fighting for the masses with his Demon Pike Drevas. As he grew stronger and sharper, he started being consumed by Drevas. Despite there being a curse on the pike assimilates its wielder with nature, Lance didn't refrain from fighting. He seemed to be anticipating the change instead.
raw.es: Piquero del antiguo principado de Vriksha, miembro de los Seis héroes. Continuó luchando para las masas con Drevas, su pico demoníaco. Cuando aumentó su agudeza y su fuerza, Drevas comenzó a consumir a Lance. A pesar de que una maldición hacía que el portador del pico se asimilara con la naturaleza, Lance no dejó de pelear. Parecía estar anticipándose al cambio.

raw.pt: Um piqueiro do Principado arruinado de Vriksha, e um dos Seis Heróis. Ele continuou lutando pelas massas com seu Pique-Demônio Drevas. Conforme ficava mais forte e afiado, ele começou a ser consumido por Drevas. Apesar da maldição no pique que mesclava seu portador à natureza, Lance não se conteve na luta. Ao invés disso, ele parecia ansioso pela mudança.
raw.th: พลหอกจากนครรัฐแห่งพฤกษาที่ล่มสลายและหนึ่งในหกวีรบุรุษ เขายังคงต่อสู้เพื่อมวลชนด้วยหอกปีศาจเดรวาส ขณะที่เขาโตขึ้นและคมขึ้นเขาก็เริ่มถูกเดรวาสกลืนกิน แม้ว่าจะเป็นหอกต้องสาบที่ดูดกลืนผู้ใช้เข้าสู่ธรรมชาติ แลนซ์ไม่ได้ละเว้นจากการต่อสู้เลย ดูเหมือนว่าเขาจะคาดหวังความเปลี่ยนแปลงแทน
raw.vi: Một chiến binh dùng giáo đến từ Xứ Vriksha đổ nát và là một trong Sáu vị anh hùng. Anh đã chiến đấu vì nhân dân cùng với Cây giáo ma quỷ Drevas. Khi anh lớn mạnh hơn và sắc bén hơn, anh bắt đầu bị Drevas hấp thụ tinh khí. Mặc dù có một lời nguyền trên cây giáo sẽ đồng hóa với chủ nhân của nó với thiên nhiên, Lance đã không ngừng chiến đấu. Thay vào đó, anh dường như biết trước sự thay đổi.

id: Selagi tetap bertarung bersama para dewa, Tombak Setan milik Lance memakan badan Lance lebih jauh. Di tengah semua itu, Lance melepaskan kekuatan terkuat tombak itu dan melemparkannya jauh untuk bertahan atas serangan penembak jitu dari jauh yang terus menyerangnya. Dan meskipun serangannya berhasil mengalahkan penembak jitu itu, serangan itu mempercepat Tombak Setan itu menghancurkan tubuhnya. Sesaat setelah itu, seorang ksatria muncul di hadapannya untuk menyampaikan pesan. Katanya ekspresi wajahnya menunjukkan kelegaan ketika mendengarkan kata-kata ksatria itu, setelah itu dia berubah menjadi pohon besar sambil memeluk Tombak Setan.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30016_DESCRIPTION
desc: As he kept fighting the gods, Lance's Demon Pike ate into his body even further. In the midst of everything, Lance unleashed his pike's ultimate power and flung it across a great distance in order to defend himself from a series of sniper attacks that had been continuously targeting him. And though this attack was successful in taking down the sniper, it consequently sped up the rate at which the Demon Pike was deteriorating his body. Moments later, a lone knight showed himself before him to deliver a message. It is said that an expression of relief came over Lance's face upon hearing the knight's words, after which he turned into a great tree whilst embracing the Demon Pike.

raw.en: As he kept fighting the gods, Lance's Demon Pike ate into his body even further. In the midst of everything, Lance unleashed his pike's ultimate power and flung it across a great distance in order to defend himself from a series of sniper attacks that had been continuously targeting him. And though this attack was successful in taking down the sniper, it consequently sped up the rate at which the Demon Pike was deteriorating his body. Moments later, a lone knight showed himself before him to deliver a message. It is said that an expression of relief came over Lance's face upon hearing the knight's words, after which he turned into a great tree whilst embracing the Demon Pike.
raw.es: Mientras combatía a los dioses, la lanza demoníaca de Lance le devoró el cuerpo y más. En medio del caos, Lance desató el poder máximo de su lanza y atravesó grandes distancias por el aire para protegerse de los ataques de un supuesto francotirador del que había sido objetivo. Si bien con su ataque logró derribar al francotirador, esto aceleró el proceso en que la lanza demoníaca le deterioraba el cuerpo. Momentos después, un caballero solitario apareció frente a él y le entregó un mensaje. Se dice que en el rostro de Lance se dibujó una expresión de alivio tras escuchar las palabras del caballero, y que se transformó en un árbol verde mientras abrazaba su lanza demoníaca.

Dan meskipun serangannya berhasil mengalahkan penembak jitu itu, serangan itu mempercepat Tombak Setan itu menghancurkan tubuhnya. Sesaat setelah itu, seorang ksatria muncul di hadapannya untuk menyampaikan pesan. Katanya ekspresi wajahnya menunjukkan kelegaan ketika mendengarkan kata-kata ksatria itu, setelah itu dia berubah menjadi pohon besar sambil memeluk Tombak Setan.
raw.pt: Como ele continuou lutando contra os deuses, a lança de Lance o consumiu ainda mais. Em meio a tudo, Lance liberou um último poder de sua lança e a arremessou longe para se defender de uma série continua de ataques de um fuzileiro. E ainda que seu ataque tenha derrubado o fuzileiro, como consequência a Lança Demoníaca deteriorava seu corpo mais rapidamente. Pouco tempo depois, um cavaleiro apareceu e entregou uma mensagem. Dizem que uma expressão de alívio apareceu em seu rosto ao ouvir as palavras do cavaleiro, e logo depois ele se tornou uma árvore enquanto abraçava a Lança Demoníaca.
raw.th: ขณะต่อสู้กับเทพ หอกปีศาจของแลนซ์ได้กัดกินร่างของเขา และจากศูนย์กลางของทุกสรรพสิ่ง ทำให้แลนซ์ปลดปล่อยพลังขั้นสูงสุดของหอกออกมา และขว้างมันออกไปไกลเพื่อกำจัดสไนเปอร์ที่กำลังเล็งเป้ามาที่เขา แต่ยิ่งใช้หอกนี้มากเท่าไร ร่างกายของเขาก็ยิ่งทรุดโทรมมากขึ้นเท่านั้น ในเวลาต่อมา อัศวินผู้หนึ่งปรากฎกายขึ้นเพื่อส่งสาร ว่ากันว่าความรู้สึกเชื่อมั่นปรากฎชัดบนใบหน้าของแลนซ์เมื่อได้ยินคำพูดของอัศวิน จากนั้นร่างของเขาก็กลายเป็นต้นไม้ใหญ่โดยโอบกอดหอกปีศาจไว้ด้วย
raw.vi: Khi tiếp tục đánh nhau với các vị thần, cây Ma thương của Lance đã ăn sâu vào cơ thể của anh hơn nữa. Giữa mọi việc, Lance đã tung ra sức mạnh tối thượng của cây thương và phóng nó qua một khoảng cách rất xa để bảo vệ bản thân khỏi một loạt các đòn tấn công bắn tỉa liên tục nhắm vào anh. Và mặc dù đòn tấn công này thành công trong việc hạ gục tay bắn tỉa đó, nhưng hậu quả là nó đã tăng tốc lên tốc độ mà cây Ma thương đã làm hỏng cơ thể anh. Một lúc sau, một hiệp sĩ đơn độc xuất hiện trước mặt anh để đưa một thông điệp. Tương truyền rằng vẻ mặt của Lance trở nên nhẹ nhõm sau khi nghe những lời của hiệp sĩ nói, sau đó anh trở thành một cây đại thụ trong khi ôm lấy cây Ma thương.

id: Pemburu yang tinggal di hutan di pinggiran Kerajaan Kecil Vriksha. Dia terkenal di daerahnya sebagai ahli pemanah, banyak yang berkunjung untuk melihat keahliannya. Dia juga suka bersombong, dan selalu senang menunjukkan kemampuannya. Suatu hari dia diundang ke istana darI Kerajaan Kecil, katanya ini mengubah nasibnya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30021_DESCRIPTION
desc: A hunter living in the forest on the outskirts of the Principality of Vriksha. As he was locally famous as an expert bowman, many visited from afar to witness his skills. He also liked to show off, and was always happy to demonstrate his abilities. One day he was invited to the palace of the Principality. it is said this incident changed his fate.

raw.es: Cazador que vivía en el bosque a las afueras del principado de Vriksha. Conocido por sus dotes con el arco, muchos solían visitarlo solo para ver su puntería. Para él era todo un placer, puesto que le encantaba presumir. Su destino cambió completamente el día en que el duque del principado lo invitó a su palacio.

Ele também gostava de se exibir, e sempre gostava de demonstrar suas habilidades. Um dia ele foi convidado ao palácio do Principado. Dizem que esse incidente mudou seu destino.
raw.th: นายพรานผู้อาศัยอยู่ในป่าชานเมืองของนครรัฐแห่งพฤกษา เขาโด่งดังในพื้นที่นี้เพราะความชำนาญด้านธนู หลายคนเดินทางมาไกลเพื่อชมทักษะของเขาและเขาเองก็ชอบสาธิตความสามารถของเขาโชว์ด้วยเช่นกัน วันหนึ่งเขาถูกเชิญไปยังวังแห่งนครรัฐ ว่ากันว่าเหตุการณ์นี้เปลี่ยนแปลงชะตาชีวิตของเขา
raw.vi: Một thợ săn sống trong rừng ở vùng ngoại ô vùng Principality, Vriksha . Ông nổi tiếng là một cung thủ xuất sắc tại vùng , rất nhiều người ở  xa đến đây chỉ để chứng kiến ​​tài năng của ông . Ông cũng thích khoe khoang và rất hạnh phúc khi chứng minh khả năng của mình . Một ngày nọ ông được mời đến cung điện Principality  và người ta nói sự kiện này đã thay đổi số phận của ông .

id: Pemburu yang tinggal di hutan di pinggiran Kerajaan Kecil Vriksha. Dia adalah pemanah terkenal yang nasibnya berubah ketika dia diundang ke istana duke, di mana seorang putri tertarik padanya. Lario menyukai perhatian ini, meskipun hidup militer sangat tidak sesuai untuknya. Tapi dia membuktikan kemampuannya dan menjadi pemimpin di pasukannya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30022_DESCRIPTION
desc: A hunter living in the forest on the outskirts of the Principality of Vriksha. He was a famous archer whose fate changed when he was invited to the duke's palace, where a princess took interest in him. Lario liked the recognition, despite how poorly military life suited him. However, he proved his worth and found himself a leader among its ranks.

raw.es: Cazador que vivía en el bosque a las afueras del principado de Vriksha. Su fama de talentoso arquero hizo que el duque lo invitara a palacio donde una de las princesas del principado se interesó por él y le ofreció un puesto en su ejército. El joven aceptó a regañadientes y acabó convirtiéndose en líder del resto de soldados del cuerpo.

raw.pt: Um caçador vivendo nas florestas acerca do Principado de Vriksha. Ele era um arqueiro famoso cujo destino mudou quando ele foi convidado ao palácio do Duque, onde uma princesa se interessou por ele. Lario gostou do reconhecimento, apesar do quão inadequada era para ele a vida militar. Entretanto, ele provou seu valor e descobriu ser um líder entre suas fileiras.
raw.th: นายพรานผู้อาศัยอยู่ในป่าชานเมืองของนครรัฐแห่งพฤกษา เขาเป็นนักธนูเลื่องชื่อที่ชะตาชีวิตต้องเปลี่ยนไปหลังจากที่เขาถูกเชิญมาที่วังของดยุค ซึ่งเจ้าหญิงได้เริ่มสนใจในตัวเขา ลาริโอชอบการยอมรับแม่ว่าชีวิตในกองทัพจะไม่เหมาะกับเขา แต่เขาก็พิสูจน์ตัวเองว่ามีคุณค่าและเป็นผู้นำที่เหมาะสม
raw.vi: Một thợ săn sống trong rừng ở vùng ngoại ô Principality, Vriksha . Anh là một cung thủ nổi tiếng và là người có số phận thay đổi khi được mời đến cung điện của công tước, nơi nàng công chúa rất quan tâm đến anh . Lario thích được nhận ra dù đời sống quân đội làm anh trông tiều tụy như thế nào. Tuy nhiên , ông đã chứng minh giá trị của mình và nhận thấy mình là một nhà lãnh đạo ở tầng lớp đó.

id: Bekas pemburu, Lario adalah pemanah terkenal dan memimpin pemanah sebagai pengawal putri kedua Kerajaan Kecil Vriksha. Dia sukses di militer dan digosipkan adalah pacar putri, tapi dia bermimpi untuk kembali ke kehidupannya yang bebas sebagai pemburu. Tapi, dia tidak pernah mewujudkan mimpinya dan terus melindungi sang putri sampai kolaps besar.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30023_DESCRIPTION
desc: A former hunter, Lario was an expert archer and lead bow for the Principality of Vriksha's second princess' bodyguards. He was successful in the military and rumored to be the princess' lover, but he dreamed of returning to his carefree hunter's life. However, he never got his wish and continued to protect the princess until the time of the great collapse.

raw.en: A former hunter, Lario was an expert archer and lead bow for the Principality of Vriksha's second princess' bodyguards. He was successful in the military and rumored to be the princess' lover, but he dreamed of returning to his carefree hunter's life. However, he never got his wish and continued to protect the princess until the time of the great collapse.
raw.es: Antiguo cazador y jefe arquero del cuerpo de guardas de la segunda princesa de Vriksha. Una vez en el ejército, se hizo famoso y corre el rumor de que se convirtió en amante de la princesa, pero su verdadero sueño era volver a ser libre como cazador. Sueño que no pudo cumplir, ya que siguió protegiendo a la princesa hasta la llegada del gran colapso.

raw.pt: Um antigo caçador, Lario era um arqueiro exímio e principal arco a serviço dos guarda-costas da segunda princesa do Principado de Vriksha. Ele teve sucesso na vida militar, e rumores dizem que ele era o amante da princesa, mas ele sonhava com o retorno à sua vida despreocupada de caçador. Entretanto, ele nunca conseguiu seu desejo e continuou a proteger a princesa até a hora do grande colapso.
raw.th: อดีตนายพราน ลารริโอเนนักธนูผู้ชำนาญและมือธนูผู้คุ้มครองขององค์หญิงอันดับที่สองแห่งนครรัฐพฤกษา เขาประสบความสำเร็จในกองทัพและมีข่าวลือว่าเป็นคนรักของเจ้าหญิงด้วย แต่เขาก็ยังฝันจะกลับไปใช้ชีวิตพรานป่าที่ไม่ต้องคอยกังวลอะไร อย่างไรก็ตามเขาไม่เคยได้ตามที่เขาปรารถนาและยังคงปกป้องเจ้าหญิงต่อไปจนกระทั่งถึงช่วงการล่มสลายครั้งใหญ่
raw.vi: Là thợ săn,  Lario là một cung thủ xuất sắc và lãnh đạo các vệ sĩ bảo vệ công chúa thứ hai của Vriksha . Ông thành công trong quân đội và được đồn là người tình của công chúa nhưng ông lại mơ ước được trở lại cuộc sống săn bắn vô tư của mình . Tuy nhiên , ông không bao giờ đạt được ước muốn đó và tiếp tục bảo vệ công chúa cho đến khi vương quốc sụp đổ .

id: Pemanah terkenal dan pemimpin pasukan putri kedua kerajaan Vrishka. Hampir kolaps dari serangan para dewa, Lario lari dari kastel, membawa sang ptri. Namun para dewa mengejar dan memblokir jalan. Menyaksikan pertahanan Lario dan perasaan bahwa dirinya adalah beban bagi Lario, sang putri mencoba menyerahkan diri. Agar sang putri tidak begitu, katanya Lario mengeluarkan sayap dari punggungnya dan menerbangkan sang putri bersamanya ke tempat aman.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30024_DESCRIPTION
desc: A famous archer and leader of Vriksha's second princess' bodyguards. On the verge of collapse from the gods' oncoming attacks, Lario fled the castle, taking the princess with him. However, the gods pursued them and blocked their path. Witnessing Lario's defiant resistance and feeling that she had become a burden to him, the princess attempted to give herself up. To keep her from doing so, it is said that Lario then sprouted wings from his back and flew the two of them away to safety.

raw.en: A famous archer and leader of Vriksha's second princess' bodyguards. On the verge of collapse from the gods' oncoming attacks, Lario fled the castle, taking the princess with him. However, the gods pursued them and blocked their path. Witnessing Lario's defiant resistance and feeling that she had become a burden to him, the princess attempted to give herself up. To keep her from doing so, it is said that Lario then sprouted wings from his back and flew the two of them away to safety.
raw.es: Famoso arquero, líder de los guardaespaldas de la segunda princesa de Vriksha. Cuando el castillo estaba a punto de colapsar debido a los embates de los dioses, Lario huyó y se llevó a la princesa con él. Sin embargo, los dioses los persiguieron y bloquearon el camino. La princesa fue testigo de la desafiante resistencia de Lario y sintió que se había convertido en una carga para él, por lo que intentó entregarse. En afán de impedir que la princesa se entregara, se dice que a Lario le crecieron alas en la espalda y que voló con la emperatriz hacia una zona segura.

raw.pt: Um arqueiro de Vriksha que lutou ao lado do exército de duendes durante a grande guerra com os deuses. Ele morreu enquanto protegia a princesa Faris e foi reanimado pela magia dos duendes. Quando acordou, ele viu um lado diferente da princesa, lutando mão a mão com os duendes. Enquanto sorria, Lario se ergueu para lutar por ele mesmo, não mais sob o comando de ninguém. Dizem que os duendes o presentearam seu adorado arco, “Sfida”, com novos poderes.
raw.th: นักธนูผู้โด่งดังและหัวหน้าหน่วยอารักขาองค์หญิงที่สองของนครรัฐแห่งพฤกษา บนปากเหวของการล่มสลายจากการโจมตีของเทพเจ้า ลาริโอหนีออกจากปราสาทพร้อมกับพาองค์หญิงไปด้วย อย่างไรก็ตาม เทพเจ้าตามล่าพวกเขาและเข้ามาขวางทาง เมื่อเห็นการต่อสู้ขัดขืนอย่างกล้าหาญของลาริโอและรู้สึกว่าเธอนั้นเป็นภาระให้เขา องค์หญิงพยายามจะจบชีวิตตัวเอง และเพื่อป้องกันไม่ให้เธอทำแบบนั้นได้ ว่ากันว่าลาริโอได้งอกปีกออกมาจากที่หลังของเขา และพาองค์หญิงบินหนีไปยังที่ปลอดภัย
raw.vi: Một cung thủ nổi tiếng và lãnh đạo đội vệ sĩ bảo vệ công chúa thứ hai của Vrishka. Đứng trước bờ vực của sự sụp đổ đến từ những cuộc tấn công sắp tới của các vị thần, Lario đã bỏ chạy khỏi lâu đài, mang theo công chúa. Tuy nhiên, các vị thần đã đuổi theo và chặn đường họ. Chứng kiến sự kháng cự đầy thách thức của Lario và cảm thấy cô trở thành gánh nặng cho ông, công chúa đã tìm cách tự tử. Để giữ cô khỏi làm như vậy, người ta nói rằng sau đó Lario đã mọc thêm đôi cánh trên lưng và đưa hai người bay đến nơi an toàn.

id: Pemanah dari Vriksha yang bertarung bersama tentara pixy selama perang besar dengan para dew. Meski jatuh saat melindungi Putri Faris, ia dihidupkan kembali dengan sihir pixy. Begitu bangun, ia melihat sisi lain dari si putri yang bertarung bersama pixy. Tersenyum, Lario bangkit untuk bertarung atas kehendak sendiri, tidak lagi dikomando siapa pun. Katanya pixy telah memberi busur tercinta Lario, "Sfida", dengan kekuatan baru.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30025_DESCRIPTION
desc: An archer from Vriksha who fought alongside the pixy army during the great war with the gods. Though he had fallen while protecting Princess Faris, he was brought back to life by the magic of the pixies. Once awake, he saw before him a completely different side of the princess fighting hand in hand with the pixies. While smiling gently, Lario rose to fight of his own will, no longer under the command of any being. And so it is said that the pixies gifted Lario's beloved bow "Sfida" with new powers.

raw.es: Arquero proveniente de Vriksha que luchó junto al ejército de elfos durante la gran guerra contra los dioses. Si bien había caído mientras protegía a la princesa Faris, revivió gracias a la magia de los elfos. Cuando abrió los ojos, contempló un lado completamente diferente de la princesa, que ahora luchaba codo a codo con los elfos. Lario esbozó una gran sonrisa y se levantó para luchar por voluntad propia, sin tener que seguir las órdenes de ningún ser. Y así fue que los elfos insuflaron a Sfida, el amado arco de Lario, con nuevos poderes.

Once awake, he saw before him a completely different side of the princess fighting hand in hand with the pixies. raw.th: นักธนูจากพฤกษาผู้ต่อสู้เคียงข้างกองทัพพิกซี่ระหว่างสงครามครั้งใหญ่กับเทพเจ้า แม้ว่าเขาจะตายไปขณะที่กำลังปกป้องเจ้าหญิงฟาริส เขาถูกทำให้ฟื้นคืนชีพด้วยเวทมนตร์ของพิกซี่ เมื่อตื่นขึ้นมา เบื้องหน้าเขาได้เห็นอีกด้านที่ต่างไปโดยสิ้นเชิงของเจ้าหญิง ต่อสู้ร่วมมือกับพิกซี่ พร้อมด้วยรอยยิ้มที่อ่อนโยน ลาริโอลุกขึ้นมาต่อสู้ด้วยเจตจำนงค์ของตนเอง ไม่อยู่ภายใต้คำสั่งของผู้ใดอีก และว่ากันว่า พิกซี่ ได้มอบของขวัญให้ธนูสุดรักของลาริโอ "สฟิดา" ด้วยพลังใหม่
raw.vi: Một cung thủ đến từ Vriksha người đã chiến đấu cùng với đội quân tiên trong cuộc đại chiến với các vị thần. Mặc dù anh đã ngã xuống khi bảo vệ Công chúa Faris, nhưng anh đã được hồi sinh nhờ phép thuật của các vị tiên. Khi tỉnh dậy, anh thấy trước anh một mặt hoàn toàn khác của công chúa đang sát cánh chiến đấu cùng với các vị tiên. Trong khi mỉm cười dịu dàng, Lario đã đứng dậy chiến đấu bằng ý chí của mình, không còn theo lệnh của bất kỳ ai. Và vì vậy, tương truyền rằng các vị tiên đã tặng cho cây cung yêu quý của Lario "Sfida" những sức mạnh mới.

id: Setan tipe air dengan daun muncul di kepalanya, dilahirkan dari getah pohon besar. Selalu ingin tahu dan lapar. Banyak cerita tentang Mossy tiba-tiba bergabung dengan orang yang berjalan melalui hutan. Tapi, dia harus diusir cepat-ceppat karena selalu mengincar makanan. Pangkat terendah dari para setan, dia adalah lawan tarung yang cocok untuk Pemanggil baru.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30030_DESCRIPTION
desc: A liquid-type demon with leaves sprouting from its head, born from the sap of a massive tree. It is curious and always hungry. There are many tales of Mossy suddenly joining those who walk through the forest. However, it should be driven away quickly since it is always after food. The lowest ranked of the demons, it is a perfect sparring partner for new Summoners.

The lowest ranked of the demons, it is a perfect sparring partner for new Summoners.
raw.es: Una criatura con hojas en la cabeza que surgió de la savia de un enorme árbol. Es curioso y siempre tiene hambre. Existen multitud de historias sobre cómo se une a todo aquel que se encuentra en un bosque. A la larga es mejor echarlos del grupo ya que tienen un estómago insaciable. Forma parte de las unidades más básicas, pero es el compañero ideal de los invocadores novatos.

raw.pt: Um demônio do tipo líquido com folhas saindo de sua cabeça, nascido da seiva de uma árvore massiva. Ele é curioso e está sempre com fome. Existem muitos relatos de Mossy se juntando subitamente àqueles que caminham pela floresta. Entretanto, eles deveriam ser afastados logo já que sempre buscam por comida. Um demônio do menor escalão, um parceiro perfeito para novos Invocadores treinarem.
raw.th: ปีศาจชนิดของเหลวที่มีใบไม้งอกมาบนหัว เกิดมาจากยางไม้ของต้นไม้ยักษ์ มันช่างสงสัยและหิวอยู่ตลอดเวลา มันมีเรื่องเล่ามากมายเกี่ยวกับ "มอสซี่" ที่จู่ๆ ก็โผล่มาร่วมทางกับคนที่เดินทางผ่านป่า อย่างไรก็ดี ควรจะไล่ไปให้พ้นเสียเพราะว่าพวกมันมักตามมาเพื่ออาหารเท่านั้น เป็นปีศาจระดับต่ำสุดและคู่ซ้อมชั้นดีสำหรับซัมมอนเนอร์มือใหม่
raw.vi: Một loài quái vật có lá mọc trên đầu, được sinh ra từ nhựa của một loại cây lớn. Nó rất kỳ lạ và luôn luôn đói. Có rất nhiều câu chuyện kể rằng Mossy đột nhiên nhập vào những người đi bộ qua rừng. Tuy nhiên, nó sẽ bỏ đi một cách nhanh chóng vì lúc nào nó cũng tìm kiếm thức ăn. Nó thuộc hàng thấp nhất trong các quái vật nhưng lại là một người bạn hoàn hảo cho những người triệu hồi mới .

id: Setelah perut Mossy yang besar penuh, katanya dia berubah menjadi Raja Mossy. Karena badannya yang besar, nafsu makannya tumbuh lebih besar. Sering pergi ke pemukiman manusia untuk mencari makanan. Orang dewasa menghindarinya karena dia kuat sebagai monster berbahaya, tapi entah kenapa populer dengan anak-anak. Dia mengendap-endap ke pertanian dengan bentuk semak yang sangat besar untuk mencuri tanaman, memberi masalah kepada petani.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30031_DESCRIPTION
desc: After Mossy's bottomless stomach is full, it's said to evolve into King Mossy. Due to its huge body, its appetite grows even larger. It often goes to human settlements looking for food. Adults avoid it because it's though of as a harmful beast, but it's somehow popular with children. It sneaks onto farms shaped as an overgrown bush to steal crops, causing trouble for farmers.

raw.en: After Mossy's bottomless stomach is full, it's said to evolve into King Mossy. Due to its huge body, its appetite grows even larger. It often goes to human settlements looking for food. Adults avoid it because it's though of as a harmful beast, but it's somehow popular with children. It sneaks onto farms shaped as an overgrown bush to steal crops, causing trouble for farmers.
raw.es: Cuando Musgoso calma su insaciable hambre se convierte en el rey Musgoso, un ser con un apetito aún mayor que suele atacar campamentos en busca de comida. Los adultos suelen evitarlo porque lo consideran peligroso, aunque tiene bastante buena fama con los niños. Suele colarse en granjas camuflado de arbusto para robar comida.

Dia mengendap-endap ke pertanian dengan bentuk semak yang sangat besar untuk mencuri tanaman, memberi masalah kepada petani.
raw.pt: Quando o estômago sem fundo, ele evolui para o Rei Mossy. Devido ao seu enorme corpo, seu apetite fica maior ainda. Ele geralmente aparece em assentamentos humanos procurando comida. Adultos o evitam porque ele é considerado uma fera nociva, mas de algum jeito ele é popular com crianças. Ele se disfarça como uma moita enorme para invadir fazendas, causando problemas aos fazendeiros.
raw.th: ฟลังจากที่กระเพาะที่ลึกไม่มีที่สิ้นสุดของมอสซี่ถูกเติมจนเต็มแล้ว มันจะพัฒนาเป็นราชามอสซี่ เนื่องจากร่างกายที่ใหญ่โต อาหารที่มันกินก็ต้องมากขึ้นด้วย มันมักจะไปตามที่อยู่ของมนุษย์เพื่อหาอาหาร ผู้ใหญ่มักจะหลีกเลี่ยงมันเพราะคิดว่าเป็นสัตว์อันตรายแต่เด็กๆ กลับชื่นชอบพวกมัน มันจะแอบเข้าไปในไร่โดยปลอมเป็นพุ่มไม้ใหญ่เพื่อโขมยพืชผลสร้างปัญหาให้กับชาวไร่
raw.vi: Người ta cho rằng sau khi bụng không đáy của Mossy nạp đầy thức ăn nó sẽ trở thành vua Mossy. Do cơ thể khổng lồ, cảm giác thèm ăn của nó thậm chí còn lớn hơn. Nó thường đi vào các khu dân cư để tìm kiếm thức ăn . Người lớn tránh gặp nó vì nghĩ rằng nó là một con thú lớn gây hại nhưng vì lí do nào đó nó lại được trẻ em ưa thích. Nó lẻn vào các trang trại với hình dạng bụi cây um tùm để lấy trộm cây trồng gây ra rắc rối cho người nông dân.

id:
Peramal aktif dari Vriksha Duchy yang hancur. Karena dia berasal dari suku nomaden, catatan masa mudanya sedikit.
Peramal mengartikan dan memanipulasi alam. Claris jarang berada di satu tempat untuk waktu yang lama, namun ia menghabiskan 10 tahun di Vriksha. Tujuannya tidak jeas, rumornya, ia mencari harta karun terpendam atau ia memiliki kekasih.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30040_DESCRIPTION
desc:
A geomancer active from the ruined Vriksha Duchy. As she was from a nomadic tribe, there are few records of her youth.
A geomancer deciphers and manipulates nature. Claris was rarely in any one place for very long, but spent 10 years in Vriksha. Her purpose is unclear, but rumors are she was searching for buried treasure or that she had a lover.

raw.es:
Geomante del antiguo principado de Vriksha. Proviene de una tribu nómada, así que poco se sabe de su juventud.
Los geomantes descifran y manipulan la naturaleza. Claris suele vivir en distintos lugares, pero por alguna razón inexplicable lleva 10 años en Vriksha. Dicen que tal vez vaya tras un tesoro de la zona o tenga un amante.

Uma geomante que veio do Ducado arruinado de Vriksha. Como ela pertencia a uma tribo nômade, existem poucos registros de sua juventude.
Um geomante decifra e manipula a natureza. Claris raramente ficava em um único lugar por muito tempo, mas ela passou 10 anos em Vriksha. Seu propósito não era claro, mas os boatos dizem que ela estava procurando por tesouros enterrados ou que ela tinha um amante.
raw.th: หมอดูปราณดินจากนครพฤกษาที่ล่มสลาย เธอมาจากชนเผ่าเร่ร่อนจึงไม่ค่อยมีเรื่องราวในวัยเยาว์ของเธอบันทึกไว้มากนัก จีโอแมนเซอร์จะถอดรหัสและปรับแต่งะรรมชาติ "คลาริส" มักไม่ค่อยปักหลักอยู่ที่ไหนเป็นเวลานานๆ แต่กลับใช้เวลา 10 ปีในพฤกษา ความตั้งใจของเธอยังไม่เป็นที่แน่ชัด แต่ลือกันว่าเธอกำลังค้นหาสมบัติที่ฝังอยู่ไม่ก็เธอมีคนรักที่นั่น
raw.vi:
Một thầy bói đất hoạt động ở vùng Vriksha Duchy. Vì đến từ một bộ lạc du mục nên có rất ít thông tin về cô thời còn trẻ.
Thầy bói giải mã và thay đổi tự nhiên . Claris hiếm khi ở lâu một nơi nào đó nhưng cô đã ở Vriksha 10 năm. Cô không xác định mục tiêu rõ ràng nhưng người ta đồn rằng cô đang tìm kiếm kho báu hay cô có người tình ở đây .

id: Peramal aktif dari Vriksha Duchy yang hancur. Selama perang dengan dewa, ia membangkitkan kemampuan untuk memanipulasi waktu, sehingga ia dikenal sebagai magi waktu. Ada sedikit catatan tentang magi waktu, dan cara memperoleh kekuatan tersebut masih diriset. Satu teorinya, kronomansi adalah kekuatan alam dengan daya hancur hebat, namun tidak ada yang membuktikan teori ini.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30041_DESCRIPTION
desc: A geomancer active from the ruined Vriksha Duchy. During the war with the gods she awakened the ability to manipulate time, allowing her to become known as a time mage. There are few records of time mages, and how she acquired the power is still being researched. One theory is that chronomancy is a natural power with great desctructive force, but there is nothing to prove this theory.

raw.es: Geomante del antiguo principado de Vriksha. Adquirió la habilidad de manipular el tiempo durante la guerra contra los dioses, llegando a convertirse en una cronomaga. Poco se sabe de estos magos, y no se sabe cómo obtuvo sus poderes. Una teoría apunta a que la cronomancia es un poder natural extremadamente destructivo, pero hasta ahora no se ha demostrado.

raw.pt: Uma geomante que veio do Ducado arruinado de Vriksha. Durante a guerra com os deuses ela despertou a habilidade de manipular o tempo, permitindo que ela se tornasse conhecida como maga do tempo. Existem poucos registros de magos do tempo, e como ela adquiriu o poder ainda é fonte de pesquisas. Uma teoria é que a cronomancia é um poder natural com grande força destrutiva, mas não existe nada para comprovar a teoria.
raw.th: หมอดูปราณดินจากนครพฤกษาที่ล่มสลาย ในช่วงสงครามกับพระเจ้าความสามารถในการควบคุมเวลาของเธอก็ตื่นขึ้นทำให้เธอเป็นที่รู้จักกันในฐานะจอมเวทการเวลา มันมีบันทึกเกี่ยวกับจอมเวทกาลเวลาไม่มากนักและวิธีที่เธอได้พลังมานั้นยังคงมีการวิจัยอยู่ มีทฤษฎีหนึ่งว่าศาสตร์แห่งกาลเวลาก็เป็นพลังของธรรมชาติที่มีพลังทำลายล้างมหาศาล แต่ก็ยังไม่มีสิ่งใดมายืนยันทฤษฎีนี้
raw.vi: Một thầy bói đất hoạt động tại vùng Vriksha Duchy . Trong cuộc chiến với các vị thần cô đã khơi dậy khả năng điều khiển thời gian khiến cô được biết đến như một pháp sư thời gian . Có rất ít thông tin về các pháp sư thời gian, và việc làm thế nào cô có được sức mạnh như vậy vẫn còn đang được nghiên cứu . Một giả thuyết cho rằng phép thuật điều khiển thời gian là một sức mạnh tự nhiên với sức tàn phá to lớn, nhưng chưa ai chứng minh được điều này .

id: Peramal yang dahulu aktif di Vriksha Duchy yang hancur. Meski meraih kekuatan impresif mampu memanipulasi waktu, buktinya sangat sedikit. Catatan usaha Claris ditemukan dalam buku harian gadis dari desa kecil. Katanya ia memiliki kekuatan sihir besar, seperti dewa. Gadis muda itu menulis, "Sepertinya dia sudah lama punya kekuatan itu di dalam dirinya."
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30042_DESCRIPTION
desc: A geomancer once active in the ruined Vriksha Duchy. Despite her gaining the impressive power of being able to manipulate time, there exists very little proof of it. Record of Claris's efforts was, however, found in the diary of a girl from a small village. It was recorded that she had wielded great magical power, like that of the gods. The young girl wrote of her in her diary, "It's like she had that power inside of her all along."

raw.en: A geomancer once active in the ruined Vriksha Duchy. Despite her gaining the impressive power of being able to manipulate time, there exists very little proof of it. Record of Claris's efforts was, however, found in the diary of a girl from a small village. It was recorded that she had wielded great magical power, like that of the gods. The young girl wrote of her in her diary, "It's like she had that power inside of her all along."
raw.es: Geomante que antaño practicaba su magia en el antiguo principado de Vriksha. A pesar de haber ganado el increíble poder de manipular el tiempo, existe poca prueba de que Claris realmente haya logrado hacerlo. Sin embargo, se encontraron registros sobre sus esfuerzos en el diario de una joven que pertenecía a un pequeño poblado. En las memorias se decía que Claris había blandido un poder mágico similar al de los dioses. La joven escribió en su diario: "Parecía que había tenido el poder dentro de ella durante toda su vida".

raw.pt: Uma geomante que veio do Ducado arruinado de Vriksha. Apesar de ganhar o impressionante poder de manipular o tempo, existem poucas provas disso. Porém, os registros dos esforços de Claris foram encontrados no diário de uma garota de uma pequena vila. Foi registrado que ela possuía imensos poderes mágicos, rivalizando com os dos deuses. A jovem garota escreveu em seu diário, “É como se ela sempre tivesse aquele poder dentro dela”.
raw.th: หมอดูปราณดินจากนครพฤกษาที่ล่มสลาย แม้เธอจะได้รับพลังสุดยอดที่สามารถควบคุมเวลาได้ แต่มีการบันทึกเป็นหลักฐานไว้อยู่น้อยมาก อย่างไรก็ตามบันทึกที่เกี่ยวของการคลาริสถูกค้นพบจากไดอารี่ของเด็กสาวจากหมู่บ้านเล็กๆ มันบันทึกเอาไว้ว่าเธอมีพลังเวทที่ยิ่งใหญ่คล้ายกับที่เทพเจ้ามี เด็กหญิงเขียนไว้ในนั้นว่า "มันคล้ายกับว่าเธอมีพลังนี้ซ่อนอยู่ในตัวมาโดยตลอด"
raw.vi: Một thầy bói đất hoạt động tại vùng Vriksha Duchy bị phá hủy. Mặc dù cô ta có được năng lực đặc biệt là có thể tính toán thời gian, nhưng vẫn có rất ít bằng chứng về việc này. Tuy vậy kỷ lục về nỗ lực của Claris được lưu lại trong nhật kí của một cô gái đến từ 1 ngôi làng nhỏ. Trong đó có ghi lại rằng cô ta đã nắm giữ được quyền lực huyền diệu tuyệt vời giống như quyền lưc của các vị thần. Cô gái trẻ viết nhật kí của mình " có thể cô gái có năng lực bên trong bản thân mình từ lâu"

id: Tanaman mirip manusia, asli hutan dalam yang tidak terjangkau matahari. Tanaman ini tertidur selagi bertumbuh di bumi. Jika ditarik dari tanah, tanaman ini buas dan menyerang siapa saja yang mengganggu. Berbahaya saat disentuh sembarangan karena teriakan tanaman ini bisa menggoncang jiwa. Atau mungkin juga mereka agak gila, terkadang ramah.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30050_DESCRIPTION
desc: A human-like plant native to deep forests where the sun can't reach. They sleep as they grow in the earth. If pulled from the ground they will become violent and attack whoever disturbed them. They are dangerous when carelessly touched as their scream can shake a person's very soul. However, it could just be that they're just a bit crazy as they are sometimes friendly.

raw.en: A human-like plant native to deep forests where the sun can't reach. They sleep as they grow in the earth. If pulled from the ground they will become violent and attack whoever disturbed them. They are dangerous when carelessly touched as their scream can shake a person's very soul. However, it could just be that they're just a bit crazy as they are sometimes friendly.
raw.es: Plantas con forma humana que viven en lo recóndito de los bosques, ocultas del sol, donde duermen mientras van creciendo. Si las arrancas de la tierra se volverán violentas y te atacarán salvajemente. No se aconseja ni tocarlas pues su grito puede resquebrajar el alma. Su carácter es bastante cambiante y a veces se muestran amistosas.
raw.id: Tanaman mirip manusia, asli hutan dalam yang tidak terjangkau matahari. Tanaman ini tertidur selagi bertumbuh di bumi. Jika ditarik dari tanah, tanaman ini buas dan menyerang siapa saja yang mengganggu. Berbahaya saat disentuh sembarangan karena teriakan tanaman ini bisa menggoncang jiwa. Atau mungkin juga mereka agak gila, terkadang ramah.
raw.pt: Uma planta de aparência humana nativa de florestas onde o sol não alcança. Elas dormem enquanto crescem na terra. Se arrancadas do chão elas se tornam violentas e atacam aqueles que a pertubaram. Elas são perigosas quando tocadas sem cuidado já que seu grito pode chacoalhar a própria alma de uma pessoa. Porém, isso pode ser um sinal de que são meio malucas já que às vezes elas são amigáveis.
raw.th: ต้นไม้รูปร่างเหมือนมนุษย์ซึ่งเติบโตในป่าลึกที่แสงอาทิตย์ส่องไปไม่ถึง มันนอนหลับขณะที่กำลังเจริญเติบโตอยู่ใต้ดิน ถ้าถูกถอนขึ้นมาจากดินก็จะดุร้ายและโจมตีทุกคนที่มารบกวนพวกมัน พวกมันมีอันตรายมากหากสัมผัสมันโดยไม่ระมัดระวังขณะที่มันส่งเสียงกรีดร้องที่สามารถเขย่าวิญญาณคนให้กระเจิงได้ อย่างไรก็แล้วแต่มันอาจจะเป็นเพราะพวกมันแค่เพี้ยนๆก็เป็นได้ เพราะบางที่พวกมันก็เป็นมิตร
raw.vi: Một loài thực vật giống con người sống trong rừng sâu, nơi mặt trời không thể chiếu tới. Chúng ngủ khi chúng lớn lên trong lòng đất. Nếu trồi lên khỏi mặt đất chúng sẽ trở nên hung tợn và tấn công bất cứ ai quấy rầy chúng. Rất nguy hiểm khi vô tình chạm chúng bởi tiếng thét của chúng có thể bắt giữ linh hồn con người. Tuy nhiên, điều kì lạ là đôi khi chúng cũng khá thân thiện .

id: Tanaman mirip manusia, asli hutan dalam yang tidak terjangkau matahari. Melakukan fotosintesis seperti tanaman lainnya, tidak merugikan atau berinteraksi dengan manusia kalau tidak perlu. Namun jika hutan atau tanaman tidak dirawat, mereka menyerang dengan jeritan perang. Tanaman ini tidak membenci manusia, namun tersenyum di dekat taman atau pertanian yang terawat.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30051_DESCRIPTION
desc: A human-like plant native to deep, sunless forests. Since they perform photosynthesis like other plants, they don't harm or interact with humans unless necessary. However, when poor care is given to plants or forests, they attack with a war cry. They don't hate people, however, and have been found smiling near well-kept gardens and farms.

raw.en: A human-like plant native to deep, sunless forests. Since they perform photosynthesis like other plants, they don't harm or interact with humans unless necessary. However, when poor care is given to plants or forests, they attack with a war cry. They don't hate people, however, and have been found smiling near well-kept gardens and farms.
raw.es: Plantas con forma humana que crecen en bosques oscuros. Solo salen a la luz para hacer fotosíntesis, evitando todo contacto con otros seres. Suelen atacar con su grito de guerra si notan que alguien amenaza su hábitat. No odian a los humanos y de hecho se alegran al ver que hay algunos que cuidan sus jardines y granjas.
raw.id: Tanaman mirip manusia, asli hutan dalam yang tidak terjangkau matahari. Melakukan fotosintesis seperti tanaman lainnya, tidak merugikan atau berinteraksi dengan manusia kalau tidak perlu. Namun jika hutan atau tanaman tidak dirawat, mereka menyerang dengan jeritan perang. Tanaman ini tidak membenci manusia, namun tersenyum di dekat taman atau pertanian yang terawat.
raw.pt: Uma planta de aparência humana nativa de florestas onde o sol não alcança. Como fazem fotossíntese como outras plantas, elas não machucam ou interagem com humanos a não ser que seja necessário. Porém, quando as plantas ou florestas não recebem cuidados, elas atacam com um grito de guerra. Só que elas não odeiam pessoas, e geralmente são vistas sorrindo quando vêem jardins e fazendas bem cuidados.
raw.th: ต้นไม้รูปร่างเหมือนมนุษย์ที่เติบโตในป่าลึกไร้แสงอาทิตย์ เนื่องจากพวกมันต้องสังเคราะห์แสงเหมือนต้นไม้อื่นๆ พวกมันจึงจะไม่ยุ่งหรือทำร้ายมนุษย์โดยไม่จำเป็น อย่างไรก็ดี ถ้ามีการดูแลต้นไม้หรือป่าไม่ดีพอมันจะจะโจมตีด้วยเสียงกู่ก้อง พวกมันไม่ได้เกลียดมนุษย์และบางทีก็ถูกพบเจอขณะที่มันยิ้มอยู่ข้างๆสวนหรือไรที่ได้รับการดูแลเป็นอย่างดี
raw.vi: Một loại thực vật giống như con người sống trong rừng sâu nơi không có ánh nắng mặt trời. Do chúng cũng thực hiện chức năng quang hợp giống như các loại cây khác nên gây hại hoặc tương tác với con người trừ khi cần thiết . Tuy nhiên, khi rừng xanh hoặc cây cối không được chăm sóc chu đáo, chúng sẽ lên tiếng đấu tranh. Thế nhưng chúng không ghét con người và người ta còn nhìn thấy chúng mỉm cười ở gần các khu vườn và trang trại được trông nom cẩn thận .

id: Tumbuhan yang seperti binatang hidup di kedalaman hutan. Mereka suka tempat yang lembab dan akan memakan semua yang bisa masuk ke dalam mulutnya. Mereka ditakuti sebagai pelindung hutan karena mereka hidup jauh di dalamnya dan jarang ditemui oleh manusia. Tapi, meskipun terlihat menakutkan, mereka baik dan sering memberikan buah kepada pengelana yang kelaparan. Tapi, kalau ada yang merusak hutan, mereka akan melepaskan aroma yang membuat semua makhluk hutan buas dan menyerang perusak itu secara agresif.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30052_DESCRIPTION
desc: An animal-like plant that lives deep in the forest. They like humid places and will eat anything that fits in their mouth. They are feared as protectors of the forest as they live deep within and are rarely ever encountered by humans. However, as scary as they may look, out of kindness they give fruits to starving travelers. Apart from that, should anyone cause harm to the forest they release an aroma throughout the forest which changes the personality of all it's creatures and makes them attack aggressively.

raw.en: An animal-like plant that lives deep in the forest. They like humid places and will eat anything that fits in their mouth. They are feared as protectors of the forest as they live deep within and are rarely ever encountered by humans. However, as scary as they may look, out of kindness they give fruits to starving travelers. Apart from that, should anyone cause harm to the forest they release an aroma throughout the forest which changes the personality of all it's creatures and makes them attack aggressively.
raw.es: Una planta con apariencia animal que vive en la profundidad del bosque. Les agradan los lugares húmedos y se alimentan de lo todo lo que les quepa en la boca. Los encuentros entre un humano y esta planta son poco frecuentes, ya que viven en la profundidad del bosque y son sus más temidas protectoras. A pesar de su escalofriante apariencia, estas plantas son bondadosas y suelen darles frutos a los hambrientos viajeros. Sin embargo, si alguna persona causara daño al bosque, estas plantas son capaces de liberar una feromona que modifica la personalidad de todas las criaturas del bosque y las hace muy agresivas.
raw.id: Tumbuhan yang seperti binatang hidup di kedalaman hutan. Mereka suka tempat yang lembab dan akan memakan semua yang bisa masuk ke dalam mulutnya. Mereka ditakuti sebagai pelindung hutan karena mereka hidup jauh di dalamnya dan jarang ditemui oleh manusia. Tapi, meskipun terlihat menakutkan, mereka baik dan sering memberikan buah kepada pengelana yang kelaparan. Tapi, kalau ada yang merusak hutan, mereka akan melepaskan aroma yang membuat semua makhluk hutan buas dan menyerang perusak itu secara agresif.
raw.pt: Uma planta animalesca que vive nas profundezas da floresta. Elas gostam de locais úmidos e comem o que quer que caiba em suas bocas. Elas são temidas como protetoras da floresta já que vivem na parte interna e raramente são vistas por humanos. No entanto, por mais assustadoras que pareçam, elas são frutos aos viajantes famintos por pura gentileza. Fora isso, se alguém causar qualquer mal à floresta, elas liberam um aroma pela floresta que altera a personalidade de todas as criaturas que vivem lá e fazem com que elas ataquem agressivamente.
raw.th: พืชที่รูปร่างเหมือนสัตว์ อาศัยอยู่ลึกเข้าไปในป่า พวกมันชอบที่ชื้นและจะกินทุกอย่างที่ยัดเข้าปากของพวกมันได้ พวกมันเป็นที่กลังเกรงในฐานะผู้พิทักษ์แห่งพงไพรขณะที่พวกมันอาศัยอยู่ลึกเข้าไปและยากนักที่จะพบเห็นโดยมนุษย์ อย่างไรก็ตาม แม้รูปร่างหน้าตาของพวกมันจะดูน่ากลัว แต่มันก็มอบผลไม้ให้กับนักเดินทางที่หิวโหยด้วยความใจดี นอกจากนั้นแล้ว หากมีใครก็ตามที่ทำให้ป่าเกิดอันตราย พวกมันจะปล่อยกลิ่นออกมาเต็มป่าซึ่งจะเปลี่ยนนิสัยของสิ่งมีชีวิตทุกตัวและทำให้พวกนั้นโจมตีอย่างดุร้าย
raw.vi: Một cái cây giống động vật sống sâu trong rừng. Chúng thích những nơi ẩm ướt và sẽ ăn bất cứ thứ gì vừa với miệng của chúng. Những người bảo vệ rừng kính sợ chúng bởi chúng sống sâu trong rừng và con người hiếm khi gặp được chúng. Tuy nhiên, dù vẻ ngoài có thể đáng sợ, vì lòng tốt chúng sẽ cung cấp trái cây cho những lữ khách đang đói. Bên cạnh đó, nếu bất kỳ ai gây hại cho khu rừng, chúng sẽ phát ra một thứ mùi thơm khắp rừng thay đổi tính cách của tất cả các sinh vật trong rừng và khiến chúng tấn công mạnh mẽ.

id: Bandit dari pegunungan berhutan perbatasan Vriksha Duchy yang hancur. Manusia tidak berguna yang disebut oleh rakyat Vriksha: kasar, vulgar, dan kejam. Kekuatannya dengan kapak sangat eksplosif, dan katanya ia dapat menumbangkan pohon besar dengan sekali ayun. Saat ia datang ke kota, para pengagumnya akan membawakan makanan hasil curian dari orang kaya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30061_DESCRIPTION
desc: A bandit from the forested mountain bordering the ruined Vriksha Duchy. A useless man that the people of Vriksha called rude, vulgar and mean. However, his power with an axe was explosive, and they said he could level a large tree in a single swing. When he came to town the many people who admired him would bring him food stolen from the rich.

raw.en: A bandit from the forested mountain bordering the ruined Vriksha Duchy. A useless man that the people of Vriksha called rude, vulgar and mean. However, his power with an axe was explosive, and they said he could level a large tree in a single swing. When he came to town the many people who admired him would bring him food stolen from the rich.
raw.es: Bandido de las montañas que limitan con el antiguo principado de Vriksha. Fue considerado un malvado y sanguinario ladrón por la gente del principado. Su poder con el hacha era increíble, podía talar cualquier árbol de un solo golpe. En su aldea natal muchos lo consideraban un héroe y le ofrecían comida robada de los ricos.
raw.id: Bandit dari pegunungan berhutan perbatasan Vriksha Duchy yang hancur. Manusia tidak berguna yang disebut oleh rakyat Vriksha: kasar, vulgar, dan kejam. Kekuatannya dengan kapak sangat eksplosif, dan katanya ia dapat menumbangkan pohon besar dengan sekali ayun. Saat ia datang ke kota, para pengagumnya akan membawakan makanan hasil curian dari orang kaya.
raw.pt: Um bandito da floresta montanhosa que faz fronteira com o Ducado arruinado de Vriksha. Um homem inútil que as pessoas de Vrishka chamavam de rude, vulgar e cruel. Porém seu poder com um machado era assombroso, e dizem que ele podia derrubar uma árvore das grandes com um único golpe. Quando ele ia à cidade as muitas pessoas que o admiravam traziam comida roubada dos ricos.
raw.th: โจรป่าจากเทือกเขาที่มีพรมแดนติดนครรัฐพฤกษาที่ล่มสลาย คนไร้ประโยชน์ที่ชาวพฤกษาเรียกว่าพวกหยาบคาย เลวและโหดเหี้ยม แต่การใช้ขวานของเขาไม่เป็นรองใครว่ากันว่าเขาสามารถโค่นต้นไม้ใหญ่ได้ด้วยการฟันเพียวครั้งเดียว เมื่อเขาเข้ามาในเมือง ผู้ที่ชื่นชมเขามักจะนำอาหารที่ขโมยจากพวกคนรวยมาให้เขา
raw.vi: Một tên cướp từ trên rừng núi tiếp giáp với vùng Vriksha Duchy đổ nát. Một người đàn ông vô dụng mà người dân cùng Viriksha gọi là thô lỗ, thô tục và keo kiệt. Tuy nhiên, sức mạnh của anh ta nằm trong một cái rìu có thể gây nổ và người ta đã nói rằng anh ta có thể san bằng một cây lớn trong một lần đu. Khi anh ta đến thành phố thì có rất nhiều người ngưỡng mộ anh ta sẽ mang cho anh ta thức ăn mà được lấy trộm từ các nhà giàu.

id: Bos bandit dari pegunungan berhutan perbatasan Vriksha Duchy yang hancur. Zaza melanjutkan karier banditnya dan pengikut yang memujanya menjadikannya kepala bandit. Ia mencoba menolaknya dengan berkata itu terlalu repot, namun saat anak buahnya dibunuh dewa-dewa, ia menunjukkan kemarahan, menghadapi dewa dengan kapaknya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30062_DESCRIPTION
desc: A bandit boss from the forested mountain bordering the ruined Vriksha Duchy. Zaza continued his banditry, and the followers that admired him made him head bandit. He tried to decline by saying it was too much trouble, but when some of his underlings were killed by the gods, he showed a rage like never before, taking on the gods with his axe.

raw.en: A bandit boss from the forested mountain bordering the ruined Vriksha Duchy. Zaza continued his banditry, and the followers that admired him made him head bandit. He tried to decline by saying it was too much trouble, but when some of his underlings were killed by the gods, he showed a rage like never before, taking on the gods with his axe.
raw.es: Jefe bandido de las montañas que limitan con el antiguo principado de Vriksha. Zaza continuó con sus fechorías y sus seguidores lo convirtieron en jefe de la banda. Se negó a ejercer como tal, pues pensó que le traería problemas. Al tiempo, uno de sus hombres fue asesinado por los dioses y, lleno de rabia, arremetió contra estos en busca de venganza.
raw.id: Bos bandit dari pegunungan berhutan perbatasan Vriksha Duchy yang hancur. Zaza melanjutkan karier banditnya dan pengikut yang memujanya menjadikannya kepala bandit. Ia mencoba menolaknya dengan berkata itu terlalu repot, namun saat anak buahnya dibunuh dewa-dewa, ia menunjukkan kemarahan, menghadapi dewa dengan kapaknya.
raw.pt: Um chefe de bandidos da floresta montanhosa na fronteira do Ducado arruinado de Vriksha. Zaza continuou com sua bandidagem, e os seguidores que o admiravam fizeram dele seu chefe. Ele tentou recusar dizendo que era muito problema, mas quando alguns de seus subalternos foram mortos pelos deuses, ele mostrou uma ira nunca antes vista, enfrentando-os com seu machado.
raw.th: หัวหน้าโจรป่าจากเทือกเขาที่มีพรมแดนติดนครรัฐพฤกษาที่ล่มสลาย ซาซ่ายังคงเป็นโจรป่าและผู้ติดตามซึ่งชื่นชมเขาก็ยกให้เขาเป็นผู้นำ เขาพยายามปฏิเสธในตอนแรกเพราะว่ามันดูวุ่นวายแต่เมื่อลูกน้องของเขาถูกเข่นฆ่าโดยเทพเจ้า เขาแสดงความโกรธออกมาอย่างที่ไม่เคยเป็นมาก่อนและจัดการเทพเจ้าด้วยขวานของเขา
raw.vi: Một người chủ của tên cướp từ trên rừng núi tiếp giáp với vùng Vriksha Duchy đổ nát. Zaza tiếp tục nghề cướp và các tên đàn em ngưỡng mộ anh ra đã tôn anh ta làm tướng cướp. Anh ta cố gắng từ chối bằng các nói ra nhiều vấn đề mà đã xảy ra với anh ta nhưng khi một vài đàn em của anh ta bị đã bị các vị thần giết chết đã làm anh ta vô cùng tức giận nên đã quyết định nhận lời.

id: Bandit dari gunung hutan perbatasan Vriksha Duchy yang hancur. Setelah anak buahnya dibunuh oleh para dewa, ia sedih secara emosional dan membalas dendam, tanpa henti memenggal para dewa dengan kapaknya. Dia ditakuti oleh dewa dan manusia, dan kemarahan tak terhentikan membuatnya dikenal sebagai "Bandit Liar." Ia terus memenggal kepala dengan kapaknya, tidak tahu tentang gelar itu.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30063_DESCRIPTION
desc: A bandit from the forested mountain bordering the ruined Vriksha Duchy. After his subordinates were killed by the gods, it is said he was drained of emotion and sought revenge against the gods, relentlessly chopping away at them with his axe. He was feared by not only the gods but humans as well, and his unwavering anger led him to be known as the "Wild Bandit." However, he continued slashing ahead with his axe, unaware of the title bestowed upon him.

raw.es: Bandido de las montañas que limitan con el antiguo principado de Vriksha. Luego de que sus subordinados murieran a manos de los dioses, se dice que todo rastro de emoción abandonó el cuerpo de Zaza, y que el guerrero buscó vengarse de los dioses y los atacó sin descanso con su hacha. No solo los dioses le temían, sino también los humanos, y su inquebrantable furia le dio el apodo de "Bandido salvaje". Sin embargo, Zaza continuó blandiendo su hacha al frente de la batalla, sin prestarle importancia al título que le habían dado.

Dia ditakuti oleh dewa dan manusia, dan kemarahan tak terhentikan membuatnya dikenal sebagai "Bandit Liar." Ia terus memenggal kepala dengan kapaknya, tidak tahu tentang gelar itu.
raw.pt: Um bandito da floresta montanhosa que faz fronteira com o Ducado arruinado de Vriksha. Após ter seus subordinados mortos pelos deuses, dizem que suas emoções foram drenadas e ele buscou a vingança contra os deuses, abatendo-os inexoravelmente com seu machado. Ele era temido não somente pelos deuses mas também pelos humanos, e sua raiva inabalável o levou a ser conhecido como “O Bandido Selvagem”. Porém, ele continuou abrindo caminho com seu machado, sem notar o apelido que recebeu.
raw.th: โจรป่าจากเทือกเขาที่มีพรมแดนติดนครรัฐพฤกษาที่ล่มสลาย หลังจากที่ลูกน้องของเขาถูกสังหารโดยเทพเจ้า  ว่ากันว่าเขาได้ระบายอารมณ์ออกมาและตามล่าล้างแค้นเทพเจ้า ใช้ขวานของเขาสับไปที่พวกนั้นอย่างไร้ความปรานี เขาเป็นที่หวาดกลัวจากทั้งเทพเจ้าและมนุษย์ด้วยกัน และความโกรธที่ไม่เปลี่ยนแปลงของเขาทำให้เขาเป็นที่รู้จักในนาม "โจรป่าบ้าคลั่ง" อย่างไรก็ดีเขาก็ยังคงกวัดแกว่งโจมตีด้วยขวานต่อไปโดยไม่ได้รับทราบถึงฉายาที่ผู้อื่นตั้งให้
raw.vi: Một tên cướp đến từ một ngọn núi bao phủ bởi khu rừng ráp ranh cùng Vriksha Duchy bị phá hủy. Sau khi thuộc hạ của hắn bị giết bởi chúa, người ta nói rằng hắn bị rút hết cảm xúc và tìm cách chống trả lại các vị thần, và không ngừng chặt hết các cây trong rừng bằng chiếc rìu của mình. Không chỉ các vị thần sợ hắn và con người cũng phải sợ hắn, và sự giận dữ của hắn đã khiến hắn được biết đến là "Bandit hoang dã". Tuy nhiên hắn vẫn tiếp tục chặt phá rừng bằng chiếc rìu của mình và không ai có thể biết hắn ta gọi là gì nữa.

id: Peri-peri ini katanya tinggal di hutan yang dalam. Mereka punya sayap tipis dan seukuran telapak tangan. Mereka cukup menyukai manusia dan akan menunjukkan jalan keluar hutan kepada manusia yang tersesat. Mereka melakukan sesuatu dengan caranya sendiri, dan mungkin minta pergi bersama mereka yang disukai. Tapi ini lebih ke deklarasi daripada permintaan. Mereka akan tetap mengikuti meskipun ditolak.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30071_DESCRIPTION
desc: These fairies are said to live in deep forests. They have thin wings and can fit in the palm of a hand. They like humans fairly well and will show a lost human how to get out of the forest. They do things their own way, and may ask to go along with those they like. It's more of a declaration than a desire, though. They will follow even if their request is refused.

raw.en: These fairies are said to live in deep forests. They have thin wings and can fit in the palm of a hand. They like humans fairly well and will show a lost human how to get out of the forest. They do things their own way, and may ask to go along with those they like. It's more of a declaration than a desire, though. They will follow even if their request is refused.
raw.es: Hadas que viven en lo profundo de los bosques. Tienen pequeñas alas y caben en la palma de la mano. Son amigas de los humanos y te ayudarán si te pierdes en un bosque. Les gusta hacer las cosas a su modo y puede que se unan a tu grupo si les caes bien, en ese caso, no te queda otra que aceptar de buena gana.
