Mereka cukup menyukai manusia dan akan menunjukkan jalan keluar hutan kepada manusia yang tersesat. Mereka melakukan sesuatu dengan caranya sendiri, dan mungkin minta pergi bersama mereka yang disukai. Tapi ini lebih ke deklarasi daripada permintaan. Mereka akan tetap mengikuti meskipun ditolak.
raw.pt: Dizem que as fadas vivem nas florestas mais densas. Elas têm asas finas e cabem na palma da mão. Elas gostam de humanos e podem mostrar o caminho para fora da floresta àqueles que se perdem. Elas fazem as coisas do seu jeito, e podem pedir para acompanhar aqueles de quem gostam. É mais uma declaração do que um pedido, na verdade. Elas vão seguir mesmo que o pedido seja negado.
raw.th: ภูตที่ว่ากันว่าอาศัยอยู่ในป่า พวกมันมีปีกที่บางและเล็กจนฝ่ามือกำได้ พวกมันชอบมนุษย์และมักจะนำทางคนที่หลงออกจากป่า พวกมันทำอะไรตามใจตัวเองและมักจะขอติดตามคนที่มันชื่นชอบและจะเป็นกึ่งการบังคับเสียด้วย เพราะฉะนั้นแม้จะถูกปฏิเสธมันก็ยังจะตื๊อตามต่อไป
raw.vi: Những nàng tiên được cho là sống trong rừng sâu. Họ có các cánh mỏng và có thể sắp đặt mọi thứ trong lòng bàn tay. Họ thích con người chính trực, tốt bụng và sẽ biến thành con người đã khuất để có được ra khỏi rừng. Họ làm mọi thứ theo cách riêng của họ, và có thể đi theo ai mà họ thích.Có thể coi đó là một tuyên bố hơn một mong muốn, mặc dù. Họ sẽ làm theo ngay cả khi yêu cầu của họ bị từ chối.

id: Ratu para peri yang tinggal di hutan yang dalam. Meskipun sulit dipercaya karena ukurannya, dia adalah master elit dalam seni penyembuhan. Titania mampu menolong banyak orang yang terkena penyakit sulit, dan banyak yang mencarinya sebagai sumber keberuntungan. Kejelekannya adalah kemalasan yang tumbuh membesar, membuatnya sering telat dan tidur terlalu lama.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30072_DESCRIPTION
desc: The queen of the fairies who lives in deep forests. Although hard to believe because of her size, she is an elite master of the healing arts. Titania is able to help many get through difficult ailments, and many seek her as a source of luck. Her flaw is the laziness she's developed over years, which leads to tardiness and oversleeping.

raw.en: The queen of the fairies who lives in deep forests. Although hard to believe because of her size, she is an elite master of the healing arts. Titania is able to help many get through difficult ailments, and many seek her as a source of luck. Her flaw is the laziness she's developed over years, which leads to tardiness and oversleeping.
raw.es: Reina de las hadas que vive en lo profundo de los bosques. A pesar de su tamaño, es una maestra en las artes curativas. Titania puede curar un sinfín de aflicciones y muchos creen que atrae la buena suerte. Su defecto es que con el tiempo se ha vuelto algo vaga y tiende a retrasarse para todo.
raw.id: Ratu para peri yang tinggal di hutan yang dalam. Meskipun sulit dipercaya karena ukurannya, dia adalah master elit dalam seni penyembuhan. Titania mampu menolong banyak orang yang terkena penyakit sulit, dan banyak yang mencarinya sebagai sumber keberuntungan. Kejelekannya adalah kemalasan yang tumbuh membesar, membuatnya sering telat dan tidur terlalu lama.
raw.pt: A rainha das fadas que vive nas profundezas da floresta. Apesar de ser difícil de acreditar devido ao seu tamanho, ela é uma mestra na arte da cura. Titania pode ajudar muitos a superarem doenças difíceis, e muitos a procuram como fonte de sorte. Seu defeito é a preguiça que ela desenvolveu ao longo dos anos, que a leva a dormir demais e sempre se atrasar.
raw.th: ราชินีแห่งภูตอาศัยอยู่ในป่าลึก แม้รูปร่างจะทำให้ดูไม่น่าเชื่อแต่เธอคือจ้าวแห่งเวทเยียวยารักษา ไททาเนียสามารถช่วยคนมากมายให้หายเจ็บ และคนมากมายก็ตามหาเธอมาเป็นตัวนำโชค ข้อเสียของเธอก็คือความขี้เกียจที่สั่งสมมานานนับปี ซึ่งทำให้เธอเฉื่อยและขี้เซา
raw.vi: Nữ hoàng của các bà tiên sống trong rừng sau. Mặc dù khó để tin hình dáng của bà nhưng bà là một thầy thuốc giỏ chữa bệnh. Titania có thể giúp nhiều người bệnh vượt qua khó khăn, và nhiều người tìm kiếm cô như một tia hi vọng để chữa khỏi bệnh. khuyết điểm của bà là sự lười biếng trong những năm qua đã làm cho cô cô ấy luôn luôn chậm trễ và ngủ trễ.

id: Peri katanya telah ada sejak permulaan dunia. Dipercaya sebagai pendiri dari desa peri, dia telah hidup sangat lama sampai Finkell tidak ingat siapa dia. Dia dikenal karena kesabarannya dan sangat murah hati, di mana dia menawarkan bantuan kepada dewa maupun setan. Katanya sihir penyembuhnya penuh dengan kehangatan bahkan makhluk yang paling jahat pun menunjukkan ketenangan dan kelembutan di depannya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30073_DESCRIPTION
desc: A fairy said to have existed since the beginning of the world. Believed to be the founder of the fairy grove, she has lived for such a long time that apparently even Finkell herself cannot remember who she really is. She is known best for her patience and superb generosity, which she kindly offers to gods and demons likewise. It is said that her healing magic is filled with so much warmth that even the most vile creatures show a calm and gentle side before her.

raw.en: A fairy said to have existed since the beginning of the world. Believed to be the founder of the fairy grove, she has lived for such a long time that apparently even Finkell herself cannot remember who she really is. She is known best for her patience and superb generosity, which she kindly offers to gods and demons likewise. It is said that her healing magic is filled with so much warmth that even the most vile creatures show a calm and gentle side before her.
raw.es: Un hada que, según se cuenta, ha existido desde el comienzo de los tiempos. Se cree que fundó la arboleda de las hadas. Este ser ha vivido durante tanto tiempo que, aparentemente, ni siquiera la mismísima Finkell recuerda quién es. Se la conoce sobre todo por su paciencia y su extrema generosidad, que ofrece tanto a los dioses como a los demonios. Se dice que su magia sanadora está insuflada con tanto calor que incluso las criaturas más viles muestran su lado calmo y gentil cuando están con ella.
raw.id: Peri katanya telah ada sejak permulaan dunia. Dipercaya sebagai pendiri dari desa peri, dia telah hidup sangat lama sampai Finkell tidak ingat siapa dia. raw.pt: Uma fada que dizem existir desde o início do mundo. Suposta fundadora do recanto das fadas, ela viveu por tanto tempo que parece que nem mesmo Finkell se lembra de quem ela é de verdade. Ela é melhor conhecida por sua paciência e sua imensa generosidade que oferece tanto a deuses quanto a demônios. Dizem que sua magia de cura é cheia de tanto calor que até as criaturas mais malignas mostram seus lados gentis e calmos diante dela.
raw.th: นางฟ้าที่ถือกำเนิดตั้งแต่การเริ่มต้นของโลกถูกเชื่อว่าเป็นผู้ก่อตั้งดินแดนนางฟ้าขึ้น เธอได้อาศัยเป็นเวลานานจนกระทั้งฟินเฮล จำไม่ได้ว่าเธอเป็นใคร เธอมีชื่อเสียงด้านความอดทนและความมีน้ำใจซึ่งเธอเอง ก็ได้เสนอความช่วยเหลือให้แก่เทพและปีศาจ กล่าวกันว่าความสามารถในการฟื้นฟูบาดแผลของเธอเต็มไปด้วยความอบอุ่น แม้กระทั่งสัตว์ประหลาดที่ดุร้ายก็ยังสงบลงต่อหน้าเธอ
raw.vi: Một nàng tiên được cho là đã tồn tại từ khi khởi đầu thế giới. Được cho là người sáng lập khu rừng cổ tích, nàng đã sống rất lâu khiến bản thân Finkell thậm chí không thể nhớ được nàng thực sự là ai. Nàng được biết đến nhiều bởi lòng kiên nhẫn và sự rộng lượng tuyệt vời mà nàng sẵn lòng mang đến cho các vị thần và cả bọn ma quỷ. Nghe nói phép thuật chữa bệnh của nàng tràn đầy ấm áp khiến những sinh vật bé nhỏ nhất cũng trở nên bình tĩnh và nhẹ nhàng trước nàng.

id: Monster pohon yang telah hidup beberapa ratus tahun. Pohon yang dibesarkan di area yang elemen Buminya kuat menyimpan sihir dalam tubuh mereka membuatnya menjadi Trent. Mereka tidak tertarik dengan yang lain dan sulit dibedakan dengan pohon biasa, tapi Trent selalu bergerak dan mengatai pohon yang tidak bergerak hanyalah sebuah pohon. Cukup mudah untuk menemukan mereka.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30081_DESCRIPTION
desc: A tree monster that has lived for several hundred years. Trees raised in areas where the Earth element is strong store up magic in their bodies making them Trents. They have extremely low interest in others and are hard to distinguish from regular trees, but Trents are always moving and say that trees that don't move are just trees. It's fairly easy to find one.

raw.en: A tree monster that has lived for several hundred years. Trees raised in areas where the Earth element is strong store up magic in their bodies making them Trents. They have extremely low interest in others and are hard to distinguish from regular trees, but Trents are always moving and say that trees that don't move are just trees. It's fairly easy to find one.
raw.es: Árbol monstruoso con cientos de años de vida que crece en lugares con un alto poder elemental de tierra. Apenas muestra interés por otros seres y es difícil de distinguir a simple vista de un árbol normal. La única diferencia es que ellos sí se mueven, y mucho. Suele ser fácil encontrar uno en un bosque.

raw.pt: Um monstro-árvore que está vivo há centenas de anos. Árvores que crescem em áreas onde o elemento da Terra é forte o suficiente armazenam magia em seus corpos, tornando-se Trents. Elas têm muito pouco interesse nos outros e são difíceis de de distinguir de árvores normais, mas Trents estão sempre se movendo e dizem que árvores que não se movem são só árvores. É relativamente fácil encontrar uma delas.
raw.th: มอนสเตอร์ต้นไม้ที่อยู่มานานหลายร้อยปี ต้นไม้ที่เติบโตบนพื้นดินที่พลังธาตุดินจำนวนมากจะศะสมพลังเวทในตัวและทำให้พวกนั้นกลายเป็นเทร้นท์ พวกเขามีความสนใจผู้อื่นในระดับต่ำมากและยากที่จะแยกแยะความแตกต่างจากต้นไม้ปกติ แต่เพราะเทร้นท์เคลื่อนที่ตลอดเวลาและพวกที่ไม่เคลื่อนที่ก็แค่ต้นไม่ธรรมดาจึงหาพวกเขาเจอได้ไม่ยากนัก
raw.vi: Một yêu quái cây sống hàng trăm năm. Những cây sống trong các khu vực có yếu tố Trái đất sẽ phát triển mạnh mẽ thần kỳ như Trent. Chúng rất ít quan tâm đến những cây khác và cũng khó để phân biệt chúng với những cây bình thường, nhưng Trent luôn luôn di chuyển và nói rằng những cây không thể di chuyển thì chỉ là những cây tầm thường. Rất dễ ràng tìm thấy một cây như thế.

id: Monster pohon yang berumur lebih dari 1000 tahun. Trent berevolusi menjadi Ent setelah bermandikan kekuatan magis selama berabad-abad. Mereka benar-benar egois dan tidak peduli walaupun hutan mereka terbakar habis dan semua spesies mereka mati. Yang diinginkannya adalah bertambah besar. Dia akan menyerang siapapun yang menghalanginya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30082_DESCRIPTION
desc: A tree monster that's over 1000 years old. Trents evolves into an Ents after bathing in magic for many centuries. They are completely self-centered and wouldn't care even if their forest was burned down and all their kind was wiped out. All it wishes to do is get bigger. It will attack of anyone who tries to get in its way.

raw.en: A tree monster that's over 1000 years old. Trents evolves into an Ents after bathing in magic for many centuries. They are completely self-centered and wouldn't care even if their forest was burned down and all their kind was wiped out. All it wishes to do is get bigger. It will attack of anyone who tries to get in its way.
raw.es: Árbol monstruoso con más de mil años de vida que mutó tras nutrir sus raíces con magia durante años. Es extremadamente egocéntrico y poco le importa si queman el bosque o si su raza se extingue, su único deseo es crecer más y más. Atacará a todo el que se ponga en su paso.

raw.pt: Um monstro-árvore com mais de mil anos. Trents se tornam Ents depois de se banharem na magia por muitos séculos. Elas são completamente egocêntricas e não se importam nem mesmo se sua floresta for queimada e sua espécie extinta. Tudo que querem é crescer ainda mais. Elas atacam qualquer um que fique no seu caminho.
raw.th: มอนสเตอร์ต้นไม้ที่อายุมากกว่าพันปี เทร้นท์จะพัฒนากลายเป็นเอ๊นท์หลังจากอาบพลังเวทนานนับศตวรรษ พวกเขาสนใจแต่ตัวเองและไม่สนสิ่งต่างๆแม้ว่าป่าของเขาจะถูกเผาทำลายหรือว่าพรรคพวกของเขาจะถูกกำจัดไปหมดก็ตาม พวกเขาแค่หวังเพียงแต่จะเติบโตใหญ่ขึ้นและจะโจมตีใครก็ตามที่คิดขวางทาง
raw.vi: Một yêu quái cây hơn 1000 năm tuổi. Các Trent biến hóa thành một Ent sau khi tắm trong ma thuật nhiều thế kỷ. Chúng hoàn toàn tự chủ và sẽ không quan tâm ngay cả khi rừng bị đốt cháy và tất cả dòng họ của chúng bị hủy diệt. Tất cả mọi thứ nó muốn làm là trở nên to lớn hơn. Nó sẽ tấn công bất cứ ai cố gắng thực hiện theo cách của nó.

id: Monster pohon berusia lebih dari 1000 tahun. Katanya Xipe Totec adalah bentuk evolusi Ent, yang ingin lebih kuat, mengeluarkan umpan seperti Dryad dari batangnya agar bisa mendapat lebih banyak gizi. Amat ditakuti manusia yang terbujuk oleh umpan dan memakannya kalau sudah dekat. Kini diketahui bahwa ini membantu pohon memperbarui diri, terkadang juga disebut sebagai "Pohon Lahir Baru."
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30083_DESCRIPTION
desc: A tree monster that's over 1000 years old. It's said that a Xipe Totec is the evolved form of an Ent that, longing for so long to become stronger, sprouted a Dryad-like decoy from its trunk in hopes of using it to get more nourishment. They're greatly feared by humans whom it would lure in with its decoy and devour them when they got close, and since it's now known that this helps the tree renew itself it is sometimes also referred to as the "Tree of Rebirth."

raw.en: A tree monster that's over 1000 years old. It's said that a Xipe Totec is the evolved form of an Ent that, longing for so long to become stronger, sprouted a Dryad-like decoy from its trunk in hopes of using it to get more nourishment. They're greatly feared by humans whom it would lure in with its decoy and devour them when they got close, and since it's now known that this helps the tree renew itself it is sometimes also referred to as the "Tree of Rebirth."
raw.es: Árbol monstruoso con más de mil años de vida. Se dice que Xipe Totec evolucionó de un Ent que, en busca de más poder, dio vida a un señuelo con forma de dríada desde su tronco con la esperanza de poder usarlo para conseguir más alimento. Los humanos les tienen mucho miedo porque el señuelo los atrae hacia el árbol para devorarlos si se acercan demasiado. Debido a que ahora se sabe que esto permite que el árbol se renueve, a menudo se los conoce como "Árbol del renacimiento".
raw.id: Monster pohon berusia lebih dari 1000 tahun. Katanya Xipe Totec adalah bentuk evolusi Ent, yang ingin lebih kuat, mengeluarkan umpan seperti Dryad dari batangnya agar bisa mendapat lebih banyak gizi. Amat ditakuti manusia yang terbujuk oleh umpan dan memakannya kalau sudah dekat. Kini diketahui bahwa ini membantu pohon memperbarui diri, terkadang juga disebut sebagai "Pohon Lahir Baru."
raw.pt: Um monstro-árvore com mais de mil anos. Dizem que um Xipe Totec é a forma evoluída de um Ent que, querendo por tanto tempo se tornar mais forte, criando um chamariz em forma de dríado em seu tronco, na esperança de usá-lo para conseguir mais alimento. Eles são muito temidos por humanos, que eles buscam atrair com o chamariz e devorar quando se aproximam. Agora que agora sabe-se que isso ajuda a árvore a se renovar, também são chamados de “Árvore do Renascimento”.
raw.th: มอนสเตอร์ต้นไม้ที่มีอายุมากกว่า 1000 ปี ว่ากันว่า ชีเปโทเทค นั้นมีวิวัฒนาการมาจาก เอ้นท์ที่โหยหาต้องการจะแข็งแกร่งมากขึ้น มันงอกเหยื่อล่อรูปร่างคล้ายไดรแอดจากกิ่งของมัน โดยหวังว่าจะใช้มันเพื่อหาสารอาหารเพิ่มมากขึ้น พวกมันเป็นที่หวาดกลัวอย่างมากของมนุษย์ที่ถูกล่อลวงด้วยเหยื่อและกลืนกินพวกเขาเมื่อเข้าใกล้ และตั้งแต่รู้กันว่าสิ่งนี้ช่วยให้ต้นไม้ฟื้นฟูตัวเองได้ บางครั้งมันจึงถูกเรียกว่า "ต้นไม้แห่งการกำเนิดใหม่
raw.vi: Một quái vật cây hơn 1000 năm tuổi. Người ta nói rằng Xipe Totec là hình thức tiến hóa của một Ent mà từ lâu đã khao khát để trở nên mạnh hơn nên đã mọc lên một mồi nhử giống như Dryad từ thân cây với hy vọng sử dụng nó để có được nhiều thức ăn hơn. Chúng reo rắt nỗi sợ hãi to lớn cho con người bởi nó sẽ thu hút bằng mồi nhử và ăn tươi nuốt sống họ khi họ đến gần và vì giờ người ta còn biết rằng điều này giúp cây tự phục hồi lại nên đôi khi nó còn được gọi là "Cây Tái Sinh".

id: Roh kuat yang tinggal di hutan yang dalam. Dryad hidup di pohon yang kuno dan besar dan sangat pemalu. Mereka tidak menyukai pertarungan dan jago dalam sihir pendukung. Kadang, sebagai gurauan, mereka membuat orang menjadi budak mereka untuk melakukan keinginan mereka. Cukup lama, remaja yang hilang di dalam hutan dikatakan menjadi budak Dryad.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30092_DESCRIPTION
desc: A powerful spirit that lives in deep forests. Dryads live in large, ancient trees and are extremely timid. They dislike combat and excel at support magic. Sometimes, as a prank, they enslave people with magic and bend them to their will. For ages, youths who disappeared in the forest have been said to have become the slaves of Dryads.

raw.en: A powerful spirit that lives in deep forests. Dryads live in large, ancient trees and are extremely timid. They dislike combat and excel at support magic. Sometimes, as a prank, they enslave people with magic and bend them to their will. For ages, youths who disappeared in the forest have been said to have become the slaves of Dryads.
raw.es: Poderosos espíritus que viven en los árboles más viejos y grandes del bosque. Las dríadas son bastante tímidas y no les gusta luchar, aunque saben lanzar hechizos curativos. Son traviesas y les gusta hechizar a los humanos con su magia para que cumplan sus órdenes. Multitud de niños desaparecidos en el bosque han acabado siendo esclavos de estas criaturas.
raw.id: Roh kuat yang tinggal di hutan yang dalam. Dryad hidup di pohon yang kuno dan besar dan sangat pemalu. Mereka tidak menyukai pertarungan dan jago dalam sihir pendukung. Kadang, sebagai gurauan, mereka membuat orang menjadi budak mereka untuk melakukan keinginan mereka. Cukup lama, remaja yang hilang di dalam hutan dikatakan menjadi budak Dryad.
raw.pt: Um poderoso espírito que vive em florestas densas. Dríades vivem em enormes árvores antigas e são extremamente tímidas. Elas não gostam de combate e são especialistas em magia de suporte. Algumas vezes, como brincadeira, elas escravizam pessoas com magia e as dobram à sua vontade. Por eras, é dito que jovens que desaparecem nas florestas se tornaram escravos das Dríades.
raw.th: วิญญาณแข็งแกร่งที่อยู่ในป่าลึก ไดรยาดอาศัยในต้นไม้ใหญ่โบราณที่ชื้นมากๆ พวกมันไม่ชอบการต่อสู้และเก่งในการใช้เวทสันบสนุน บางครั้งพวกมันก็ทำอะไรแผลงๆ อย่าการจับคนไว้ด้วยเวทมนตร์และบังคับทำสิ่งต่างๆ ว่ากันว่าตั้งแต่อดีตเหล่าวัยรุ่นที่หายตัวไปในป่ามักจะเป็นเพราะถูกพวกไดรยาดจับไปเป็นทาส
raw.vi: Một yêu tinh có sức mạnh sống trong rừng sâu. Các Dryad cực nhút nhát và sống trong một cái cây cổ thụ to. Chúng không thích chiến đấu và trội hơn khi có sự hỗ trợ phép thuật. Đôi khi như một trò đùa, chúng dùng phép thuật bắt mọi người làm nô lệ và bắt họ làm theo những gì họ muốn. Những người trẻ bị biến mất trong rừng vì bị bắt làm nô lệ của Dryads.

id: Elf kuat yang tinggal di hutan yang dalam. Dikenal sebagai penjaga hutan, dia tidak bertambah tua dan tetap terlihat rupawan dan mempunyai hidup yang hampir abadi. Tidak menyukai pertarungan dan kekuatan magisnya yang sangat kuat digunakan untuk pertahanan dan bukan untuk menyerang. Meskipun sangat konservatif, yang sangat ingin tahu akan meninggalkan hutan mengikuti manusia yang menarik perhatiannya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30093_DESCRIPTION
desc: A powerful elf that lives in the deep forest. Known as the forest's guardian, it doesn't age and has beautiful looks and a nearly eternal lifespan. It dislikes fighting and its immensely powerful magic is usually used for defense rather than offense. Although very conservative, a curious one may leave the forest with a human it is interested in.

raw.en: A powerful elf that lives in the deep forest. Known as the forest's guardian, it doesn't age and has beautiful looks and a nearly eternal lifespan. It dislikes fighting and its immensely powerful magic is usually used for defense rather than offense. Although very conservative, a curious one may leave the forest with a human it is interested in.
raw.es: Poderosa elfa que vive en lo profundo de los bosques. Se considera la guardiana del bosque y su belleza perdura con el paso de los años como si fuera inmortal. No le gusta luchar y su inmenso poder mágico se centra más en la defensa que en el ataque. No suelen dejar el bosque, pero puede que alguna sienta curiosidad en acompañarte si le das un motivo.
raw.id: Elf kuat yang tinggal di hutan yang dalam. Dikenal sebagai penjaga hutan, dia tidak bertambah tua dan tetap terlihat rupawan dan mempunyai hidup yang hampir abadi. Tidak menyukai pertarungan dan kekuatan magisnya yang sangat kuat digunakan untuk pertahanan dan bukan untuk menyerang. Meskipun sangat konservatif, yang sangat ingin tahu akan meninggalkan hutan mengikuti manusia yang menarik perhatiannya.
raw.pt: Um poderoso elfo que vive no fundo da floresta. Conhecido como guardião da floresta, ele não envelhece e sua aparência é tão bela quando sua vida quase eterna é longa. Não aprecia a luta e sua magia imensamente poderosa é usada para defesa e não para o ataque. Apesar de conservador, um elfo curioso pode deixar a floresta na companhia de um humano que o interesse.
raw.th: เอลฟ์ทรลพลังที่อาศัยอยู่ในป่าลึก รู้จักกันในนามผู้พิทักษ์ป่า พวกนี้จะไม่แก่ มีหน้าตาสวยงามและแทบจะไม่มีวันตาย พวกนี้ไม่ชอบการต่อสู้และใช้เวทไปในทางป้องกันมากกว่าการรุก แม้ว่าจะค่อนข้างระแวดระวังตัวแต่พวกช่างสงสัยบางตนอาจอาจติดตามมนุษย์ที่ตนเองสนใจออกจากป่าด้วย
raw.vi: Một con yêu tinh có sức mạnh sống trong rừng sâu. Được coi là người bảo vệ rừng, nó không già đi và có vẻ đẹp và tuổi thọ gần như vĩnh cửu. Nó không thích chiến đấu và phép thuật vô cùng mạnh mẽ của nó thường được sử dụng để phòng thủ chứ không phải để phạm tội. Mặc dù rất bảo thủ nhưng khi tò mò nó có thể rời khỏi rừng với một con người nó quan tâm.

id: Telah hidup abadi, Elf Tnggi menghaluskan sifat sayang alam dan berevolusi menjadi pelindung semua makhluk hutan. Lemenara juga melindungi mereka selama perang besar melawan para dewa, namun hutan akhirnya terbakar oleh pasukan. Melihat hal ini, senyuman lenyap dari wajahnya, dan ia balas dendam pada para dewa. Dalam perang, mahkota putih di kepalanya ternoda merah darah para dewa.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30094_DESCRIPTION
desc: Having lived for an eternity, a High Elf then sublimates her affectionate nature and evolves into a protector of all the forest's creatures. Lemenara had also protected them during the great war with the gods, but the forest was eventually burned down by their army. Seeing the forest burn, the soft smile disappeared from her face, and she then ferociously sought revenge against the gods. In the battle that ensued, the white wreath upon her head was stained red with the blood of the gods.

raw.en: Having lived for an eternity, a High Elf then sublimates her affectionate nature and evolves into a protector of all the forest's creatures. Lemenara had also protected them during the great war with the gods, but the forest was eventually burned down by their army. Seeing the forest burn, the soft smile disappeared from her face, and she then ferociously sought revenge against the gods. In the battle that ensued, the white wreath upon her head was stained red with the blood of the gods.
raw.es: Luego de vivir durante una eternidad, una suma elfa renuncia a su cariñosa naturaleza y evoluciona para convertirse en una protectora de todas las criaturas del bosque. Lemenara también las había protegido durante la gran guerra contra los dioses, si bien su ejército, eventualmente, incendió el bosque. Tras ver cómo ardía el bosque, la sonrisa que caracterizaba a Lemenara desapareció de su rostro y dio lugar a una feroz venganza contra los dioses. En la batalla resultante, la corona blanca que tiene en la cabeza se tiñó de rojo con la sangre de los dioses.
raw.id: Telah hidup abadi, Elf Tnggi menghaluskan sifat sayang alam dan berevolusi menjadi pelindung semua makhluk hutan. Lemenara juga melindungi mereka selama perang besar melawan para dewa, namun hutan akhirnya terbakar oleh pasukan. Melihat hal ini, senyuman lenyap dari wajahnya, dan ia balas dendam pada para dewa. Dalam perang, mahkota putih di kepalanya ternoda merah darah para dewa.
raw.pt: Tendo vivido por uma eternidde, uma Elfa sublima sua natureza afetuosa e evolui para uma protetora de todas as criaturas da floresta. Lemenara também as protegeu durante a grande guerra com os deuses, mas a floresta foi eventualmente queimada pelo seu exércido. Vendo a floresta queimar, o sorriso suave desapareceu de seu rosto e ela buscou ferozmente a vingança contra os deuses. Na batalha que se seguiu, a guirlanda branca em sua cabeça foi manchada de vermelho com o sangue dos deuses.
raw.th: ไฮเอลฟ์ที่มีชีวิตอยู่มานานแสนนาน จะยกระดับความรักต่อธรรมชาติและวิวัฒนาการไปเป็นผู้พิทักษ์แห่งทุกชีวิตในป่า เลมีนารา ยังได้ปกป้องสิ่งมีชีวิตเหล่านั้นในช่วงสงครามครั้งใหญ่กับเหล่าเทพเจ้าด้วย แต่ท้ายที่สุดป่าก็ถูกเผาจนราบโดยกองทัพของพวกนั้น รอยยิ้มที่อ่อนโยนหายไปจากใบหน้าของเธอเมื่อได้เห็นป่าถูกเผาไหม้ และเธอก็เริ่มออกล้างแค้นเทพเจ้าอย่างดุร้าย ในการสู้รบที่เกิดขึ้น พวงหรีดสีขาวบนศีรษะของเธอถูกย้อมไปด้วยสีแดงจากเลือดของเทพเจ้า
raw.vi: Đã từng sống bất tử, một Yêu Tinh cấp Cao sau đó đã làm cho bản tính yêu thương của cô thăng hoa và trở thành người bảo vệ của tất cả các sinh vật trong rừng. Lemenara cũng đã bảo vệ họ trong cuộc đại chiến với các vị thần, nhưng rừng cuối cùng đã bị thiệu rụi bởi đội quân của các vị thần. Chứng kiến cảnh rừng bị thiêu rụi, nụ cười hiền dịu đã biến mất khỏi khuôn mặt cô và sau đó, cô đã tìm cách trả thủ các vị thần một cách tàn bạo. Trong trận chiến xảy ra sau đó, vòng hoa trắng trên đầu cô đã được nhuộm đỏ bằng máu của các vị thần.

id: Bentuk baru Lemera setelah evolusi untuk melawan para dewa. Dikatakan mencintai semua makhluk yang peduli dan menghormati tanah, ia membenci mereka yang melukai dan menghancurkannya. Ia menolak memaafkan para dewa yang ingin menghancurkan manusia yang mencintai alam di sekitarnya. Ini bukan berarti ia lebih memilih umat manusia. Saat ia menemukan manusia yang tidak menghormati tanah, ia akan menyerbunya dengan kemarahan seperti para dewa.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30095_DESCRIPTION
desc: Lemenara's new form after evolving in order to fight against the gods. Said to love all creatures who care for and respect the land, she hates those who mean to hurt and destroy it. Thus, she refuses to forgive the gods who seek to destroy these humans meant to love the nature that surrounds them. However, this doesn't mean that she favors the human race over any other. Where she to find a human who disrespected the land, she would strike him or her with as much fury as that of the gods themselves.

raw.en: Lemenara's new form after evolving in order to fight against the gods. Said to love all creatures who care for and respect the land, she hates those who mean to hurt and destroy it. Thus, she refuses to forgive the gods who seek to destroy these humans meant to love the nature that surrounds them. However, this doesn't mean that she favors the human race over any other. Where she to find a human who disrespected the land, she would strike him or her with as much fury as that of the gods themselves.
raw.es: La nueva forma de Lemenara tras evolucionar para luchar contra los dioses. Se dice que ama a todas las criaturas que respetan y cuidan la tierra, y odia a quienes intentan hacerle daño. Por ende, se rehúsa a perdonar a los dioses que intentan destruir a los humanos que están destinados a amar la naturaleza que los rodea. Sin embargo, esto no significa que piense que los humanos son la raza más agraciada. Si encontrara a un humano que le faltara el respeto a la tierra, lo golpearía con la misma furia con la que castigaría a un dios.
raw.id: Bentuk baru Lemera setelah evolusi untuk melawan para dewa. Dikatakan mencintai semua makhluk yang peduli dan menghormati tanah, ia membenci mereka yang melukai dan menghancurkannya. Ia menolak memaafkan para dewa yang ingin menghancurkan manusia yang mencintai alam di sekitarnya. Ini bukan berarti ia lebih memilih umat manusia. Saat ia menemukan manusia yang tidak menghormati tanah, ia akan menyerbunya dengan kemarahan seperti para dewa.
raw.pt: A nova forma de Lemenara, depois de evoluir para lutar contra os deuses. Dizem que ela ama todas as criaturas que cuidam e respeitam a terra, e odeia as que a machucam e destróem. Por isso, ela se recusou a perdoar os deuses que buscam destruir os humanos que devem amar a natureza que os cerca. Porém, isso não quer dizer que ela favorece a raça humana. Se ela encontrasse um humano que desrespeitava a terra, ela o atacava com tanta fúria quanto os próprios deuses.
raw.th: ร่างใหม่ของเลมีนาร่าหลังจากวิวัฒนาการเพื่อที่จะต่อสู้กับเทพเจ้า ว่ากันว่าจะรักทุกชีวิตที่ใส่ใจและเคารพต่อแผ่นดิน เธอเกลียดพวกคนที่ทำร้ายและทำลายมัน ด้วยเหตุนั้น เธอจึงปฏิเสธที่จะอภัยให้กับเทพเจ้าผู้ที่พยายามทำลายล้างมนุษย์ที่รักธรรมชาติที่อยู่รอบๆ ตัวพวกเขา อย่างไรก็ตาม นี่ไม่ได้หมายความว่าเธอชื่นชอบพวกมนุษย์มากกว่าเผ่าพันธุ์อื่นๆ เมื่อไหร่ที่เธอพบมนุษย์ที่ไม่เคารพธรรมชาติ เธอจะโจมตีทั้งเขาหรือเธอด้วยความโกรธเกรี้ยวแบบเดียวกันกับเทพเจ้า
raw.vi: Hình dạng mới của Lemenara sau khi tiến hóa để chiến đấu chống lại các vị thần. Tương truyền rằng vì yêu thương tất cả các sinh vật chăm sóc và tôn trọng vùng đất này, cô ghét những người có ý định làm tổn thương và hủy diệt nó. Do đó, cô không bao giờ tha thứ cho các vị thần tìm cách hủy diệt những con người này mong muốn yêu thương thiên nhiên quanh họ. Tuy nhiên, điều này không có nghĩa là cô ưu ái loài người hơn những loài khác. Nếu cô phát hiện con người xúc phạm vùng đất này, cô sẽ tấn công người đó một cách giận dữ nhiều như với chính các vị thần.

id: Seorang utri dari Duke Vriskha. Karena statusnya, dia dibesarkan dengan sangat hati-hati oleh penjaga yang terlalu melindungi. Ini membuatnya ingin kebebasan dan bermimpi tentang petualangan. Orang-orang di sekitarnya mengejek mimpinya, tapi dia serius. Dia berlatih pedang dengan diam-diam, dan tidak lama berhasil mengalahkan jago pedang lainnya. Tapi, dia tetap pemalu di depan lelaki.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30102_DESCRIPTION
desc: A princess from the ruined Vriksha Duchy. Because of her status she was raised with great care by an overprotective bodyguard. This made her yearn for freedom and dream of adventure. Those around her mocked her dream, but she was serious. She secretly practiced the sword, and was soon able to surpass other swordsmen. However, she was still shy around men.

raw.en: A princess from the ruined Vriksha Duchy. Because of her status she was raised with great care by an overprotective bodyguard. This made her yearn for freedom and dream of adventure. Those around her mocked her dream, but she was serious. She secretly practiced the sword, and was soon able to surpass other swordsmen. However, she was still shy around men.
raw.es: Princesa del antiguo principado de Vriksha. Dado su estatus, pasó toda su niñez rodeada de guardias que la protegían. Esto despertó sus ganas de tener libertad y vivir aventuras. Muchos pensaron que estaba loca, pero la joven princesa aprendió a luchar con la espada y pronto superó a otros espadachines. El mero encuentro con los  hombres hacía que se ruborizara.
raw.id: Seorang utri dari Duke Vriskha. Karena statusnya, dia dibesarkan dengan sangat hati-hati oleh penjaga yang terlalu melindungi. Ini membuatnya ingin kebebasan dan bermimpi tentang petualangan. Orang-orang di sekitarnya mengejek mimpinya, tapi dia serius. Dia berlatih pedang dengan diam-diam, dan tidak lama berhasil mengalahkan jago pedang lainnya. Tapi, dia tetap pemalu di depan lelaki.
raw.pt: Uma princesa do Ducado arruinado de Vriksha. Por causa de seu status ela foi criada com muito cuidado por um guarda-costas superprotetor. Isso criou nela o anseio pela liberdade e despertou sonhos de aventura. Aqueles à sua volta a zombavam pelo sonho, mas ela não estava brincando. Secretamente ela praticou o manejo da espada, e logo conseguiu superar outros espadachins. Porém ela ainda era tímida ao redor de homens.
raw.th: เจ้าหญิงจากนครรัฐพฤกษาที่ล่มสลาย เนื่องด้วยสถานะของเธอจึงทำให้เธอถูกเลี้ยงมาอย่างระมัดระวังมากโดยเหล่าบอดี้การ์ดผู้เป็นห่วงเธอมากเกินไป นี่เป็นเหตุให้เธอโหยหาอิสรภาพและฝันที่จะได้ออกผจญภัย คนรอบข้างของเธอหัวเราะเยาะความฝันนั้นแต่เธอมีความตั้งใจจริง เธอแอบฝึกวิชาดาบอย่างลับๆ และไม่นานก็สามารถเอาชนะนักดาบคนอื่นๆได้ อย่างไรก็ดี เธอก็ยังคงขี้อายเวลาอยู่ต่อหน้าผู้ชาย
raw.vi: Một công chúa của vùng Vriksha Duchy đổ nát. Vì thân phận của mình nên cô đã từng sống trong một sự bảo vệ cao của một vệ sỹ luôn theo sát. Điều này làm cho cô luôn khát khao được tự do và mơ về các cuộc phiêu lưu. Cô luôn khao khát ước muốn thành hiện thực mặc cho những người xung quanh luôn chế nhạo điều đó. Cô bí mật luyện kiếm và nhanh chóng giỏi hơn những kiếm sĩ khác. Tuy nhiên, cô luôn xấu hổ khi đứng cạnh đàn ông.

id: Seorang putri dari Duke Vriksha yang hancur, dan salah satu jago pedang paling terkenal di negerinya. Dia bergabung di medan perang ketika negaranya diserang para dewa. Dengan menggunakan Pedang Bumi Vriklius, dia maju berperang. Tapi, karena kurang pengalaman, dia menjadi terisolasi di medan perang. Banyak yang mengorbankan nyawanya untuk menyelamatkannya, tapi usaha mereka berakhir tragis.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30103_DESCRIPTION
desc: A princess of the ruined Vriksha Duchy, and one of the country's most prominent swordswomen. She took to the battlefield when the gods invaded her country. With the Earth Sword Vriklius in hand she engaged in battle. However, due to her inexperience, she became isolated on the battlefield. Many sacrificed themsevles to save her, but their efforts came to a tragic end.

raw.en: A princess of the ruined Vriksha Duchy, and one of the country's most prominent swordswomen. She took to the battlefield when the gods invaded her country. With the Earth Sword Vriklius in hand she engaged in battle. However, due to her inexperience, she became isolated on the battlefield. Many sacrificed themsevles to save her, but their efforts came to a tragic end.
raw.es: Princesa del principado de Vriksha y una de las mejores espadachinas de la región. Se alzó a las armas cuando estalló la guerra contra los dioses y logró hacerles frente con su espada pétrea Vriklius. Por desgracia, su inexperiencia hizo que se quedara sola en la batalla y que muchos sacrificaran su vida solo por protegerla.

raw.pt: Uma princesa do Ducado arruinado de Vriksha, e uma das espadachins mais proeminentes do país. Ela foi ao campo de batalha quando os deuses invadiram seu país. Com a Espada da Terra Vriklius em punho, ela mergulhou na batalha. Mas devido à sua inexperiência, ela ficou isolada no campo. Muitos se sacrificaram para salvá-la, mas seus esforços tiveram um fim trágico.
raw.th: เจ้าหญิงจากนครรัฐพฤกษาที่ล่มสลาย และเป็นหนึ่งในนักดาบหญิงที่โดดเด่นที่สุดของประเทศ เธอเข้าร่วมสงครามเมื่อเหล่าเทพเจ้ารุกรานประเทศของเธอ เธอเข้าต่อสู้ด้วยดาบธาตุดินในมือ แต่เนื่องจากความด้อยประสบการ เธอจึงโดดเดี่ยวอยู่ในสนามรบ หลายคนสละตัวเองเพื่อปกป้องเธอแต่ความพยายามของพวกเขาก็นำมาซึ่งจุดจบที่น่าเศร้า
raw.vi: Một công chúa của vùng Vriksha Duchy đổ nát và là một trong những kiếm sĩ bậc nhất của đất nước. Cô đã ra chiến trường khi các vị thần xâm chiếm đất nước của mình. Với thanh kiếm Vriklius Trái Đất  trong tay cô xông pha vào trận chiến. Tuy nhiên, do thiếu kinh nghiệm của mình, cô đã bi cô lập trên chiến trường. Nhiều bình lính đã hy sinh để cứu cô, nhưng nỗ lực của họ đã kết thúc bi thảm.

id: Putri dari Wilayah Vriksha yang hancur, ia juga adalah pejuang penting di negaranya. Melalui tindakannya, wilayahnya damai namun segera jatuh akibat kekuatan musuh yang melimpah. Selagi ia hampir mengorbankan diri untuk rakyat, mukjizat terjadi. Entitas memasuki badannya, memberinya lebih banyak kekuatan. Yang orang tidak tahu adalah bahwa ia menukarkan nyawanya untuk kekuatan ini.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30104_DESCRIPTION
desc: A princess from the ruined Vriksha Duchy, she was also a prominent warrior in her home country. Through her actions there was a moment of peace, but soon the duchy began to collapse under the enemy's overwhelming force. Then, just as she was about to sacrifice herself for her people, a miracle happened. An entity entered her body, granting her even more strength than before. However, what the people didn't know was that she exchanged her life for this power.

raw.en: A princess from the ruined Vriksha Duchy, she was also a prominent warrior in her home country. Through her actions there was a moment of peace, but soon the duchy began to collapse under the enemy's overwhelming force. Then, just as she was about to sacrifice herself for her people, a miracle happened. An entity entered her body, granting her even more strength than before. However, what the people didn't know was that she exchanged her life for this power.
raw.es: Princesa del antiguo principado de Vriksha y prominente guerrera en su país natal. A través de su comportamiento, Lidith logró conseguir la paz. Sin embargo, al poco tiempo, el principado comenzó a colapsar bajo la abrumadora fuerza enemiga. Cuando Lidith estaba a punto de sacrificarse por su gente, ocurrió el milagro. Una entidad entró en su cuerpo y le otorgó más fuerza de la que alguna vez supo tener. Sin embargo, lo que la gente no sabía era que Lidith había entregado su vida por este poder.
raw.id: Putri dari Wilayah Vriksha yang hancur, ia juga adalah pejuang penting di negaranya. Melalui tindakannya, wilayahnya damai namun segera jatuh akibat kekuatan musuh yang melimpah. Selagi ia hampir mengorbankan diri untuk rakyat, mukjizat terjadi. Entitas memasuki badannya, memberinya lebih banyak kekuatan. Yang orang tidak tahu adalah bahwa ia menukarkan nyawanya untuk kekuatan ini.
raw.pt: Uma princesa do Ducado arruinado de Vriksha, que também era uma guerreira de destaque em sua terra natal. Através de suas ações houve um momento de paz, mas logo o ducado começou a ruir perante a força esmagadora do inimigo. Quando ela estava prestes a sacrificar-se por seu povo, aconteceu um milagre. Uma entidade entrou em seu corpo, dando a ele ainda mais força do que antes. Porém, as pessoas não sabia que ela troco sua vida por este poder.
raw.th: เจ้าหญิงจากซากนครรัฐพฤกษาที่ล่มสลาย เธอยังเป็นนักรบที่ประสบความสำเร็จในประเทศบ้านเกิดของเธอ แม้ว่าสิ่งที่เธอกระทำจะเกิดในช่วงสันติสุข แต่ไม่นานนครรัฐก็เริ่มล่มสลายภายใต้ทัพศัตรูที่ถาโถมเข้ามา และในขณะที่เธอกำลังจะสละชีวิตเพื่อประชาชนของเธอ ปาฏิหารย์ก็บังเกิดขึ้น แก่นแท้ก็ได้เข้ามาสู่ร่างกายของเธอทำให้เธอได้รับพลังมากขึ้นกว่าเก่า อย่างไรก็ตาม สิ่งที่ผู้คนไม่รู้ก็คือเธอต้องแลกด้วยชีวิตของเธอเพื่อให้ได้พลังนี้มา
raw.vi: Một công chúa đến từ Công quốc Vriksha, cô cũng là một chiến binh nổi tiếng tại quốc gia quê hương cô. Nhờ những hành động của cô, đã có lúc hòa bình được thiết lập, nhưng ngay sau đó, công quốc bắt đầu sụp đổ dưới lực lượng áp đảo của đối phương. Sau đó, ngay khi cô sắp hy sinh bản thân vì những người dân của mình, phép màu đã xảy ra. Một thực thể đã đi vào cơ thể cô, cấp cho cô sức mạnh thậm chí mạnh hơn nhiều so với trước kia. Tuy nhiên, cái mà mọi người không biết đó là cô phải trả giá bằng mạng sống của mình để có được sức mạnh đó.

id: Putri dari Kerajaan Kecil Vriksha yang hancur, yang menukar nyawanya untuk mendapatkan kekuatan. Kerajaan Kecil Vriksha berhasil bertahan karena beberapa kemenangan lokal, tapi kondisi perang menjadi lebih buruk. Dengan nyawanya yang lebih pendek karena dia menggunakan kekuatannya, dia menjadi lebih kuat dari sebelumnya. Setelah pengikut keluarganya tahu tentang pengorbanannya untuk rakyat, Lidih hanya menggelengkan kepalanya sambil tersenyum, dan terus bertarung agar rakyat bisa melarikan diri. Melihat pengorbanan yang begitu tulus, banyak dari pengikutnya memutuskan untuk bertarung bersamanya sampai akhir.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30105_DESCRIPTION
desc: A princess from the ruined Vriksha Duchy who exchanged her life to gain power. The Vriksha Duchy managed to hold on thanks to a few local victories, but the condition of the war only got worse. With her lifespan growing shorter as she used her powers, conversely she became even stronger than before. Once the vassals of her family realized what she had sacrificed for the people, Lidith shook her head with a smile, and continued fighting to help citizens evacuate. Watching such selflessness in action, many of her vassals decided to fight alongside her until the bitter end.

raw.en: A princess from the ruined Vriksha Duchy who exchanged her life to gain power. The Vriksha Duchy managed to hold on thanks to a few local victories, but the condition of the war only got worse. With her lifespan growing shorter as she used her powers, conversely she became even stronger than before. Once the vassals of her family realized what she had sacrificed for the people, Lidith shook her head with a smile, and continued fighting to help citizens evacuate. Watching such selflessness in action, many of her vassals decided to fight alongside her until the bitter end.
raw.es: Una princesa del antiguo principado de Vriksha que cambió su vida por poder. El principado de Vriksha logró mantenerse en pie gracias a unas pocas victorias locales, pero la condición de la guerra solo empeoró. Si bien su ciclo de vida se hacía más corto a medida que usaba sus poderes, la princesa se hizo más fuerte que nunca. Cuando los vasallos de su familia se dieron cuenta de lo que la princesa había sacrificado por su gente, Lidith se limitó a sonreír y continuó luchando para ayudar a escapar a los ciudadanos. Cuando comprendieron que la princesa actuaba con total desinterés por su propio bienestar, muchos de los vasallos decidieron pelear a su lado hasta el amargo final.
raw.id: Putri dari Kerajaan Kecil Vriksha yang hancur, yang menukar nyawanya untuk mendapatkan kekuatan. Kerajaan Kecil Vriksha berhasil bertahan karena beberapa kemenangan lokal, tapi kondisi perang menjadi lebih buruk. Dengan nyawanya yang lebih pendek karena dia menggunakan kekuatannya, dia menjadi lebih kuat dari sebelumnya. Setelah pengikut keluarganya tahu tentang pengorbanannya untuk rakyat, Lidih hanya menggelengkan kepalanya sambil tersenyum, dan terus bertarung agar rakyat bisa melarikan diri. Melihat pengorbanan yang begitu tulus, banyak dari pengikutnya memutuskan untuk bertarung bersamanya sampai akhir.
raw.pt: Uma princesa do Ducado arruinado de Vriksha que trocou a vida para obter poder. O Ducado de Vriksha conseguiu suportar graças a poucas vitórias locais, mas a condição da guerra só piorou. Com sua expectativa de vida diminuindo a medida que usava seus poderes, ela ficou mais forte do que antes. Quando os vassalos da família dela perceberam o que ela sacrificou pelo povo, Lidith balançou a cabeça com um sorriso e continuou lutando para ajudar os cidadãos a fugirem. Vendo tanto altruismo em ação, muitos de seus vassalos decidiram lutar ao seu lado até o fim.
raw.th: เจ้าหญิงจากมณฑลรัฐพฤกษาที่ล่มสลาย ที่แลกเปลี่ยนชีวิตเธอกับพลังมณฑลรัฐพฤกษา สามารถที่จะเอาชนะสงครามได้บางครั้งแต่สถานการณ์เริ่มย่ำแย่ลง ชีวิตของเจ้าหญิงสั้นลงทุกครั้งที่เธอใช้พลัง แต่พลังของเธอก็แข็งแกร่งขึ้นทุกๆ ครั้ง เมื่อผู้ติดตาม รวมถึงครอบครัวรู้เรื่องของการเสียสละของเธอแก่ประชาชน ลิดิธส่ายหัวพร้อมกับรอยยิ้มและต่อสู้เพื่อนำประชาชนออกจากประเทศ ด้วยความเสียสละของเธอ ผู้ติดตามได้ตัดสินใจต่อสู้ข้างๆ เธอจนถึงที่สุด
raw.vi: Một công chúa từ Công quốc Vriksha tàn phá, người đã đổi mạng mình để có được sức mạnh. Công quốc Vriksha đã xoay trở tồn tại nhờ một vài chiến thắng tại đấy, nhưng tình trạng chiến tranh chỉ trở nên tồi tệ hơn. Dù tuổi thọ nàng ngày càng ngắn khi dùng sức mạnh của mình, ngược lại nàng càng trở nên mạnh mẽ hơn trước. Khi gia tướng của gia đình nàng nhận ra những gì nàng đã hy sinh cho mọi người, Lidith mỉm cười lắc đầu, và tiếp tục chiến đấu để giúp người dân sơ tán. Chứng kiến lòng vị tha đó, nhiều gia tướng của nàng đã quyết định chiến đấu cạnh nàng cho đến kết cục cay đắng của nàng.

id: Pohon besar yang punya kehendak sendiri dan bisa bergerak. Dia juga bisa berbicara, tapi karena dia mendapat nutrisi dari fotosintesis, dia masih dikaslifikasikan sebagai tumbuhan. Buah Alneu mengandung stimulan yang bisa menyembuhkan kelelahan , dan dia sering memberikannya kepada manusia yang disukainya. Meskipun ukurannya besar, dia suka barang yang kecil dan lucu, terutama anak manusia.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30112_DESCRIPTION
desc: A giant tree with a willof its own and the ability to move. It can also speak, but since it gets its nutrition from photosynthesis, it's still biologically classified as a plant. Alneu's fruit contains a stimulant that can heal fatigue, and it often gives it to humans it likes. Contrary to its large size it likes small and cute things, especially human children.

raw.en: A giant tree with a willof its own and the ability to move. It can also speak, but since it gets its nutrition from photosynthesis, it's still biologically classified as a plant. Alneu's fruit contains a stimulant that can heal fatigue, and it often gives it to humans it likes. Contrary to its large size it likes small and cute things, especially human children.
raw.es: Árbol gigante con voluntad propia que puede moverse y hablar. Ya que recibe sus nutrientes a través de la fotosíntesis, se considera una planta. Los frutos de Alneu, que suele ofrecer a quien es de su agrado, estimulan y curan el cansancio. A pesar de su gran tamaño, le gustan las cosas pequeñas como los niños.
raw.id: Pohon besar yang punya kehendak sendiri dan bisa bergerak. Dia juga bisa berbicara, tapi karena dia mendapat nutrisi dari fotosintesis, dia masih dikaslifikasikan sebagai tumbuhan. Buah Alneu mengandung stimulan yang bisa menyembuhkan kelelahan , dan dia sering memberikannya kepada manusia yang disukainya. Meskipun ukurannya besar, dia suka barang yang kecil dan lucu, terutama anak manusia.
raw.pt: Uma árvore gigante com vontade própria e a habilidade de se mover. Ela também pode falar, mas por ter sua fonte de nutrição na fotossíntese, ainda é classificada biologicamente como uma planta. O fruto de Alneu contém um estimulante que pode curar a fadiga, e ela geralmente o presenteia a humanos de quem gosta. Apesar de seu tamanho enorme, ela gosta de coisas pequenas e adoráveis, em especial crianças humanas.
raw.th: ต้นไม้ยักษ์ที่มีความคิดเป็นของตัวเองและมีความสามารถในการเคลื่อนย้าย นอกจากนี้มันยังสามารถพูด แต่เนื่องจากมันได้รับสารอาหารจากการสังเคราะห์แสง ในทางชีวภาพก็ยังคงจัดเป็นพืช ผลของ "อัลนู" ประกอบด้วยยากระตุ้นที่สามารถรักษาความเมื่อยล้าและมันมักจะมอบให้กับมนุษย์ที่มันชอบ ขัดกับขนาดของมัน มันชอบสิ่งที่มีขนาดเล็กและน่ารักโดยเฉพาะอย่างยิ่งมนุษย์เด็กๆ
raw.vi: Một cái cây khổng lồ có suy nghĩ và có khả năng di chuyển. Nó cũng có thể nói nhưng từ khi nó có dinh dưỡng từ quan hợp và nó vẫn được phân loại theo sinh học như một loại cây. Quả Alneu chứa một chất thần kỳ có thể chữa bệnh, làm tiêu tan mệt mỏi và nó thường chia cho những người mà nó thích. Khác với thân hình to lớn, nó thích những thứ nỏ, đáng yêu, đặc biệt là trẻ con.

id: Ketika Pohon Besar Alneu telah hidup lebih dari 10.000 tahun, dia berubah menjadi pohon Dunia, Altro. Tidak bisa mati, Altro juga telah ada sejak permulaan waktu, juga dikenal sebagai makhluk tertua di dunia. Beberapa orang mencari Altro untuk memecahkan masalah sulit di dunia, tapi karena dia hidup jauh di dalam area yang terpencil, banyak yang patah semangat untuk mencarinya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30113_DESCRIPTION
desc: When Great Tree Alneu has lived for more than 10,000 years, it transforms into theg World Tree, Altro. Basically immortal, Altro, who has been around since the beginning of time, is also know as the world's eldest being. Some search for Altro looking to solve the world'd most difficult problems, but since it lives deep inside a secluded area, most get discouraged from looking for it.

Basically immortal, Altro, who has been around since the beginning of time, is also know as the world's eldest being. raw.es: Cuando el gran árbol Alneu supera los 10.000 años de edad se transforma en el sumo árbol Altro. Este ser inmortal lleva en este mundo desde sus comienzos y se considera la criatura más longeva. Muchos buscan a Altro para resolver los misterios del planeta, pero acaban rindiéndose ya que habita en una zona apartada del resto del mundo.
raw.id: Ketika Pohon Besar Alneu telah hidup lebih dari 10.000 tahun, dia berubah menjadi pohon Dunia, Altro. Tidak bisa mati, Altro juga telah ada sejak permulaan waktu, juga dikenal sebagai makhluk tertua di dunia. Beberapa orang mencari Altro untuk memecahkan masalah sulit di dunia, tapi karena dia hidup jauh di dalam area yang terpencil, banyak yang patah semangat untuk mencarinya.
raw.pt: Quando a Grande Árvore Alneu viveu por mais de dez mil anos, ela se transformou na Árvore do Mundo, Altro. Basicamente imortal, Altro está presente desde os primórdios e é conhecido como o ser mais velho do mundo. Alguns buscam por Altro procurando a solução para os problemas mais difíceis do mundo, mas já que ele vive em reclusão em uma área isolada, a maioria é desencorajado da busca.
raw.th: เมื่อต้นไม้ใหญ่ อัลนู มีชีวิตอยู่นานกว่า 10,000 ปีก็เปลี่ยนเป็นต้นไม้โลก อัลโทร ใความเป็นอมตะ อัลโทรที่อยู่มานานตั้งแต่สมัยยุคแรกถูกเรียกกันว่าเป็นสิ่งมีชีวติที่แก่ที่สุดในโลก บางคนตามหาอัลโทรเพื่อให้แก้ปัญหาที่ยากที่สุดในโลก แต่เพราะมันอาศัยอยู่ในส่วนลึกของพื้นที่ที่เงียบสงบมากที่สุด คนส่วยใหญ่จึงหมดกำลังใจที่จะค้นหามัน
raw.vi: Khi Great Tree Alneu đã sốngđược hơn 10000 năm, nó biến thành Altro - theg World Tree. Về khía cạnh bất tử, Altro cũng là người chị cả của thế giới. Một vài lần tìm kiếm Altro để giải quyết các vấn đề khó khăn nhất của thế giới nhưng vì nó sống sâu bên trong một vùng hẻo lánh nên hầu hết mọi sự tìm kiếm đều thất bại.

id: Eltri katanya adalah nenek moyang semua pohon di Gaia besar. Besar dan bisa terbang di udara, sangat menakjubkan sehingga beberapa orang mengiranya adalah pulau terbang. Kalau dia terbang di tempat yang sama selama beberapa tahun, kadang hutan akan muncul di sekitarnya, meskipun tanahnya gersang. Dipuja sebagai Dewa Pohon karena dia mampu menumbuhkan kehidupan di sekitarnya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30114_DESCRIPTION
desc: Eltri is said to be the ancestor of all the trees in Grand Gaia. Immense and able to float in the air, it's so impressive that some people mistake it for a floating island. If it floats in the same place for many years, sometimes a forest will suddenly appear nearby, even in wastelands. It is worshipped as the God Tree as it has the ability to sprout life all around it.

raw.en: Eltri is said to be the ancestor of all the trees in Grand Gaia. Immense and able to float in the air, it's so impressive that some people mistake it for a floating island. If it floats in the same place for many years, sometimes a forest will suddenly appear nearby, even in wastelands. It is worshipped as the God Tree as it has the ability to sprout life all around it.
raw.es: Eltri se considera el antecesor del resto de árboles de Gran Gaia. Es enorme y puede flotar en el aire, por lo que muchos lo confunden con una isla flotante. Si flota en la misma zona durante varios años puede crear un bosque, incluso si no hay más que desierto. Se considera el dios de los árboles ya que es capaz de generar vida.
raw.id: Eltri katanya adalah nenek moyang semua pohon di Gaia besar. Besar dan bisa terbang di udara, sangat menakjubkan sehingga beberapa orang mengiranya adalah pulau terbang. raw.pt: Dizem que Eltri é o ancestral de todas as árvores em Grand Gaia. Imensa e capaz de flutuar no ar, é tão impressionante que muitos a confundem com uma ilha voadora. Se ela flutua no mesmo lugar por muitos anos, às vezes uma floresta surge por perto, mesmo em meio a terras devastadas. Ela é adorada como o Deus-Árvore, e tem a habilidade de fazer brotar a vida à sua volta.
raw.th: ว่ากันว่า "เอลทรี" เป็นบรรพบุรุษของต้นไม้ทั้งหมดในแกรนด์ไกอา ใขนากใหญ่มากและสามารถที่จะลอยอยู่ในอากาศได้ เป็นที่น่าประทับใจจนทำให้ให้บางคนเข้าใจผิดว่ามันเป็นเกาะลอย ถ้ามันลอยอยู่ในสถานที่เดียวกันเป็นเวลาหลายปีบางครั้งป่าก็จะปรากฎขึ้นในบริเวณใกล้เคียงแม้จะอยู่ในที่รกร้าง เป็นที่เคารพบูชาเป็นเทพเจ้าต้นไม้ที่มีความสามารถในการแตกหน่อชีวิตรอบตัวมัน
raw.vi: Eltri được cho là tổ tiên của tất cả các cây ở Grand Gaia. To lớn và có thể nổi trong không khí và  gây ấn tượng khi một số người nhầm nó là một hòn đảo nổi. Nếu nó nổi tại một vị trí trong nhiều năm, có thể sẽ có một khu rừng đột ngột xuất hiện gần đó, thậm chí trong những vùng đất hoang. Nó được tôn thờ như  Cây thần thánh vì nó có khả năng làm nảy nở cuộc sống xung quanh nó.

id: Ayah dari semua pohon, Eltri, setelah mengumpulkan kekuatan bertahun-tahun, ia memiliki banyak kepribadian. Meski ia memisahkannya agar bisa berdebat, menambah ketepatan pemikirannya. Ada teori tak terkonfirmasi bahwa kepribadian multipelnya ada dalam eksteriornya yang seperti benteng. Wajah yang bisa dilihat padanya sekarang adalah kepribadian utama, dengan semua percakapan pentingnya.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30115_DESCRIPTION
desc: The father of all trees, Eltri, after acquiring the knowledge of countless years came to hold a multitude of personalities. It's thought he separated his personalities so that he could debate between them, increasing the precision of his thinking. There is an unconfirmed theory that states that his multiple personalities reside within his fort-like exterior. It appears that the faces that can be seen on him now represent his main personalities, with all important conversations going through them.

raw.en: The father of all trees, Eltri, after acquiring the knowledge of countless years came to hold a multitude of personalities. It's thought he separated his personalities so that he could debate between them, increasing the precision of his thinking. There is an unconfirmed theory that states that his multiple personalities reside within his fort-like exterior. It appears that the faces that can be seen on him now represent his main personalities, with all important conversations going through them.
raw.es: Padre de todos los árboles. Después de adquirir el conocimiento de incontables años, Altri almacena una multitud de personalidades. Se cree que separó todas sus personalidades para poder debatir entre sí, en afán de aumentar la precisión de su razonamiento. Hay una teoría, todavía no confirmada, que dice que sus múltiples personalidades residen dentro de su exterior fortificado. Parece que las caras que se pueden ver sobre su corteza representan las diferentes personalidades, y que todas ellas participan de las conversaciones.

Ada teori tak terkonfirmasi bahwa kepribadian multipelnya ada dalam eksteriornya yang seperti benteng. Wajah yang bisa dilihat padanya sekarang adalah kepribadian utama, dengan semua percakapan pentingnya.
raw.pt: O pai de todas as árvores, Eltri, reuniu uma multidão de personalidades depois de incontáveis anos acumulando uma multidão de personalidades. Acredita-se que ele separou suas personalidades para que pudesse debater com elas, aumentando a precisão de seu pensar. Existe uma teoria não confirmada de que suas muitas personalidades residem em seu exterior parecido com um forte. Parece que todas as faces que agora podem ser vistas nele representam suas personalidades principais, com todas as conversas passando por elas.
raw.th: บิดาแห่งต้นไม้ทั้งมวล หลังจาก เอลทริ ได้รับความรอบรู้มานานหลายปีจนนับไม่ถ้วนและมีความหลายหลายของบุคลิก ได้มีการคิดกันว่ามันได้แยกบุคลิกออกจากกันเพื่อที่มันจะได้สามารถถกเถียงกันเองได้เพื่อเพิ่มความเฉียบคมในการคิด มีทฤษฎีที่ไม่ได้รับการยืนยันอันหนึ่งได้กล่าวไว้ว่าบุคลิกทั้งหลายอยู่ภายในรูปร่างที่เหมือนป้อมปราการของมัน ดูเหมือนว่าใบหน้าที่สามารถมองเห็นบนตัวของมันจะแสดงถึงบุคลิกหลักที่การสนทนาที่สำคัญทั้งหมดจะต้องพูดผ่านมัน
raw.vi: Đấng sinh thành của tất cả cây cối, Eltri, sau vô số năm tích lũy kiến thức, đã sở hữu được vô số tính cách. Người ta nghĩ rằng ông đã tách biệt các tính cách của mình để có thể tranh luận giữa chúng, giúp tăng độ chính xác trong tư duy của ông. Có một giả thuyết chưa được xác nhận rằng, đa tính cách ẩn dấu bên trong vẻ ngoài giống như pháo đài của ông. Có vẻ như các khuôn mặt có thể nhìn thấy trên ông hiện tại đại diện cho các tính cách chính của ông, với tất cả các cuộc trò chuyện quan trọng thông qua chúng.

id: Penembak mesin yang berkelana di sekitar Duke Vriksha. Dia kehilangan ingatan dan diketahui sebagai pengunjung dari dunia lain yang tidak diketahui. Senapan mesinnya bisa menghancurkan pasukan dengan zirah yang tebal, tapi karena Vriskha tidak bisa membuat amunisinya, dia hanya digunakan pada perang yang paling penting. Karena tidak puas, dia menghabisnya waktunya untuk riset.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30122_DESCRIPTION
desc: A gatling gunner who forages in the Vriksha Duchy. He lost his memory and was known as a visitor from another world with an unknown origin. His gatling gun could take down heavily armored regiments, but as Vriksha was unable to make ammunition, he would only be used in the most important battles. Dissatisfied with this, it is said he spent his days researching.

raw.en: A gatling gunner who forages in the Vriksha Duchy. He lost his memory and was known as a visitor from another world with an unknown origin. His gatling gun could take down heavily armored regiments, but as Vriksha was unable to make ammunition, he would only be used in the most important battles. Dissatisfied with this, it is said he spent his days researching.
raw.es: Un pistolero que deambula por el principado de Vriksha. Perdió su memoria y muchos creen que viene de un mundo desconocido. Su ametralladora puede arrasar con ejércitos armados, pero como en Vriksha no hay munición, solo la usa en caso de que sea necesario. Con tal de resolver este problema, Max investiga día y noche.

raw.pt: Um atirador que vive no Ducado de Vriksha. Ele perdeu a memória e é conhecido como um visitante de outro mundo de origem desconhecida. Sua metralhadora podia dar conta de regimentos altamente armados e protegidos, mas como Vriksha não produzia munições, ele somente a usava nas batalhas mais importantes. Insatisfeito com a condição, dizem que ele passou seus dias pesquisando.
raw.th: มือปืนกลแก็ทลิ่งที่หากินในนครรัฐพฤกษา เขาสูญเสียความทรงจำและถูกเรียกว่าเป็นผู้มาเยือนจากโลกอื่นที่ไม่รู้ที่มา ปืนกลแก็ทลิ่งของเขาสามารถจัดการกองทหารติดอาวุธหนัก แต่ที่พฤกษานั้นไม่สามารถสร้างกระสุนได้ เขาจึงถูกใช้เฉพาะศึกที่สำคัญเท่านั้น และเพราะความไม่ค่อยพอใจในเรื่องนี้ว่ากันว่าเขาใช้เวลาทั้งวันในการค้นคว้า
raw.vi: Một tay súng khét tiếng đã cướp phá vùng Vriksha Duchy. Anh ta đã bị mất trí nhớ và được biết đến như là du khách từ một thế giới khác không rõ nguồn gốc. Tài bắn súng của anh ta có thể đi vào trung đoàn bọc thép, nhưng do Vriksh không thể làm đạn dược, anh ta sẽ chỉ được sử dụng trong các trận đánh quan trọng nhất. Không hài lòng với điều này, người ta nói ông đã dành thời gian của mình cho nghiên cứu.

id: Penembak mesin yang berkelana di sekitar Duke Vriksha. Douglas disebut sebagai pengunjung dari dunia lain, dan karena senapannya tidak ada di Gaia Besar, dia mengalami kesulitan mencari amunisi. Tapi, dia berhasil membuat mekanisme yang memanfaatkan sihir untuk amunisi. Senapan itu lalu akan melepaskan rentetan peluru selama sihir penggunanya masih ada.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30123_DESCRIPTION
desc: A gatling gunner who forages in the Vriksha Duchy. Douglas was said to be a visitor from another world, and since his gun was nonexistent in Grand Gaia he faced difficulties procuring ammuniction. However, he succeeded in making a mechanism that used magic for ammunition. The gun would then unleash a fury of bullets as long as the user's magic held up.

raw.en: A gatling gunner who forages in the Vriksha Duchy. Douglas was said to be a visitor from another world, and since his gun was nonexistent in Grand Gaia he faced difficulties procuring ammuniction. However, he succeeded in making a mechanism that used magic for ammunition. The gun would then unleash a fury of bullets as long as the user's magic held up.
raw.es: Un pistolero que deambula por el principado de Vriksha. Muchos creen que viene de otro mundo y, como su ametralladora no existía en Gran Gaia, su munición se ha convertido en su bien más preciado. Tras mucho investigar, Max logró crear una máquina que convertía la magia en balas y pudo poner fin al problema que tanto le atormentaba.
raw.id: Penembak mesin yang berkelana di sekitar Duke Vriksha. Tapi, dia berhasil membuat mekanisme yang memanfaatkan sihir untuk amunisi. Senapan itu lalu akan melepaskan rentetan peluru selama sihir penggunanya masih ada.
raw.pt: Um atirador que vive no Ducado de Vriksha. Dizem que Douglas era um visitante de outro mundo, e como sua arma era inexistente em Grand Gaia ele encontrou dificuldades para encontrar munição. Porém ele conseguiu produzir um mecanismo que usava magia como munição. A arma passou a soltar uma torrente furiosa de balas enquanto a magia do usuário aguentasse.
raw.th: มือปืนกลแก็ทลิ่งที่หากินในนครรัฐพฤกษา ว่ากันว่าดั๊กกลาสเป็นผู้มาเยือนจากโลกอื่นและเนื่องจากปืนของเขาไม่เคยมีปรากฎในแกรนด์ไกอามาก่อน เขาจึงมีปัญหากับการค้นหากระสุนมาใช้ อย่างไรก็ดีเขาคิดค้นกลไกที่จะนำพลังเวทมนตร์มาอัดเป็นกระสุนได้สำเร็จ ปืนจึงได้ปลดลป่อยกระสุนที่รุนแรงได้นานตราบเท่าที่พลังเวทของผู้ใช้ยังมีอยู่
raw.vi: Một tay súng khét tiếng đã cướp phá vùng Vriksha Duchy. Douglas được biết đến như người du khách từ một thế giới khác và kể từ khi khẩu súng của anh ta không thể sử dụng trong vùng Grand Gaia thì anh ta đã phải đối mặt với những khó khăn để mua đạn. Tuy nhiên, anh ta đã thành công trong việc tạo ra một cơ chế mà được sử dụng phép thuật cho đạn. Súng sẽ phóng ra một viên đạn ma thuật khi người sử dụng bắn.

id: Penembak mesin yang berkenala di sekitar Duke Vriksha. Katanya dia berasal dari dunia lain. Dia melawan para dewa dengan senapan mesinnya, tak lelah melatih sihirnya untuk menambah kekuatan tembakannya. Dia tidak mengikuti strategi terntentu, tidak pernah takut perang. Dia melawan puluhan ribu sendirian, menghabiskan titik terakhir energinya setelah mengalahkan jendral musul.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30124_DESCRIPTION
desc: A gatling gunner who forages in the Vriksha Duchy.  He is said to be from another world. He took on the gods with his gatling gun, restlessly training his magic to increase the power of each shot. He followed no strategy, never fearing battle. He faced tens of thousands alone, drawing on his last bit of energy only after defeating the enemy general.

raw.en: A gatling gunner who forages in the Vriksha Duchy.  He is said to be from another world. He took on the gods with his gatling gun, restlessly training his magic to increase the power of each shot. He followed no strategy, never fearing battle. He faced tens of thousands alone, drawing on his last bit of energy only after defeating the enemy general.
raw.es: Un pistolero que deambula por el principado de Vriksha  y que proviene de otro mundo. Se enfrentó a los dioses armado con su ametralladora y con su magia capaz de aumentar el poder de cada disparo. Max jamás temió a un combate, y tras hacer frente a miles de enemigos él solo, liberó la energía que le quedaba para derrotar al general enemigo.

Dia melawan puluhan ribu sendirian, menghabiskan titik terakhir energinya setelah mengalahkan jendral musul.
raw.pt: Um atirador que vive no Ducado de Vriksha.  Dizem que ele veio de outro mundo. Ele enfrentou os deuses com sua metralhadora, treinando incansavelmente sua magia para aumentar o podoer de cada tiro. Ele não seguia estratégia, e nunca temia a batalha. Ele enfrentou dezenas de milhares sozinho, dando seu último suspiro somente após derrotar o general inimigo.
raw.th: มือปืนกลแก็ทลิ่งที่หากินในนครรัฐพฤกษา ว่ากันว่าเขาคือผู้มาเยือนจากต่างโลก เขาจัดการกับเทพเจ้าด้วยปืนกลแก็ทลิ่งของเขา เขาฝึกฝนเวทมนตร์โดยไม่หยุดพักเพื่อเพิ่มพลังการยิงในแต่ละครั้ง เขาไม่สนใจแผนการ ไม่กลัวการรบ เขาเผชิญหน้าศัตรูนับหมื่นตามลำพัง โดยเหลือพลังงานให้ใช้เพียงนิดเดียวหลังจากที่สังหารแม่ทัพของศัตรูลงได้
raw.vi: Một tay súng khét tiếng đã cướp phá vùng Vriksha Duchy. Anh ta được cho rằng đến từ một thế giới khác. Anh ta đảm nhận chức vụ như một vị thần với khẩu súng trong tay đã không ngừng đào tạo ma thuật của mình để làm tăng sức mạnh của mỗi lần bắn. Anh ta không tuân theo chiến thuật, không bao giờ lo sợ chiến đấu. Anh ta sống hàng vạn năm một mình mà phải dựa vào hơi sức cuối cùng sau khi đánh bại kẻ thù chung

id: Seorang pengguna senapan mesin yang berkelana di Duke Vriksha. Catatan sejarah menceritakan dia menantang berpuluh-puluh ribu dewa sendirian sebelum akhirnya menderita luka parah. Tapi, ada beberapa dokumen yang menceritakan nasibnya setelah itu. Sepertinya dia menghilang menuju gerbang ke dunia lain sebelum meninggal. Ketika perang hampir selesai, Douglas dan senapan mesin magisnya yang sangat kuat sekali lagi berdiri menantang pasukan para dewa.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_30125_DESCRIPTION
desc: A magical machine gunner who forages in the Vriksha Duchy. Historical texts tell of how he challenged tens of thousands of gods on his own before suffering a fatal wound. However, there is a handful of documents chronicling his actions afterwards. It seems he had disappeared into a gate to the otherworld just before dying. As the war and mankind itself drew to an end, Douglas and his immensely powerful magic gattling gun once again stood in defience before the army of gods.
